title: TapirMasterModels
description: A consolidated, single-file schema for the Archicad Tapir JSON API.

designOptionsToActivate.description: The design options to activate, each in the given combination.

ActiveGraphicalOverrideCombinationById.description: The graphic override combination to apply, given by id or by name.

ActiveGraphicalOverrideCombinationByName.description: The graphic override combination to apply, given by id or by name.

name.description: Name of the renovation filter. An exact match wins over a case-insensitive one.

author.description: The author of the new comment.

overwriteExisting.description: Optional. When true, an embedded library item already existing on an outputPath is deleted first, so the newly added file replaces the loaded library part. By default false: the existing loaded part stays in use. Requires Archicad 27 or newer.

libraries.description: Local library folders or container files, by absolute path.

loadCombinationId.description: The identifier of the load combination to add the load cases to.

loadFactors.description: The load cases to add, with their factors.

tableId.description: The guid of a preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables (the branch, elbow and transition tables with includeFittingTables): a pipe or circular duct segment table, a branch or elbow table of the Piping or Ventilation domain, or, from Archicad 29, a transition table. Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables are found too, but their rows have no key. Archicad 27: any preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers.

rows.description: The rows to add, with their key and optionally their values. Branch tables from Archicad 28, elbow and transition tables from Archicad 29. Segment tables have a row for each reference id, so no row can be added to them. Archicad 27: the key has the shape only, the table gives the index.

executionResults.description: One result per row, in the order of the rows.

viewSettingsFlags.description: The view settings flags of the item, as Archicad stores them (a bit field).

AddOnViewpointTypeOrUndefined.description: Whether the item is a root, a group or a leaf node.

propertyId.description: An existing custom property. Create it first with CreatePropertyDefinitions if needed.

elements.description: The elements to align: Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Morph, Mesh, Zone, Object, Lamp, Stair, Railing, CurtainWall, Line, PolyLine, Arc, Circle, Spline, Hatch, Text or Hotspot, in the current database.

alignTo.description: The edge of the plan bounding boxes to align: left (smallest X), right (largest X), bottom (smallest Y), top (largest Y), centerX (the middle in X, so the elements line up on one vertical line) or centerY (the middle in Y, on one horizontal line).

reference.description: Optional element to align to; it is not moved itself. Without it the elements are aligned to the outermost edge of the whole set (its leftmost left edge, its topmost top edge, ...), or for centerX and centerY to the middle of the bounding box of the whole set.

endAdditionalLength.description: The length added to the curve member at its end.

loadCaseId.description: The load case the load belongs to.

AnalyticalImportIdMapping.description: Maps the edges and vertices of the given surface member to the parts of the new element. Archicad 26 and newer.

duration.description: Left out when it is not set.

AnalyticalLoadDistributionType.description: Whether the load is the same along the edge or changes from the start value to the end value.

AnalyticalLoadFactor.description: A load case of a structural analysis load combination with its factors.

multiplier.description: The multiplier of the load case.

intersectingMemberPartRef.description: When given, the local coordinate system of memberPartRef in its intersection with this member part is returned.

AnalyticalMemberPartRef.description: A reference to a part (vertex, edge or surface) of an analytical member. partId, customVertexData and ratioEdgeData are zero when left out.

elemGuid.description: The element of the analytical member.

AnalyticalMemberType.description: The analytical member type of an element.

amVariationGuid.description: The identifier of the analytical model variation. Archicad 27 and newer.

renovationFilterGuid.description: The identifier of the renovation filter of the variation. Archicad 25 and 26.

layerConnectionClassIds.description: The connection classes of the layers. Archicad 25: a list of integers. Archicad 26: one object per layer, with the layer's attribute index and its connection class.

AnalyticalNode.description: A node of the Structural Analytical Model.

AnalyticalPointLoad.description: An analytical point load: its settings and the member part it loads.

loadCaseId.description: The load case the load belongs to.

AnalyticalRatioEdgeData.description: The part of the edge of a RatioEdge.

AnalyticalRelease.description: The release of an analytical member.

releaseDescriptions.description: The releases of the member parts. Each needs all six rigidities; a stiffness left out is 0.

AnalyticalRigidityType.description: The rigidity of a degree of freedom of a release.

segmentedSurfaceMembers.description: The segments of the surface member.

AnalyticalSupport.description: An analytical support: its settings and the member part it supports. Every rigidity type is required; a value left out is 0.

AnalyticalSupportGeometry.description: The geometry of an analytical support in a Structural Analytical Model.

AnalyticalSurfaceLoad.description: An analytical surface load: its settings and the member part it loads.

loadCaseId.description: The load case the load belongs to.

AnalyticalSurfaceMember.description: A surface member (wall, slab, roof) or a segment of one of the Structural Analytical Model.

contour.description: The curves of the outer contour.

lcsXVector.description: The X axis of the local coordinate system. Archicad 26 and newer.

materialAttrIndex.description: The attribute index of the material.

AnalyticalVisibilityMode.description: Whether only the analytical model is shown or the analytical model within the entire model.

AnalyticalVisibilitySettings.description: The visibility settings of the Structural Analytical Model. Archicad 26 and newer.

favoriteName.description: The name of the Favorite whose settings become the settings of its tool.

elementType.description: The element type of the tool whose settings changed.

favoritesToApply.description: The elements and the Favorite to apply to each. Give this or favorite.

favorite.description: The name of one Favorite to apply to many elements, instead of favoritesToApply: to the given elements, or without elements to every element of the Favorite's type that matches the filter. The Favorite is read only once. Needs elements or filter.

elements.description: The elements to apply the single favorite to, one execution result each, in the same order. Only with favorite.

filter.description: Server-side element filter for the single favorite. Without elements the favorite is applied to every element of its type that matches it; an element of elements that does not match it gets a failed execution result. Only with favorite.

applySettings.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's settings-type parameters (structure, materials, pens, etc.). Geometry (position, floor, and dimensions such as a Wall's height) is never applied - the element stays on its own home story - except that a Window or Door takes the Favorite's library part and parameters, size included, while keeping its wall, marker and placement. For the hierarchical types (Stair, Railing, Curtain Wall) the settings of the sub-elements are not applied, because they are inseparable from the Favorite's own geometry. A Dimension's text size, text pen and text frame are not changed (tested in Archicad 28): the dimension creation commands take textHeight, textPen and textFrame for them. Default is true.

applyClassifications.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's classifications. Default is true.

applyCategories.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's element categories (e.g. IFC categories). Default is true.

applyProperties.description: Whether to apply the Favorite's property values. Default is true.

keepFields.description: Fields of the target element to keep: after the Favorite has been applied, they are copied back from the target as it was before, so only the Favorite's other settings (e.g. its library part or wall type) take effect. 'id' and 'layerIndex' apply to every element type; 'width', 'height' and 'sillHeight' to a Window or Door ('width' and 'height' also to a Skylight); 'height', 'topOffset' and 'relativeTopStory' to a Wall or Column; 'referenceLineLocation' to a Wall. A field the target's type does not have is ignored. To keep a Wall's or Column's top exactly as it was, keep 'height', 'relativeTopStory' and 'topOffset' together - a kept 'height' alone is recomputed by Archicad while the Favorite's relativeTopStory links the top to a story. Default: nothing is kept.

floorInd.description: The identifier of the floor. Optional parameter, by default the current floor is used.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the arc on. Optional parameter, by default the current layer is used.

begAngle.description: Beginning angle of the arc in radians.

endAngle.description: End angle of the arc in radians.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line? Optional, defaults to false.

linePenIndex.description: Optional pen index. By default the current pen is used.

angle.description: 0.0, or the angle of the 'a' axis in radians.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line?

textHeight.description: Optional height of the dimension texts in millimeters (paper size), applied to every witness point (on creation after favoriteName).

textPen.description: Optional pen index of the dimension texts, applied to every witness point (on creation after favoriteName).

textFrame.description: Optional frame around the dimension texts (true: framed, false: not framed), applied to every witness point. Without it a new dimension gets the Dimension tool's setting.

defaultWitnessVal.description: Optional value that goes with the witness line form, in meters (for Fix the length of the witness lines), applied to every witness point.

Its settings are applied first, then the command sets the geometry and its usual text placement. The favorite's text size, text pen and text frame are not applied (tested in Archicad 28): use textHeight, textPen and textFrame for the texts. The Dimension tool defaults are left as they were.

sectionElementIds.description: A list of section elements whose preset points are merged into one continuous dimension chain. Only one of sectionElementId and sectionElementIds can be given.

preset.description: OpeningEdges puts fixed points, not associated ones, at the edges of an Opening tool element as the section draws it: left and right for a horizontal direction, bottom and top for a vertical one. Archicad does not associate dimensions with openings in sections.

textPen.description: Optional pen index of the dimension texts, applied to every witness point (on creation after favoriteName).

elevationOrigin.description: Optional level an Elevation dimension measures from. A new dimension gets the one of favoriteName or the Dimension tool defaults without it.

defaultWitnessForm.description: Optional witness line form, as in the Dimension Settings, applied to every witness point.

defaultWitnessVal.description: Optional value that goes with the witness line form, in meters (for Fix the length of the witness lines), applied to every witness point.

AssociativeWitnessPoint.description: A witness point of a dimension. Give elementId (with line, inIndex, special, nodeType, nodeStatus and nodeId as needed) for a point associated with an element, or only coordinate for a static point that is not associated with any element, like a point added by hand on empty space. elementId together with coordinate gives an associative point at that location on the element.

coordinate.description: Without elementId: the position of a static (non-associative) witness point; the other fields are ignored for a static point. With elementId: the location of the associative point on the referenced element (written to its base location), e.g. where the dimension line crosses a long or oblique wall face; without it Archicad chooses the point, e.g. the middle of a wall edge. Whether Archicad keeps this location for every kind of base (edges with line true, or only hotspots) is not verified.

classificationId.description: The classification to set. The item replaces the attribute's current item in the same classification system. If the classificationItemId field is omitted, the attribute becomes unclassified in the given system.

classificationIds.description: The classification of the attribute in every classification system it is classified in.

AttributeCreationInfo.description: How, from where, by whom and when the attribute was created. Available from Archicad 30, and only for an attribute Archicad keeps a creation record of: legacy or imported attributes may have none, and then the field is left out. Any of the texts may be empty.

methodDescription.description: Human-readable description of the creation method.

source.description: Human-readable origin, for example the name of the file or Add-On the attribute came from.

creatorUserName.description: The Teamwork user name, or the OS login name in a solo project, at the time of creation.

creationTime.description: The creation time of the attribute, in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC (a GSTime), the same scale as modificationTime.

AttributeCreationMethod.description: The creation method or workflow: AddOn (created by an Add-On), Merge (merging files), Paste (pasting from another file), New (created by the user through the UI), Import (an attribute file, IFC, DWG/DXF or another supported format), Explode (exploding a PDF or DWG), Duplicate (duplicating an attribute), Hotlink (a hotlinked file), XRef (a file attached in the Xref manager), Library (a library part), LibraryMaster (generated from GDL) or Unspecified.

AttributeFolder.description: An attribute folder, identified by the type of the attributes it holds and its path from the root folder of that type. Attribute folders exist from Archicad 26.

path.description: The names of the folders from the root folder down to this folder, the root folder itself not included. An empty array is the root folder.
The names of the folders from the root folder down to the folder to rename, the root folder itself not included.

newName.description: The new name of the folder.

index.description: Index of the attribute.

name.description: Name of the attribute.

folderPath.description: The names of the attribute folders from the root folder of the attribute type down to the folder holding the attribute, the root folder itself not included. An empty array is the root folder. Attribute folders exist from Archicad 26, so before that the array is always empty. GetAttributesByType always returns it; GetAttributesFromProject, which reads another file, does not.

modificationTime.description: The last modification time of the attribute, in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC (a GSTime), the same stamp the Attribute Manager writes as ModiTime into its XML export.

AttributeHeadersOrError.description: The response of the GetAttributesByType command or an error.

AttributeHeadersWrapper.description: The response of the GetAttributesByType command.

AttributeIdOrError.description: An attribute identifier or an error.

AttributeIdsOrErrors.description: A list of attribute identifiers or errors.

attributes.description: One item per imported (or, with dryRun, importable) attribute of the source file.

attributeIndexes.description: One item per requested attribute type, in the order of attributeTypes.

AttributePropertyDefinitionFilter.description: Which property definitions to return: the user defined (custom) ones, the fundamental built-in ones, or all of them.

AttributePropertyValue.description: A property value with the identifiers of the property and its owner attribute.

AttributePropertyValueStatus.description: A property value with its status, returned when includeStatus is true.

propertyValue.description: Missing when the value is not available or not evaluated.

isAvailable.description: Whether the property definition is available for the attribute.

isEditable.description: Whether the value of the property is editable for the attribute.

isVisible.description: Whether the property definition is visible for the attribute.

AttributePropertyValues.description: A list of attribute property values.

attributeId.description: The attribute to move.

newIndex.description: The index the attribute gets. It must not be used by another attribute of the type.

attributeId.description: The attribute at its new index. Archicad cannot renumber an attribute in place, so this is a new attribute with a new id; with dryRun it is the attribute's current id.

placeholders.description: The number of temporary attributes needed for the free indices below newIndex.

elements.description: The elements that refer to the attribute, in the floor plan and in every section, elevation, interior elevation, detail, worksheet, 3D document, layout and master layout: in their own fields, their library part parameters or their memo data (side surfaces, roof levels, morph faces, cutting planes). Rewritten to the new index unless dryRun is true.

hotlinkElements.description: Elements from hotlinked modules that refer to the attribute. They cannot be changed and keep the old index until their module file is reindexed.

toolDefaults.description: The element types whose tool default refers to the attribute. Rewritten unless dryRun is true.

favorites.description: The names of the Favorites that refer to the attribute. Rewritten unless dryRun is true.

attributes.description: The other attributes that refer to the attribute: composites (skins and separators), building materials (cut fill, cut surface), surfaces (hatching fill), MEP systems (fill) and profiles (skins and edges). Rewritten unless dryRun is true.

overrideRules.description: The names of the graphic override rules that refer to the attribute. Rewritten unless dryRun is true.

layersShown.description: The hidden or locked layers of the elements that were shown and unlocked for the move and put back afterwards. Not present with dryRun.

warnings.description: What keeps the old index or did not work after the attribute was moved: elements from hotlinked modules, a tool default, Favorite, attribute or rule that could not be written, the name or the attribute folder.

newName.description: The new name of the attribute. It must not be empty or the name of another attribute of the same type.

attributeId.description: The deleted attribute (with dryRun, the attribute that would be deleted).

replacementAttributeId.description: The attribute that took its place.

wouldDelete.description: Only on a dry run: the attribute and its replacement passed the checks, and a real run would delete the attribute and rewrite the references listed here to the replacement.

elements.description: The elements that referred to the deleted attribute, in the floor plan and in every section, elevation, interior elevation, detail, worksheet, 3D document, layout and master layout: in their own fields, their library part parameters or their memo data (side surfaces, roof levels, morph faces, cutting planes). They refer to the replacement now, unless dryRun is true.

hotlinkElements.description: Elements from hotlinked modules that refer to the deleted attribute. They cannot be changed; replace the attribute in their module file.

toolDefaults.description: The element types whose tool default referred to the deleted attribute. Rewritten unless dryRun is true.

favorites.description: The names of the Favorites that referred to the deleted attribute. Rewritten unless dryRun is true.

attributes.description: The other attributes that referred to the deleted attribute: composites (skins and separators), building materials (cut fill, cut surface), surfaces (hatching fill), MEP systems (fill) and profiles (skins and edges). Rewritten unless dryRun is true.

overrideRules.description: The names of the graphic override rules that referred to the deleted attribute. Rewritten unless dryRun is true.

layersShown.description: The hidden or locked layers of the elements that were shown and unlocked for the change and put back afterwards. Not present with dryRun.

warnings.description: What still refers to the deleted attribute: elements from hotlinked modules, a tool default, Favorite, attribute or rule that could not be written. What could not be rewritten to the replacement keeps a copy of the deleted attribute, whose attribute id the last warning names.

count.description: The number of attributes of the type.

firstIndex.description: The index of the first valid attribute of the type, as Archicad reports it. Left out when the type has no attribute.

lastIndex.description: The highest index in use. Left out when the type has no attribute.

freeIndexes.description: The indexes between firstIndex and lastIndex that no attribute uses, for example those of deleted attributes, in ascending order. Archicad 29 gives a new Layer the lowest free index.

name.description: The autotext's display name, as shown in the Insert Autotext dialog of Archicad.

AutoTextNameOrError.description: The display name of one autotext key, or an error.

AutoTextNamesOrErrors.description: One result per input key, in the same order.

referencePosition.description: Reference point to automatically find zone.

AvailableLibraryPartType.description: The kind of the library part file: a GDL object, an image, a text file, a binary list criteria file or other. Available from Archicad 28; missing when it cannot be read.

AxonometricProjectionParameters.description: The parameters of an axonometric projection. Present only when isPersp is false.

azimuth.description: The camera azimuth in degrees, the Azimuth of the 3D Projection Settings dialog: for a side view the direction from the model to the camera, counterclockwise from the X axis (270 looks from the south). A predefined axonometry looks from 45 degrees further on.

AxonometryProjectionType.description: The projection type of an axonometric 3D projection, the projMod of the Archicad API. Archicad works out the transformation matrix of every type but Custom from the type and the azimuth. XY is the top view and Bottom the view from below. YZ and XZ are both the side view (an elevation), looking from the azimuth. Frontal, Monometric, Isometric and Dimetric are the predefined axonometries, and FrontalBottom, MonometricBottom, IsometricBottom and DimetricBottom the same seen from below; an Isometric at azimuth 270 is the isometric from the south-east (X axis at -30 degrees, Y at 30, Z at 90). Custom keeps the transformation matrix as given. Parallel cannot be set: Archicad makes it Custom.

nodeStatus.description: Reserved by Archicad for section dimensions (API_Base node_status).

elements.description: The elements to copy.

copies.description: One item for each given element, in the same order.

error.description: Why the element, or some of its copies, could not be made. The copies made before the error are still listed in elements.

elements.description: The 2D elements to copy: Line, PolyLine, Arc, Circle, Spline, Hotspot, Text, Hatch or Label (not associated with an element). Drawings are not copied yet: created from their own data they lose the link to their source view.

targetDatabaseId.description: The database to copy the elements into, e.g. a worksheet, a detail or a layout (see GetDatabases).

offset.description: Optional vector the copies are moved by in the target database. Without it they keep the coordinates of the originals.

elements.description: The new element of each given element, in the same order, or the reason it was not copied.

files.description: The files to copy. Each keeps its file name inside the target folder.

targetFolder.description: Optional. The folder relative to the embedded library to copy the files into, for example 'Office/Doors'. Missing folders are created. By default the root of the embedded library.

overwriteIfExists.description: Optional. When true, an item with the same name in the target folder is replaced. By default false.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to copy, each given by its name or by an element placed from it, with the name of the copy.

librariesReloaded.description: Whether the libraries were reloaded after copying. False when nothing was copied or the reload failed; then the copies are not found by name until the libraries are reloaded.

use.description: Whether the cover fill is shown on the floor plan.

origo.description: Origin of the fill relative to the project origin.

matrix00.description: X component of the primary distortion (direction) vector - the cosine of the fill angle, if not distorted.

origin.description: The origin of the fill relative to the center of the element.

styles.description: The 3D styles to create. Each starts from the current 3D style; only the given fields differ from it.

surfaceRGB.description: Optional color override of the cut and uncut surfaces. Components are in the 0..1 range.

warnings.description: Parameters that were not set, prefixed with the index of the grid element.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

coordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the reference line of the curtain wall on the floor plan. Each pair of consecutive coordinates becomes one straight segment, so two coordinates give a single-segment curtain wall.

zCoordinate.description: Optional Z coordinate (absolute elevation) of the bottom of the curtain wall. When omitted, the base level of the favorite (or of the Curtain Wall tool defaults) relative to the floor is kept.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. When omitted, derived from zCoordinate if that is given, otherwise the current story.

height.description: Optional height of the curtain wall. When omitted, the height of the favorite (or of the Curtain Wall tool defaults) is kept.

primaryPattern.description: Optional column pattern: the sizes of the columns along the segment (the primary grid). When omitted, the pattern of the favorite (or of the tool defaults) is kept.

secondaryPattern.description: Optional row pattern: the sizes of the rows from the bottom up (the secondary grid). When omitted, the pattern of the favorite (or of the tool defaults) is kept.

cells.description: Optional assignment of panel and frame classes to the cells of the pattern unit. The unit repeats along and up the segment, so an assignment applies to every repetition of that cell. A cell not listed here keeps the assignment of the favorite (or of the tool defaults) when the pattern is unchanged, otherwise the assignment of the first default cell.

height.description: The height setting stored on the curtain wall element.

actualHeight.description: The height of the curtain wall as calculated by Archicad (ACAPI_CurtainWall_GetCWHeight). Omitted when Archicad cannot calculate it.

zCoordinate.description: The absolute elevation of the bottom of the curtain wall: its home story's level plus its offset from it (API_CurtainWallType::planeOffset), as CreateCurtainWalls and ModifyCurtainWalls take it.

referenceLine.description: The 2D coordinates of the reference line of the curtain wall on the floor plan, one more than its segments (each pair of consecutive coordinates is one segment), as CreateCurtainWalls and ModifyCurtainWalls take them in coordinates. Empty when Archicad cannot return it.

angle.description: The rotation angle of the curtain wall in radians.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true, Archicad recomputes 'visibility' automatically from the curtain wall's vertical extent.

cutProjectionMode.description: Projection mode of the cut part of the curtain wall on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::cutProjectionMode).

uncutProjectionMode.description: Projection mode of the uncut part (below the cut plane) of the curtain wall on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::uncutProjectionMode).

overheadProjectionMode.description: Projection mode of the overhead part (above the cut plane) of the curtain wall on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::overheadProjectionMode).

cutFillPen.description: Cut fill foreground pen; the building material's pen can be overridden on the element level. Before Archicad 27 always reported as not overridden.

cutFillBackgroundPen.description: Cut fill background pen; the building material's pen can be overridden on the element level. Before Archicad 27 always reported as not overridden.

frameCutLinePen.description: Pen index of the cut part of the frames on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::frameCutLinePen).

frameCutLineTypeId.description: Line type of the cut part of the frames on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::frameCutLineType). Omitted when not set.

panelCutLinePen.description: Pen index of the cut part of the panels on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::panelCutLinePen).

panelCutLineTypeId.description: Line type of the cut part of the panels on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::panelCutLineType). Omitted when not set.

useFrameTypesAttributes.description: The frames use the attributes of their frame types instead of frameCutLinePen/frameCutLineTypeId.

usePanelTypesAttributes.description: The panels use the attributes of their panel types instead of panelCutLinePen/panelCutLineTypeId.

pen.description: The pen index of the curtain wall (API_CurtainWallType::pen).

belowViewLinePen.description: Pen index of the curtain wall's view below the cut plane on the floor plan, the uncut lines (API_CurtainWallType::uncutLinePen).

belowViewLineTypeId.description: Line type of the curtain wall's view below the cut plane on the floor plan, the uncut lines (API_CurtainWallType::uncutLineType). Omitted when not set.

aboveViewLinePen.description: Pen index of the curtain wall's view above the cut plane on the floor plan, the overhead lines (API_CurtainWallType::overheadLinePen).

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type of the curtain wall's view above the cut plane on the floor plan, the overhead lines (API_CurtainWallType::overheadLineType). Omitted when not set.

CurtainWallFrameContourUpdate.description: The contour of the frame, as GetDetailsOfElements returns it. Only the given keys are changed.

homeStoryLevel.description: The absolute level of the curtain wall's home story: the z the other z values of this item are measured from. Add it to them for absolute coordinates.

begCoordinate.description: The start of the frame. Its z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

endCoordinate.description: The end of the frame. Its z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

panelConnectionHole.description: The parameters of the panel connection hole.

d.description: Depth of the panel connection hole.

w.description: Width of the panel connection hole.

frameContour.description: The parameters of the frame contour.

segmentIndex.description: The index of the curtain wall segment to which this frame belongs.

CurtainWallFrameType.description: Enumeration of available curtain wall frame types.

classIndex.description: The frame class (classID) of the frame: 0 to 3 for the built-in classes, 4 and up for the frame classes of the owner curtain wall.

homeStoryLevel.description: The absolute level of the curtain wall's home story: the z the other z values of this item are measured from. Add it to them for absolute coordinates.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the panel polygon. Their z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

isHidden.description: Indicates if the panel is hidden (deleted panels remain in the database).

isDegenerate.description: Indicates if the panel is degenerate. Omitted when Archicad cannot tell.

segmentIndex.description: The index of the curtain wall segment to which this panel belongs.

CurtainWallPattern.description: The column (primary) or row (secondary) pattern of a curtain wall segment: the sizes of the columns/rows of one pattern unit and how the unit is repeated along the segment.

sizes.description: The sizes (widths of the columns or heights of the rows) of the pattern unit in meters, in order from the start of the segment or from the bottom. The unit is repeated to fill the segment.

flexibleIndices.description: Zero-based indices of the columns/rows of the pattern unit that 'BestDivision' may stretch. When omitted, all of them are flexible. Ignored by 'FixedSizes'.

CurtainWallPatternCell.description: The panel and frame classes of one cell of the pattern unit of a curtain wall segment. Panel classes are numbered as Archicad numbers them: 0 is no panel (the cell is left empty), 1 is the first panel class of the curtain wall (as listed in the Curtain Wall Settings, from the favorite or the tool defaults), 2 the second and so on. Frame classes: 0 is no frame (the cell is merged with its neighbour), 1 the Division frame, 2 the Corner frame, 3 the Boundary frame, 4 the first custom frame class of the curtain wall, 5 the second and so on. Fields not given keep the default assignment of the cell.

columnIndex.description: Zero-based column of the cell within the pattern unit, counted from the start of the segment.

rowIndex.description: Zero-based row of the cell within the pattern unit, counted from the bottom.

panelClassIndex.description: The panel class of the cell. 0 leaves the cell without a panel (Archicad keeps a hidden 'deleted panel' subelement there). With a crossing frame it is the class of the left (or lower) half; see rightPanelClassIndex for the other half.

rightPanelClassIndex.description: The panel class of the right (or upper) half of a cell with a crossing frame. Defaults to panelClassIndex.

leftFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the frame on the left edge of the cell (the grid line at the start of the column).

bottomFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the frame on the bottom edge of the cell (the grid line at the bottom of the row).

crossingFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the diagonal frame of the cell. Only used when crossingFrameType is not 'None'.

CurtainWallPatternLogic.description: How the pattern unit fills the segment: 'FixedSizes' keeps the given sizes and repeats the unit, which may leave a partial unit at the end (Archicad: Fixed Size); 'BestDivision' stretches the flexible columns/rows so that whole units fill the segment with the least stretching (Archicad: Best Division).

CurtainWallPatternOrigin.description: Where the pattern unit is anchored on the segment: at its start, centered with a unit starting at the center, centered with a unit centered on the center, or at its end.

begCoordinate.description: The start of the segment's reference line. Its z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

endCoordinate.description: The end of the segment's reference line. Its z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

gridOrigin.description: The origin of the segment's grid. Its z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

gridAngle.description: The angle of the grid in radians.

homeStoryLevel.description: The absolute level of the curtain wall's home story: the z the other z values of this item are measured from. Add it to them for absolute coordinates.

isNegativeArc.description: Indicates if the arc is negative.

coordinates.description: The new 2D coordinates of the reference line of the curtain wall on the floor plan. Each pair of consecutive coordinates is one straight segment, so the number of coordinates must be the current number of segments plus one: the segments can be moved and resized, but not added or removed (a curved segment becomes straight).

zCoordinate.description: The new Z coordinate (absolute elevation) of the bottom of the curtain wall. The home story is derived from it unless floorIndex is given too.

floorIndex.description: The new home story index. On its own it moves the curtain wall to that story, keeping its bottom offset from the story; with zCoordinate it pins the story the bottom elevation is measured from.

height.description: The new height of the curtain wall. It is applied before the other fields and read back: when Archicad does not apply it, the item fails and the curtain wall is left unchanged.

primaryPattern.description: The new column pattern: the sizes of the columns along the segments (the primary grid). Applied to every segment of the curtain wall; the frames and panels are regenerated from it.

secondaryPattern.description: The new row pattern: the sizes of the rows from the bottom up (the secondary grid). Applied to every segment of the curtain wall; the frames and panels are regenerated from it.

cells.description: Assignment of panel and frame classes to the cells of the pattern unit of every segment, as in CreateCurtainWalls. Without a pattern change, a cell not listed here keeps its current assignment; with one, it takes the assignment of the first current cell.

CutPlane.description: Defines a 3D cut plane using the plane equation: pa*x + pb*y + pc*z + pd = 0

pa.description: Coefficient of x in the plane equation. The x coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pb.description: Coefficient of y in the plane equation. The y coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pc.description: Coefficient of z in the plane equation. The z coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pd.description: Constant term in the plane equation, in meters. The distance of the plane from the origin along the normal vector.

databaseId.description: The database to activate. When windowType is omitted, the window type is taken from the database; when both are given, they must match.

storyIndex.description: Story index to activate. Only valid when windowType is 'FloorPlan'. As returned by GetStories.

DatabaseById.description: Selects a database by ID; a window type may also be supplied.

databaseId.description: The database to activate. When windowType is omitted, the window type is taken from the database; when both are given, they must match.

storyIndex.description: Story index to activate. Only valid when windowType is 'FloorPlan'. As returned by GetStories.

DatabaseByWindowType.description: Selects a database by window type; a database ID may also be supplied.

name.description: The name of the database. Missing when the database info cannot be read.

referenceId.description: The reference id of the database. Missing when the database info cannot be read.

DatabaseIdOrError.description: An Archicad database identifier or an error.

DatabaseIdsOrErrors.description: A list of Archicad database identifiers or errors.

Date.description: A date in its string representation as defined in ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD.

categoryValueId.description: Left out when the default has no value in this category.

name.description: The localized name of the value, for display only. Left out when the default has no value in this category.

available.description: Whether the property is available for the tool default of the element type.

visible.description: Whether the property is visible for the tool default of the element type.

attributeId.description: The attribute to delete.

replacementAttributeId.description: The attribute of the same type that replaces it wherever it is used. It must be another attribute than the one to delete.

attributes.description: The attributes to delete, each with the attribute that takes its place, handled in the given order.
One item per requested attribute, in the same order.

executionResults.description: One result for each input folder, in the order of the input. On a dry run a folder that is not the root folder and exists gets wouldDelete; Archicad can still refuse to delete a folder that passes these checks.

One result for each input attribute, in the order of the input. On a dry run an attribute that passes the checks made before deleting (valid attributeType, attribute found) gets wouldDelete; Archicad can still refuse to delete an attribute that passes them.
One result for each input classification item, in the order of the input. On a dry run a classification item that exists gets wouldDelete; Archicad can still refuse to delete one that exists.
One result for each input classification system, in the order of the input. On a dry run a classification system that exists gets wouldDelete; Archicad can still refuse to delete one that exists.

designOptionCombinations.description: The design option combinations to delete.

designOptionSets.description: The design option sets to delete.

electricalCircuits.description: The circuits to remove from their panels.

elementSets.description: The element sets to delete, as returned by CreateElementSets or GetElementSetsOfElements. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On can be deleted. The elements of a deleted set are not deleted.

executionResults.description: One result for each input element set, in the order of the input. On a dry run an element set that exists and was created by the Tapir Add-On gets wouldDelete.

elements.description: The elements to delete. The zones among them are deleted before all the others, so an automatic zone deleted together with its bounding elements is gone before its boundary is. Deleting the boundary of an automatic zone without the zone itself can open Archicad's modal 'No closed polygon found around the clicked point' dialog, which blocks the command until someone clicks it in Archicad.

executionResults.description: One result for each input element, in the order of the input. On a dry run an element that passes every check made before deleting (it exists, its layer is not locked, it is editable) gets wouldDelete; Archicad can still refuse an element that passes them.

embeddedLibraryItems.description: A list of embedded library items to delete.

path.description: The path of the folder to delete, in the format GetFavoriteFolders returns: the folder names from the root down. The root folder cannot be deleted.

recursive.description: Archicad deletes a folder together with everything in it: its Favorites and its subfolders with their Favorites. A folder that is not empty is deleted only if this is true. Default: false.

databases.description: The parent databases whose trace (ghost) record is deleted, as returned by GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId or GetContainingDatabases.

graphicOverrideCombinationIds.description: The graphic override combinations to delete. Their rules are kept.

ruleGroupNames.description: The names of the rule groups to delete.

moveRulesToGroup.description: The name of the rule group the rules of the deleted groups are moved to, so they are kept. Created when no rule group has this name.

deleteRules.description: Delete the rules of the deleted groups too. Without this or moveRulesToGroup, a group that still contains rules is not deleted.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The graphic override rules to delete.

hotlinkNodes.description: The hotlink nodes to delete, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes. Each node is removed together with its placed instances and their elements, as the Hotlink Manager's Delete does; use BreakHotlinkNodes instead to keep the elements. In Teamwork the Hotlink and XRef management has to be reserved first (ReserveHotlinkCacheManagement).

acceptAllElements.description: Accept all creation/deletion/modification of the deleted issue. By default false.

DeleteIssueResult.description: The result of the execution: success, with error when it failed. A dry run also answers dryRun, and wouldDelete when the issue exists.

physicalSystems.description: The physical systems to remove from their system groups. Their member elements are not deleted.

tableId.description: The guid of a preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables (the branch, elbow and transition tables with includeFittingTables): a pipe or circular duct segment table, a branch or elbow table of the Piping or Ventilation domain, or, from Archicad 29, a transition table. Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables are found too, but their rows have no key. Archicad 27: any preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers.

keys.description: The keys of the rows to delete. Segment tables, and the elbow tables of Archicad 28, have a row for each reference id, which is emptied instead. Archicad 27: the indices are those before the call; the rows are deleted from the highest index down.

names.description: The names of the module data to delete; the empty name is the default section.

dryRun.description: If true, nothing is deleted: each execution result says what the deletion would do for that item, from the checks made before deleting (corrupt id, item not found, layout subset, View Map folder that is not empty). Archicad can still refuse an item that passes them: a Project Map item other than an independent worksheet, detail or viewpoint created by the Tapir Add-On, a marker-linked worksheet or detail, or in a Teamwork project an item that is not reserved. Default is false.

names.description: The names of the project data to delete.

projectInfoIds.description: List of project info field ids (autotext keys, as GetProjectInfoFields returns them) to delete. Only custom fields can be deleted. On Archicad 30 a key is matched to the field by its name, so it fails when more than one field has the name; delete such a field by its projectInfoFieldId instead.

projectInfoFieldIds.description: List of fields of the Project Info groups to delete, by the ids GetProjectInfoGroups returns. Available from Archicad 30. Their results follow the results of projectInfoIds.

projectInfoGroups.description: The Project Info groups to delete. A group that contains fixed (built-in) fields cannot be deleted.

propertyIds.description: The identifiers of properties to delete.

executionResults.description: One result for each input property, in the order of the input. On a dry run a property that exists gets wouldDelete; Archicad can still refuse to delete one that exists (for example a built-in property).

propertyGroupIds.description: The identifiers of property groups to delete.

executionResults.description: One result for each input property group, in the order of the input. On a dry run a property group that exists gets wouldDelete; Archicad can still refuse to delete one that exists (for example a built-in group).

DeleteSelectedElementsResult.description: The result of the execution. A real run answers success, with error when it failed; a dry run also answers dryRun, and the elements it would delete.

wouldDelete.description: Only on a dry run that passed the checks: true when at least one element is selected.

elements.description: Only on a dry run: the selected elements (for a marquee, the ones it touches). A real run deletes them, together with the other members of their groups when Suspend Groups is off and the elements linked to them (labels, dimensions, ...).

executionResults.description: One result per attribute, in the input order. On a dry run an attribute that exists gets wouldDelete.
One result per element, aligned with the input. On a dry run an element that exists gets wouldDelete; Archicad can still refuse to delete its user data.

DeletionExecutionResult.description: The result of a deletion for one target. On a dry run a target that passed every check gets wouldDelete instead of being deleted.

name.description: The name of the design option combination.

activeDesignOptions.description: The list of active design options in the combination.

designOptionCombinationId.description: The guid identifier of the design option combination.

name.description: The name of the design option combination.

activeDesignOptions.description: The list of active design options in the combination. Available from Archicad 29.

isEditable.description: Whether the design option combination can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork). Available from Archicad 29.

notEditableError.description: The reason why the design option combination is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

DesignOptionCombinationId.description: The identifier of a design option combination.

DesignOptionCombinationIdOrError.description: A design option combination identifier or an error.

DesignOptionCombinationIdsOrErrors.description: A list of design option combination identifiers or errors.

name.description: The new name of the design option combination.
The name of the design option.

id.description: The string id of the design option.

ownerSetName.description: The name of the owner design option set.

designOptions.description: The design options to turn off in the combination. The other options of the combination are left as they are.

name.description: The name of the design option.

id.description: The string id of the design option.

ownerSetName.description: The name of the owner design option set.

isEditable.description: Whether the design option can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork). Returned by GetDesignOptions.

notEditableError.description: The reason why the design option is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

DesignOptionId.description: The identifier of a design option.

DesignOptionIdOrError.description: A design option identifier or an error.

DesignOptionIdsOrErrors.description: A list of design option identifiers or errors.

DesignOptionLinkType.description: The type of the associated design option.

designOptionId.description: The design option to move within its set.

beforeDesignOptionId.description: The design option of the same set to move it before. When it is not given, the design option is moved to the end of its set.

canMove.description: Whether the element can be moved to another design option or to the main model.

error.description: The reason why the element cannot be moved. Only present when canMove is false.

name.description: The new name of the design option. The name is kept when it is not given.

id.description: The new string id of the design option. The id is kept when it is not given.

DesignOptionSetId.description: The identifier of a design option set.

designOptionSetId.description: The design option set to move.

beforeDesignOptionSetId.description: The design option set to move it before. When it is not given, the set is moved to the end.

name.description: The new name of the design option set.

clipPolygon.description: The boundary of the cut out area, at least 3 points, without repeating the first one.

polygonArcs.description: Optional arcs of the boundary, with indices into clipPolygon.

markerCoordinate.description: Where the marker symbol is placed. Default is the first point of clipPolygon.

angle.description: Rotation of the marker symbol in radians. Default is that of the tool defaults.

name.description: Name of the new viewpoint. Default is that of the tool defaults.

id.description: Reference ID shown in the marker and in the Project Map. A '/' splits it between the two lines of the marker. Default is that of the tool defaults.

floorIndex.description: Story of the marker when it is placed on a floor plan. Default is the current story.

angle.description: The rotation angle (radian) of the marker symbol

clipPolygon.description: The clip polygon of the detail/worksheet

referredView.description: Guid of the referred view. Only if the marker refers to a view.

referredDrawing.description: Guid of the referred drawing. Only if the marker refers to a drawing.

referredPMViewPoint.description: Guid of the referred view point. Only if the marker refers to a view point.

DetailsOfElement.description: Details of an element. When the optional fields filter is given in the input, only the requested fields are present; the required list below applies to unfiltered requests.

elementId.description: The identifier of the element. Returned when elementId is listed in fields, and always when no elements are given.

hotlinkId.description: The hotlink instance this element belongs to. Present only for elements that came in through a placed hotlink; such elements are read-only.

floorPlanPolygons.description: Cut-fill polygons as drawn on the floor plan (wall joins resolved by ArchiCAD). Only collected for construction element types whose floor plan symbol comes from a real cut through the element - walls, columns, beams and their segments, slabs, roofs, shells, meshes, morphs, curtain walls and their segments/panels/frames, stairs and their risers/treads/structures. Absent for every other type, when the element has no cut fill, or when the floor plan database is not accessible.

infoString.description: The element ID (info string) as Archicad shows it. Present only when requested in additionalFields.

compoundInfoString.description: The compound info string of the element, e.g. the summary of its composite or profile, as Archicad shows it. Present only when requested in additionalFields and the element has a non-empty one.

libraryPartUnId.description: The unique ID of the library part the element was placed from. Present only when requested in additionalFields and the element is library part based (e.g. object, lamp, door, window).

creatorToolUnId.description: The unique ID of the tool that created the element. Present only when requested in additionalFields and Archicad reports one for the element.

DimensionAppearance.description: Optional dimension type, as in the Dimension Settings. A new dimension is Linear without it, whatever favoriteName or the Dimension tool defaults say. Elevation gives level marks, e.g. on a vertical chain in a section.

DimensionData.description: Dimension element data including witness points and geometry.

appearance.description: The dimension type, as in the Dimension Settings.

elevationOrigin.description: The level an Elevation dimension measures from (kept for the other types too).

witnessPoints.description: The witness points of the dimension. Besides the geometry each item carries the base element reference as CreateAssociativeDimensions takes it (API_Base: baseElementId, line, inIndex, special, nodeType, nodeStatus, nodeId): read a dimension placed by hand to learn the values an element type needs.

linePen.description: The pen of the dimension and witness lines.

defaultWitnessVal.description: The value that goes with defaultWitnessForm, in meters. For Fix it is the length of the witness lines (the custom witness line length of the Dimension Settings). Each witness point has its own witnessVal.

DimensionDetails.description: The settings of a linear dimension (the Dimension tool), with the names ModifyAssociativeDimensions takes. The witness points are read with GetDimensionData.

appearance.description: The dimension type, as in the Dimension Settings.

elevationOrigin.description: The level an Elevation dimension measures from (kept for the other types too).

dimensionLinePosition.description: A point of the dimension line.

direction.description: The direction of the dimension line.

linePen.description: The pen of the dimension and witness lines.

marker.description: The marker at the witness points. Its size is not returned: the value the API reports did not match the marker size in the Dimension Settings for linear dimensions.

textHeight.description: The text height of the dimension's settings in millimeters. Each witness point keeps its own (GetDimensionData).

textPen.description: The text pen of the dimension's settings. Each witness point keeps its own (GetDimensionData).

textFrame.description: The text frame of the dimension's settings. Each witness point keeps its own (GetDimensionData).

defaultWitnessForm.description: The witness line form of the dimension's settings; each witness point has its own witnessForm.

defaultWitnessVal.description: The value that goes with defaultWitnessForm, in meters. Each witness point has its own witnessVal.

DimensionMarker.description: The marker at the witness points. Its size is not returned: the value the API reports did not match the marker size in the Dimension Settings for linear dimensions.

type.description: The marker type, named after API_MarkerID.

DimensionMarkerType.description: The marker type, named after API_MarkerID.

DimensionMarkerUpdate.description: Optional marker at the witness points; give the type, the pen or both. Its size is not written: the size the API reports did not match the marker size of the Dimension Settings for linear dimensions.

DimensionOrigin.description: The origin a level dimension measures from.

DimensionPreferences.description: The Dimensions page: the dimension standard and the format (unit, decimals, extra accuracy and zero handling) of each dimension type.

dimensionStandardIndex.description: The index of the dimension standard the page follows.

radial.description: The format of the radial dimensions.

level.description: The format of the level dimensions.

elevation.description: The format of the elevation dimensions.

doorWindow.description: The format of the door, window and skylight dimensions.

parapet.description: The format of the sill height (parapet) dimensions.

DimensionPreferencesUpdate.description: The Dimensions page: the dimension standard and the format (unit, decimals, extra accuracy and zero handling) of each dimension type.

dimensionStandardIndex.description: The index of the dimension standard the page follows.

radial.description: The format of the radial dimensions.

level.description: The format of the level dimensions.

elevation.description: The format of the elevation dimensions.

doorWindow.description: The format of the door, window and skylight dimensions.

parapet.description: The format of the sill height (parapet) dimensions.

DimensionStandard.description: A dimension standard of the project, as listed in Options > Project Preferences > Dimensions.

index.description: The 1-based index of the dimension standard.

name.description: The name of the dimension standard, as the dimensionStyle of GetViewSettings and SetViewSettings.

DimensionWitnessForm.description: Optional witness line form, as in the Dimension Settings, applied to every witness point.

DimensionWitnessFormOrUnknown.description: The witness line form of the dimension's settings (None, Small, Large or Fix); each witness point has its own witnessForm.

DisplayValueEnumId.description: An enumeration value identifier using the displayed value.

elements.description: At least 3 elements to distribute: Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Morph, Mesh, Zone, Object, Lamp, Stair, Railing, CurtainWall, Line, PolyLine, Arc, Circle, Spline, Hatch, Text or Hotspot, in the current database. Their order does not matter: they are distributed in the order of the middles of their plan bounding boxes along the direction.

direction.description: horizontal distributes the elements along X, vertical along Y. They are not moved in the other direction.

mode.description: centers makes the distances between the middles of the plan bounding boxes equal, gaps makes the empty space between neighbouring bounding boxes equal (the gap is negative, so the boxes overlap, when the elements are wider together than the space between the two outermost elements).

Document3DAttributeOptions.description: The uniform attribute options (cut and uncut surfaces, shading, hidden edges).

shouldUseUniformCutAttributes.description: Use uniform attributes on the cut surfaces.

uniformLineType.description: The index of the uniform line type of the cut surfaces.

uniformFillPen.description: The uniform fill pen of the cut surfaces.

uniformFillBkgPen.description: The uniform fill background pen of the cut surfaces.

uncutSurfaceBkgPen.description: The background pen of the uncut surfaces.

shouldUseElemPen.description: Use a uniform pen for the element contours.

elemPen.description: The uniform pen of the element contours.

shadFillPen.description: The pen of the shadow fill.

shadFill.description: The index of the shadow fill.

shadFillBkgPen.description: The background pen of the shadow fill.

shadContPen.description: The pen of the shadow contours.

hiddenEdgeLineType.description: The index of the line type of the hidden edges.

hiddenEdgeLinePen.description: The pen of the hidden edges.

Document3DBoundaryDisplay.description: How the boundary contours are displayed.

Document3DFilterAndCutSettings.description: Which elements and stories the 3D Document shows (API_3DFilterAndCutSettings). The marquee filter is not included.

allStories.description: Whether all stories are shown; if false, firstStory3D to lastStory3D.

elemTypeFilter.description: Whether each element type is shown. On Set only the listed element types are changed.

Document3DPlanConnection.description: The connection of the 3D Document to the model.

Document3DProjectionSetting.description: The projection of the 3D Document (API_3DProjectionInfo). persp is present when isPersp is true, axono otherwise. Changing isPersp starts the new projection from zero, give persp or axono with it.

camGuid.description: The Camera the projection comes from. Missing when there is none.

actCamSet.description: The active Camera Set. Missing when there is none.

tranmat.description: The 3x4 transformation matrix, row by row.

Document3DSettings.description: The settings of the 3D Document, with the field names of API_DocumentFrom3DType.

cutSetting.description: The 3D cut of the 3D Document (API_3DCutPlanesInfo). The cut planes themselves are not included.

customMater.description: The surface of the cut. Missing when there is none.

hiddenLineType.description: A line type. Missing when there is none.

attributeOptions.description: The uniform attributes of cut and uncut surfaces (API_UniformAttributeOptions). Pens and uniformLineType are indices; the enums fillCutSurfacesWith, uncutSurfaceFillType, hiddenEdgeVisibility and onCutPlaneVisibility are their integer values.

shadFill.description: A fill. Missing when there is none.

hiddenEdgeLineType.description: A line type. Missing when there is none.

docSrc.description: Whether the 3D Document comes from the 3D window or from the floor plan.

skeletonOptions.description: API_SkeletonOptions of a 3D Document made from the floor plan. viewSrc is the integer value of API_ViewSourceID.

boundaryLineType.description: A line type. Missing when there is none.

changes.description: All changes belonging to the given document revision.

DocumentRevisionId.description: The identifier of a document revision.

DrawingAnchorPoint.description: The node of the drawing's bounding box the drawing is placed by (API_DrawingType::anchorPoint). Used only when useOwnOriginAsAnchor is false.

DrawingColorMode.description: How the drawing's pens are output (API_DrawingType::colorMode).

contentBox.description: The full boundary box of the Drawing's content, independent of its frame, as returned by Archicad.

name.description: Custom title name of the new Drawing. Giving a name implies nameType CustomName unless nameType is set explicitly.

nameType.description: Defaults to CustomName when name is given, otherwise to the Drawing tool's current default.

position.description: Where the Drawing is placed on the layout, in meters; this becomes its pos. Without clipPolygon it is the lower left corner of the Drawing (before rotation). With clipPolygon it is the point where the origin of the source view lands (on a floor plan the project origin): a model point (x, y) appears at position + scale * drawing scale * (x, y), rotated by angle, and the clipPolygon chooses which part is shown.

scale.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view (API_DrawingType::ratio). Defaults to 1.0.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians. Defaults to the Drawing tool's current default.

drawingScale.description: Ignored: Archicad takes the scale from the source view (API_DrawingType::drawingScale is output only). GetDetailsOfElements returns the scale the Drawing got.

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing, in model meters. Archicad uses it only with clipPolygon and then adds modelOffset * drawing scale (times scale, rotated by angle) to the new Drawing's pos; without clipPolygon it is ignored. Defaults to the Drawing tool's current default.

clipPolygon.description: Optional polygon to clip the drawing with, in layout coordinates (meters on the layout, the same coordinate system as position) - not the coordinates of the source view's model. Stored as given: position, angle, scale and modelOffset are not applied to it, and it does not move the content (see position).

pos.description: Position of the drawing on the layout, in meters. Without a clip polygon it is the lower left corner of the drawing (before rotation); with one it is where the origin of the source view lands (a modelOffset can move it by modelOffset * drawingScale).

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians.

ratio.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view.

drawingScale.description: The scale of the drawing, taken from its source view (e.g. 0.01 for 1:100).

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing, in model meters. Used only by clipped drawings; Archicad then adds modelOffset * drawingScale (times ratio, rotated by angle) to pos.

isCutWithFrame.description: Whether the drawing is clipped by a custom polygon (see clipPolygon) instead of showing the full auto-fit extent.

bounds.description: Bounds of the drawing on the layout.

clipPolygon.description: Polygon used to clip the drawing view, in layout coordinates (meters on the layout, the same coordinate system as pos and bounds - not the coordinates of the source view's model). Archicad stores it as is; pos, angle, ratio and modelOffset are not applied to it. Present only when isCutWithFrame is true.

navigatorItemId.description: Archicad's internal identifier of this Drawing's link (API_DrawingType::drawingGuid as Archicad reports it). This is NOT the navigator item id of the source view: CreateDrawings passes the source view in this field, but once the Drawing is created Archicad reports its own identifier, which is different for every Drawing (even two Drawings of the same view), is neither the source view nor the Drawing's item in the Layout Book, and is not accepted by navigator commands such as GetViewSettings. To find the source view of a placed Drawing, use the sourceNavigatorItemId of its DrawingItem in the Layout Book tree (GetNavigatorItemTree). Read-only: Archicad has no API to relink a Drawing to a different source (see ChangeDrawingLink).

customName.description: The drawing's custom title name. Present only when nameType is CustomName.

customNumber.description: The drawing's custom title ID. Present only when numberingType is CustomNumber.

isInNumbering.description: Whether the drawing is included in the automatic drawing numbering sequence.

isScaleIncludedInAutotextAndIndex.description: The 'Include scale in Autotext and index' checkbox of Drawing Settings (API_DrawingType::includeInAutoTextsAndIES): whether the drawing's scale is included in the 'Drawing Scale' and 'Original Scale' Autotexts and in indexes.

hasBorderLine.description: Whether the drawing shows a printable border (Drawing Settings > Frame > Add Printable Border).

borderLineTypeIndex.description: Attribute index of the line type of the drawing's border.

borderPenIndex.description: Pen index of the drawing's border.

borderSize.description: Border size of the drawing (API_DrawingType::borderSize), in meters.

penTableIndex.description: Attribute index of the pen set the drawing uses when penTableUsageMode is PenTableIndex (API_DrawingType::penTableIndex).

isTransparentBackground.description: Whether the drawing's background is transparent (API_DrawingType::isTransparentBk).

rasterizeDPI.description: The resolution, in dots per inch, a PDF drawing is rasterized at (API_DrawingType::rasterizeDPI).

useOwnOriginAsAnchor.description: Whether the drawing is placed by its own origin instead of anchorPoint (API_DrawingType::useOwnOrigoAsAnchor).

manualUpdate.description: The Drawing Manager's Update Type: true for Manual, false for Automatic. Read-only.

storedInProject.description: The Drawing Manager's Stored in Project column: whether the drawing's content is stored in the project file. Read-only.

status.description: The Drawing Manager's Status column. Read-only; absent when Archicad could not check the drawing.

linkType.description: The Drawing Manager's Source column: what kind of source the drawing is linked to. Read-only; absent when the link could not be read.

linkPath.description: Path of the drawing's external source file (the Drawing Manager's Path column). Present only when the source is a file (external view, DWG/DXF, PDF, image, ...). Read-only.

titleLibraryPartIndex.description: Library part index of the drawing title (API_DrawingTitle::libInd). A negative/invalid index means no title object is instantiated; setting it to a valid index (e.g. copied from another drawing) makes Archicad create the title's own placed element.

titleElementId.description: Id of the drawing title, itself a placed GDL object element (font/pen/size aside, its own settings are reachable like any other element, e.g. with GetGDLParametersOfElements/SetGDLParametersOfElements). Absent if the drawing has no title object.

DrawingLinkType.description: The kind of source a drawing is linked to (the Drawing Manager's Source column): a view of this project (InternalView), a view of another Archicad project file (ExternalView), a drawing file, a DWG/DXF file, a PDF, an image, a PlotMaker file, an Add-On generated drawing, or an unknown/other source.

DrawingNameType.description: How the drawing's title name is assembled (Identification tabpage of the Drawing Settings dialog).

begC.description: The start point of the line, in layout coordinates.

endC.description: The end point of the line, in layout coordinates.

penIndex.description: The index of the pen of the line.

lineTypeIndex.description: The index of the line type of the line.

DrawingNumberingType.description: How the drawing's title ID is assigned (Identification tabpage of the Drawing Settings dialog).

DrawingPenTableUsageMode.description: Which pen table the drawing uses (API_DrawingType::penTableUsageMode): its own, the one of the model, or the pen set given by penTableIndex.

pen.description: The pen index of the primitive.

lineType.description: Line, Arc, PLine, Tri and Poly: the line type.

determination.description: How the type of the line or fill is determined (origin, inner line, contour line).

loc.description: Point: the location. Text: the left baseline position.

nArcs.description: The number of curved segments. Their geometry is not returned.

polygons.description: Poly: the sub polygons, the first one is the outline, the others are holes.

destBox.description: Pict: the bounding box of the picture.

referencedElement.description: Ctrl_ElementRef: the element the item refers to. The drawing of a Wall ends with one such item for each Window and Door in it.

drwIndex.description: The drawing order index of the referenced element.

DrawingPrimitiveType.description: The API_PrimTypeID name without its API_Prim prefix and ID suffix.

DrawingSettings.description: Modifiable settings for a Drawing element placed on a layout.

pos.description: Position of the drawing on the layout, in meters. Without a clip polygon it is the lower left corner of the drawing (before rotation); with one it is where the origin of the source view lands (a modelOffset can move it by modelOffset * drawingScale).

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians.

ratio.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view.

drawingScale.description: The nominal scale of the drawing. Archicad may keep the existing value of a placed Drawing; the element's execution result is then a failure that names the value kept, although the other settings given were applied.

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing, in model meters. Used only by clipped drawings; Archicad then adds modelOffset * drawingScale (times ratio, rotated by angle) to pos.

isCutWithFrame.description: Whether the drawing is clipped by a custom polygon. Set to false to clear an existing crop and restore the drawing's full auto-fit extent. Only consulted when no clipPolygon is supplied in the same call - supplying a clipPolygon always enables clipping. Setting it to true without a clipPolygon merely re-enables the clip polygon already stored on the Drawing.

clipPolygon.description: Polygon used to clip the drawing view, in layout coordinates (meters on the layout, the same coordinate system as pos and bounds - not the coordinates of the source view's model). It is stored as given: pos, angle, ratio and modelOffset are not applied to it, so a polygon taken from the model must be transformed to the layout first. At least 3 points. Setting this also enables polygon clipping (isCutWithFrame becomes true); to remove clipping, set isCutWithFrame to false instead.

customName.description: The drawing's custom title name. Only used when nameType is CustomName.

customNumber.description: The drawing's custom title ID. Only used when numberingType is CustomNumber.

isInNumbering.description: Whether the drawing is included in the automatic drawing numbering sequence.

isScaleIncludedInAutotextAndIndex.description: The 'Include scale in Autotext and index' checkbox of Drawing Settings (API_DrawingType::includeInAutoTextsAndIES): whether the drawing's scale is included in the 'Drawing Scale' and 'Original Scale' Autotexts and in indexes. Set it to false on e.g. a 1:1 schedule drawing placed next to a 1:200 plan so that the layout's scale Autotext shows only 1:200.

hasBorderLine.description: Whether the drawing shows a printable border (Drawing Settings > Frame > Add Printable Border).

borderLineTypeIndex.description: Attribute index of the line type of the drawing's border.

borderPenIndex.description: Pen index of the drawing's border.

borderSize.description: Border size of the drawing (API_DrawingType::borderSize), in meters.

titleLibraryPartIndex.description: Library part index of the drawing title (API_DrawingTitle::libInd). A negative/invalid index means no title object is instantiated; setting it to a valid index (e.g. copied from another drawing) makes Archicad create the title's own placed element.

penTableIndex.description: Attribute index of the pen set the drawing uses (API_DrawingType::penTableIndex). Archicad uses it only when penTableUsageMode is PenTableIndex; give both to switch the drawing to a pen set.

isTransparentBackground.description: Whether the drawing's background is transparent (API_DrawingType::isTransparentBk).

rasterizeDPI.description: The resolution, in dots per inch, a PDF drawing is rasterized at (API_DrawingType::rasterizeDPI).

useOwnOriginAsAnchor.description: Whether the drawing is placed by its own origin instead of anchorPoint (API_DrawingType::useOwnOrigoAsAnchor).

DrawingStatus.description: The Drawing Manager's Status column: UpToDate (OK) when the drawing matches its source, Modified when the source changed since the drawing was last updated, Unknown when the status cannot be determined (e.g. a missing external source).

DryRun.description: If true, the command makes all the checks of a real run and resolves the same targets, with the same errors, but changes nothing in the project and creates no undo step. The response is that of a real run with "dryRun": true added, and says for each target what the real run would do. Default is false.

DryRunFlag.description: Present, and true, only in the response of a dry run (the dryRun input was true): nothing was changed in the project.
