enumerationReference.description: For an enumerated value, the values of the enumeration it refers to (IfcPropertyEnumeration), each as a string. Available from Archicad 28; left out when the property has none.

propertySetName.description: The name of the property set, for example Pset_DoorCommon.

propertyName.description: The name of the property, for example FireRating.

propertySetName.description: The name of the property set, for example Pset_DoorCommon. Custom property set names are also accepted.

propertyName.description: The name of the property, for example FireRating.

type.description: The IFC type of the value, for example IfcLabel, IfcText, IfcIdentifier, IfcBoolean, IfcLogical, IfcInteger, IfcReal or a measure type like IfcThermalTransmittanceMeasure. A type Archicad does not know is rejected.

value.description: The new value of the property. Provide a boolean for IfcBoolean and IfcLogical (IfcLogical also accepts the string Unknown), a number for the numeric types and a string for every other type.

ElementIFCType.description: The IFC type of an element.

ElementIFCTypesOrErrors.description: A list of the IFC types of elements or errors.

ElementIdOrError.description: An element identifier or an error.

ElementIdsOrErrors.description: A list of element identifiers or errors.

infoString.description: The new Element ID, as the Info Box shows it (GetDetailsOfElements returns it as id).

libraryPart.description: The new library part, given by one of name, index or guid. It has to be a placeable library part of the element's type in the loaded libraries.

keepParameters.description: Copies the values of the element's GDL parameters to the parameters of the new library part that have the same name, type and array dimensions; the other parameters get the new part's defaults. Default: true.

keepSize.description: Keeps the size (A and B) of the element; when false, the element gets the new part's default size. Default: true.

ElementLinkData.description: A directional link from one element to another, with the flags stored on it.

fromElementId.description: The element the link starts from.

toElementId.description: The element the link points to.

flags.description: A 32-bit integer stored on the link, free for the script's own use (for example to tell apart the kinds of links it creates). Default is 0.

elementId.description: The element the link points to.

flags.description: The flags stored on the link by LinkElements.

ElementLinkReference.description: A directional link from one element to another.

fromElementId.description: The element the link starts from.

toElementId.description: The element the link points to.

linkByCriteria.description: True when the property objects matching their criteria are linked to the element.

individualLibraryPartIndex.description: The index of the library part of the individually assigned property object, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. 0 when no property object is assigned individually.

individualLibraryPartName.description: The name of the individually assigned library part. Absent when there is none or it cannot be read.

individualLibraryPartGuid.description: The guid of the individually assigned library part, the same as the guid returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Absent when there is none or it cannot be read.

criteriaPropertyObjects.description: The linked property objects whose criteria match the element.

links.description: The links starting from the element.

ElementLinksOrError.description: The links starting from an element, or an error.

elbowParameters.description: The elbow parameters of a routing node (RoutingNode::Modifier::SetElbowDefaultParameters). Archicad 29 or newer.

mirrorAxis.description: The mirror axis: the line through two points on the floor plan.

beginPoint.description: First point of the mirror axis.

endPoint.description: Second point of the mirror axis. Must differ from beginPoint.

copy.description: Optional parameter. If true, a mirrored copy of the element is created and the original is kept. By default it's false.

ElementNotSplit.description: The split line does not cross the element (or only touches one of its ends), so the element was left as it was.

ElementOrGroupId.description: An identifier representing either an Element or a Group.

ElementOrGroupIds.description: A list of element and/or group identifiers.

editable.description: Whether the value of the property can be modified for the element. False for example for read-only properties or expressions with cyclic references.

visible.description: Whether the property is visible for the element.

libraryPartIndex.description: The index of the property object's library part, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

name.description: The name of the library part. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

guid.description: The guid of the library part, the same as the guid returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Absent when the library part cannot be read.

isIndividuallyAssigned.description: True when the property object is assigned to the element individually, false when it is linked by criteria.

propertyObjects.description: The property objects (library parts of the old listing system) of the element, linked to it by criteria or individually. Empty when the element has none.

ElementPropertyValue.description: A property value with the identifiers of the property and its owner element.

valueStatus.description: Value (the default) sets propertyValue. Default removes the element's own value, so the property shows its default value (or its expression) again. UserUndefined sets the value to undefined. propertyValue is not needed and is ignored for Default and UserUndefined.

ElementPropertyValueWithStatus.description: A property value with the identifiers of the property and its owner element.

valueStatus.description: Value (the default) sets propertyValue. Default removes the element's own value, so the property shows its default value (or its expression) again. UserUndefined sets the value to undefined. propertyValue is not needed and is ignored for Default and UserUndefined.

ElementPropertyValues.description: A list of element property values.

ElementQuantities.description: The type-specific quantities of an element. The fields depend on the type of the element.

composites.description: The quantities per building material, in the order Archicad reports them: one item for each skin of a composite or complex profile element, and a single item for a basic element. Empty for Zones and Morphs, for which Archicad reports no skins.

ElementRelationsOrError.description: The type-specific relations of an element or an error. The variant depends on the type of the input element.

ElementReservationState.description: Free: nobody has reserved the element. Editable: the current user has reserved it. Locked: another user has reserved it (see reservedBy).

reservedBy.description: The user who has reserved the element. Left out when the element is free.

owner.description: The Teamwork owner of the element. In Teamwork the owner is the user who has reserved the element, so this is the same user as reservedBy; kept for compatibility. Left out when the element is free.

elements.description: The elements to put into the element set.
The elements of the element set.

ElementSetId.description: The identifier of an element set.

ElementSetUserData.description: The custom data stored with the element set by the add-on that created it.

dataVersion.description: The version of the data, as set by the add-on that created the element set.

platformSign.description: The platform sign of the data, telling the byte order it was written with.

data.description: The raw bytes of the data, Base64 encoded. Empty when the element set has no data.

elementSets.description: The element sets that contain the element. Empty if the element is not part of any element set.

elementSetId.description: The identifier of an element set.

ElementStateId.description: The identifier of the captured state, accepted by GetElementChangesSince and ReleaseElementState. It is only valid in the Archicad session and project it was captured in.

ElementStateType.description: How GetElementChangesSince finds the changed elements between this state and another one. ModificationStamp (the default) compares the modification stamps of the elements, so any change to a tracked element counts. 3DModel compares the 3D model of the elements, so only a change that alters the 3D model counts, and capturing it generates the 3D model of the project. Two states can only be compared when they were captured with the same type. With either type the changes come from Archicad's element difference generator, which tracks the model elements: 2D elements such as texts, labels and hatches can be missing from the result even when they were created, modified or deleted.

surfaces.description: The surfaces of the element as Archicad reports them: one item per surface attribute and building material pair of the element, so an element has as many items as it has distinct pairs (a basic wall with three different surfaces reports three items). Empty when Archicad reports no surface for the element, for example for an element without a 3D model.

surfaceId.description: The surface (material) attribute of the surface. Left out when the surface is not a project attribute, for example one defined by a GDL script.

buildingMaterialId.description: The building material of the part of the element the surface belongs to.

exposedArea.description: The area of the surface that is not covered by any of the covering elements, in square meters.

bodyIndex.description: The index of the body in the element, starting from 0.

polygonIndex.description: The index of the polygon in the body, starting from 0.

polygonId.description: The identifier of the polygon in the 3D model (ModelerAPI::Polygon::GetPolygonId).

surfaceType.description: The surface type of the polygon: the numeric value of API_SurfaceTypeID as ACAPI_Polygon_PolygonId2SurfaceType returns it.

polygons.description: Every polygon of every body of the element's 3D model, generated with separate components. Empty when the element has no 3D model.

bodies.description: The solid bodies of the element's own 3D model, in Archicad's order, or an error for a body without texture information. Empty (or an error item instead) when the element has no solid 3D model of its own (the bodies of a Stair, Railing or Curtain Wall, and of the segments of a Column or Beam, belong to their subelements, which can be given instead).

triangles.description: The triangles covering the polygon of the element, holes excluded, as Archicad triangulates it.

vertices.description: The 2D coordinates of the three vertices of the triangle.

ElementTrims.description: The trims of one element: the roofs and shells trimming it, and the elements it trims.

trimmedBy.description: The roofs and shells trimming this element, with the trim type.

trims.description: The elements this roof or shell trims.

ElementTrimsOrError.description: The trims of one element, or an error.

ElementTypeFloorLayerFilter.description: A server-side element filter. An element matches when its type, its home story and its layer are each among the listed ones; an omitted or empty list does not filter.

name.description: The name of the element type in the language of the running Archicad (for example "Wand" for Wall in German Archicad).

ElementURLReference.title: URLReference
ElementURLReference.description: The web link of an element.

url.description: The URL of the link, e.g. https://www.graphisoft.com.

description.description: The description of the link, e.g. GRAPHISOFT Home Page.

url.description: The URL of the link, e.g. https://www.graphisoft.com. At most 511 bytes in UTF-8.

description.description: The description of the link, e.g. GRAPHISOFT Home Page. At most 255 bytes in UTF-8. Empty when omitted.

userData.description: The key-value pairs stored on the element.

value.description: The stored value.

userData.description: The key-value pairs to store on the element. A key that already exists on the element gets the new value; other keys are left as they are.

keysToDelete.description: The keys to remove from the element. A key the element does not hold is ignored.

markerParameters.description: The marker parameters to change, each given by name or by index. The other marker parameters and the opening's own settings are left as they are.

ElementsByIFCIds.description: A list of elements identified by their IFC identifiers or errors.

elements.description: A list of element identifiers having the given IFC identifier. If the given IFC identifier is an external identifier, the list can contain multiple elements as the IFC can be placed multiple times.

ElementsOfDesignOptionOrError.description: The elements of the design option or an error.

ElementsWithExecutionResults.description: The response of the GetElementsByType command.

ElementsWithExecutionResultsOrError.description: The response of the GetElementsByType command or an error.

ElementsWrapper.description: A list of elements wrapped in an object.

ElementsWrapperOrError.description: A list of elements or an error.

elementsWithElevations.description: The elements with elevation offset pairs.

elevation.description: The vertical offset in meters to move the element by, like Edit > Move > Elevate. A positive value moves the element up, a negative value moves it down. The home story of the element does not change.

copy.description: Optional parameter. If true, then a copy of the element will be elevated. By default it's false.

id.description: The reference ID shown in the elevation marker and in the Project Map. Without it the elevation takes the ID of the Elevation tool defaults.

path.description: The absolute path of the file to copy.
The relative path of the library item inside the embedded library, the same path AddFilesToEmbeddedLibrary takes as outputPath.

EndpointConnections.description: The connections of a wall, beam or beam segment.

connectedToBeginPoint.description: Elements connected to the beginning point of the element.

connectedToEndPoint.description: Elements connected to the end point of the element.

connectedWithReferenceLineToEndPoints.description: Elements connected with their reference line to the beginning or end point of the element.

connectedToReferenceLine.description: Elements connected to the reference line of the element, not at its endpoints.

crossingReferenceLine.description: Elements whose reference line intersects the reference line of the element.

guid.description: The identifier of the enumeration value, as reported by GetAllProperties. An element's stored value refers to the value by this.

nonLocalizedValue.description: Nonlocalized value of the enumeration if there is one.

EnumValueId.description: The identifier of a property enumeration value.

EnumValueIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the identifier of a property enumeration value.

EnumValueToAdd.description: Text values for an enumeration option to add.

nonLocalizedValue.description: Nonlocalized value of the enumeration if there is one.

EnumValuesToAdd.description: Enumeration values to add to a property.

path.description: Absolute path on the AC host. With the prefs format: if extension matches the Favorite binary format (.prefs), writes a single file; otherwise treats as folder. With the xml format: the folder to write the Favorite files to. With the legacyPRF format: the .prf file to write.

overwrite.description: Optional, true by default: an existing file is overwritten. false refuses to export when a file already exists at path, and writes nothing. It needs an export to a single file (prefs format with a .prefs path, or legacyPRF format); with an export to a folder it is an error, as the names of the files written there are Archicad's.

issues.description: Leave it empty to export all issues.

exportPath.description: The os path to the bcf file, including it's name. An existing file is overwritten, unless overwrite is false.

overwrite.description: Optional, true by default. false refuses to export when a file already exists at exportPath, and writes nothing.

useExternalId.description: Use external IFC ID or Archicad IFC ID as referenced in BCF topics.

alignBySurveyPoint.description: Align BCF views by Archicad Survey Point or Archicad Project Origin.

ExpressionDefaultValue.description: Default value of the property in case of an expression based property value.

FailedExecutionResult.description: The result of a failed execution.

name.description: The name of the Favorite.

folderPath.description: The path of the folder the Favorite is in, as Archicad gives it. Empty for the root folder.

classifications.description: The classifications stored with the Favorite, in the format of GetClassificationsOfElements.

categoryValues.description: The element category values stored with the Favorite, in the format of GetCategoryValuesOfElements.

name.description: The localized name of the value, for display only.

properties.description: The property values stored with the Favorite. Each has propertyValue, in the format of GetPropertyValuesOfElements, or an error when its value cannot be read.

FavoriteDefaultMarker.description: The marker stored with the Favorite, for the element types that have one. Absent when the Favorite has no marker - that is not an error.

libPart.description: The library part of the marker. Absent when it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the marker.

layerIndex.description: The index of the layer the Favorite places its elements on.

elementId.description: The element ID stored with the Favorite. Absent when it is empty.

libPart.description: The library part of the Favorite, for the library part based types (Object, Lamp, Window, Door, Skylight, Zone). Absent otherwise or when it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters stored with the Favorite. Empty for the types without GDL parameters.

subElements.description: The sub-elements stored with the Favorite, for example the frames and panels of a Curtain Wall.

libPart.description: The library part of the sub-element. Absent when it has none or it could not be read.

classifications.description: The classifications the favorite applies, one per classification system.

properties.description: The property values stored in the favorite.

name.description: The name of the Favorite.

folder.description: The folder hierarchy of the Favorite in the file or folder. Empty = root.

path.description: The names of the folders leading from the root to this folder, this folder's name last. Empty for the root folder.

favorites.description: The names of the Favorites directly in this folder.

isDefault.description: True if the value is the default value of the property.

folder.description: The folder hierarchy of the Favorite in the Favorites palette. Empty for the root.

libPart.description: The library part of the Favorite, for the library part based types (Object, Lamp, Window, Door, Skylight, Zone). Absent otherwise or when it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters stored with the Favorite. Empty for the types without GDL parameters.

subElements.description: The sub-elements stored with the Favorite.

FavoritesWrapper.description: The response of the GetFavoritesByType command.

FillAttributeOrError.description: A fill attribute or an error.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing Fill to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

index.description: Index of the existing Fill to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing Fill with the given name will be overwritten.

subType.description: Vector, Solid, Empty, Symbol, LinearGradient, RadialGradient, or Image. Defaults to Vector. Only one Solid and one Empty fill may exist. Image fills use the texture field's name to reference the image library part.

useForWalls.description: This fill can be used for cut fills.

useForDraft.description: This fill can be used for drafting fills.

useForCover.description: This fill can be used for cover fills.

horizontalSpacing.description: The fill's spacing factor in the X direction (Vector fills).

verticalSpacing.description: The fill's spacing factor in the Y direction (Vector fills).

angle.description: The angle of the fill in radians (Vector, Symbol, and gradient fills).

bitPattern.description: 16 hex characters (8 bytes) describing the fill's bitmap pattern, one line of the pattern per byte, matching the Pattern field of the Attribute Manager XML export.

symbolOffset1.description: First offset vector of the repeating symbol motif, X1/Y1 in the Fill Types dialog (Symbol fills only).

symbolOffset2.description: Second offset vector of the repeating symbol motif, X2/Y2 in the Fill Types dialog (Symbol fills only).

percent.description: Translucency percentage [0..1] (gradient and Solid fills). A Solid fill with a percent below 1 is created as a percent fill (like the 25 % fill), 1 makes it a full Solid fill.

texture.description: Used for Image and gradient fills. Only name, rotationAngle, xSize, ySize, mirrorX, and mirrorY are used for Fills.

lineItems.description: Vectorial fill line items (Vector fills only).

symbolLines.description: Line items of the fill's repeating symbol pattern (Symbol fills only).

symbolArcs.description: Arc items of the fill's repeating symbol pattern (Symbol fills only).

symbolHotspots.description: Hotspot coordinates of the fill's repeating symbol pattern (Symbol fills only).

symbolSolidFills.description: Filled polygons of the fill's repeating symbol pattern (Symbol fills only), as GetFills returns them.

frequency.description: The distance between two instances of this item.

direction.description: The angle of the item, measured CCW from the horizontal axis, in radians.

offsetLine.description: The parallel offset of the item, measured from the (rotated) horizontal axis.

offset.description: The offset of the item.

lineLengths.description: Dash-gap length pairs describing this line item. Must contain an even number of items.

angle.description: Arc angle in radians, measured CCW.

FillSymbolSolidFill.description: A filled polygon of a symbol fill's pattern (sfill_SolidFills with sfill_FillCoords, sfill_SubPolys and sfill_PolyArcs), in the same form as other polygons in Tapir: closed contours, the first point repeated at the end of each contour.

subPolygons.description: 1-based index of the last coordinate of each contour (the outline first, then the holes).

Filter3DSettingsUpdate.description: The settings to change, in the form Get3DFilterAndCutSettings returns. Only the given keys are changed.

allStories.description: Whether all stories are shown; if false, firstStory3D to lastStory3D.

elemTypeFilter.description: Whether each element type is shown. On Set only the listed element types are changed.

filters.description: Optional. Archicad's own flag filters. An element is kept only when it fulfills all of them.

layerIndices.description: Optional. An element is kept only when it is on one of these layers (the layerIndex field of GetDetailsOfElements).

floorIndices.description: Optional. An element is kept only when its home story is one of these (the floorIndex field of GetDetailsOfElements).

hotlinkIds.description: Optional. An element is kept only when it came in through one of these placed hotlink instances (the hotlinkId field of GetDetailsOfElements, elements of type Hotlink).

name.description: The name of the dimension standard.

dimensionStandardId.description: The guid of the dimension standard.

nameContains.description: Optional. Only library parts whose name contains this text, ignoring case.

firstOnly.description: Optional. When true, only the first matching library part is returned. By default false.

libraryParts.description: The matching library parts.

name.description: The name of the model view option combination.

flags.description: The flags of the model view option combination, as Archicad returns them.

accept.description: True to accept the changes made in the hierarchical editing mode (OK), false to discard them (Cancel).

topLevel.description: The top of the floor plan range: elements are shown up to this level.

topLevel.description: The top of the floor plan range: elements are shown up to this level.

absoluteDisplayLimit.description: The absolute display limit from Project Zero in meters: elements set to show on the floor plan down to the absolute display limit are shown down to this level.

fontIndex.description: Index of the font (from 1), as Text and Label fields reference it in fontIndex.

fontName.description: Name of the font as Archicad carries it.

destinationFolder.description: Destination folder for the generated documentation files.

description.description: Informal description of this coordinate reference system.

geodeticDatum.description: Name by which this datum is identified.

verticalDatum.description: Name by which the vertical datum is identified.

mapProjection.description: Name by which the map projection is identified.

mapZone.description: Name by which the map zone, relating to the MapProjection, is identified.

xAxisOrdinate.description: Value along the northing axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system (IfcMapConversion.XAxisOrdinate).

scale.description: Scale to be used, when the units of the CRS are not identical to the units of the engineering coordinate system (IfcMapConversion.Scale).

crsName.description: Name by which the coordinate reference system is identified.

description.description: Informal description of this coordinate reference system.

geodeticDatum.description: Name by which this datum is identified.

verticalDatum.description: Name by which the vertical datum is identified.

mapProjection.description: Name by which the map projection is identified.

mapZone.description: Name by which the map zone, relating to the MapProjection, is identified.

xAxisAbscissa.description: Value along the easting axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system (IfcMapConversion.XAxisAbscissa).

xAxisOrdinate.description: Value along the northing axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system (IfcMapConversion.XAxisOrdinate).

scale.description: Scale to be used, when the units of the CRS are not identical to the units of the engineering coordinate system (IfcMapConversion.Scale).

isCutPlanes.description: Whether the 3D cut planes are switched on.

useCustom.description: Whether the custom cut settings are used.

cutPlanes.description: The cut planes, in the form accepted by Set3DCutPlanes: pa*x + pb*y + pc*z + pd = 0, pd in meters.

cutawayEnabled.description: Whether 3D Cutaway is on in the 3D window.

cuttingPlanesVisible.description: Whether the cutting planes are shown in the 3D window.

navigatorItemId.description: The navigator item of the 3D Document, from the Project Map or the View Map.

geometries3D.description: The 3D geometry of each element, aligned with the input: the solid bodies of its 3D model, or an error.

counts.description: The number of components of each type in the 3D model Archicad currently holds, one item per type, or an error for a type that could not be counted.

isPersp.description: True for a perspective projection, false for an axonometric one.

cameraElementId.description: The Camera element the projection was set from. Missing when the projection does not come from a camera.

activeCameraSetElementId.description: The active Camera Set element. Missing when there is none.

perspective.description: The perspective parameters. Present only when isPersp is true.

names.description: The names of the 3D styles. An empty name means the current 3D style. When omitted, the current 3D style is returned.

styles.description: The details of the 3D styles, in the order of the input names.

styleNames.description: The names of the 3D styles of the project.

currentStyleName.description: The name of the current 3D style, the one the 3D window uses.

hSize.description: The horizontal size of the 3D window in pixels.

vSize.description: The vertical size of the 3D window in pixels.

zoomScaleX.description: The horizontal zoom scale of the 3D projection.

zoomScaleY.description: The vertical zoom scale of the 3D projection.

zoomDispX.description: The horizontal displacement (pan) of the 3D projection.

zoomDispY.description: The vertical displacement (pan) of the 3D projection.

GetActiveGraphicalOverrideCombinationRes.description: The graphic override combination applied to the current window. Empty when the current window has no combination applied.

name.description: The name of the graphic override combination. Missing when the combination cannot be read, e.g. it was deleted.

version.description: Version number in the form of "1.1.1".

viewpointId.description: The add-on viewpoint root or group to list the children of.

viewpoints.description: The details of each given add-on viewpoint item, in the order of the input, or an error for an item that cannot be read.

key.description: The autotext's key. To embed it in the content of a Text or Label element, surround it with '<' and '>'.

value.description: The autotext's current value, as Archicad resolves it without an element context.

classificationSystems.description: The classification systems of the project.

groups.description: The groups to get all the elements of.

elementsOfGroups.description: All the elements of each given group, including the elements of its nested groups, or an error.

elementType.description: Only the Favorites of this element type are returned. Omit it to get every Favorite.

properties.description: Returns only the definitions of these properties. Identifiers not found in the project are left out of the response. All properties are returned when omitted.

propertyTypes.description: Returns only the properties of these types. All types are returned when omitted.

includeAvailability.description: Adds the availability list (the classification items a custom property is available for) to each custom property. Default is true.

propertyGroups.description: Every property group, including empty ones.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model the geometry is read from. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.

links.description: The link and its geometry for each element, in the order of the input. An element that is not an analytical link, or whose link cannot be got, is represented by an error object.

loadGroupId.description: The identifier of the load group to list the load cases of. Every load case of the project is listed when it is omitted.

loadCases.description: The load cases. A load case that cannot be read is represented by an error object.

loadCombinations.description: The load combinations of the project. A load combination that cannot be read is represented by an error object.

loadGroups.description: The load groups of the project. A load group that cannot be read is represented by an error object.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model the geometry is read from. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.

loads.description: The load of each element, in the order of the input, with its geometry in the Structural Analytical Model and, for an edge or a surface load, its custom data (the curve or contour stored with the element). An element that is not an analytical point, edge or surface load, or whose load cannot be got, is represented by an error object.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; before Archicad 27 it is required.

segmentationCentralAngle.description: When given, surface members are read as segmented surface members (for curved walls), each segment spanning at most this central angle, in radians.

analyticalMembers.description: The analytical member of each element, in the order of the input. An element that is no member of the model, or whose member cannot be read, is represented by an error object.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.

memberPartRefs.description: The member parts to get the geometry of: vertices (BegVertex, EndVertex, CustomVertex) give a node, edges (Edge, RatioEdge, CustomEdge) a curve.

geometries.description: The node or curve of each member part, in the order of the input. A member part the geometry cannot be got for, a surface among them, is represented by an error object.

memberTypesOfElements.description: The analytical member type of each element, in the order of the input. An element the type cannot be got for is represented by an error object.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; before Archicad 27 it is required.

curveMembers.description: The elements of the curve members (beams, columns) of the model.

surfaceMembers.description: The elements of the surface members (walls, slabs, roofs) of the model.

modelCheckTypeId.description: The type identifier of the Structural Analytical Model check.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model of the variation.
The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; before Archicad 27 it is required.
The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.

releases.description: The release of each element, in the order of the input. An element the release cannot be got for is represented by an error object.

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model the geometry is read from. The model of the current view is used when it is omitted; in Archicad 26 it is required.

supports.description: The support and its geometry for each element, in the order of the input. An element that is not an analytical support, or whose support cannot be got, is represented by an error object.

visibilitySettings.description: The Structural Analytical Model visibility settings, with every field.

centerPrompt.description: Prompt for clicking the center of the arc. Single-byte text: the control box takes a char field.
centerPrompt.default: Click the center of the arc

startPrompt.description: Prompt for clicking the start point of the arc, which also sets its radius.
startPrompt.default: Click the start point of the arc

endPrompt.description: Prompt for clicking the end point of the arc. Archicad draws the arc while the cursor moves; the direction the cursor goes around the center decides whether the arc is clockwise.
endPrompt.default: Click the end point of the arc

showRubberArcFeedback.description: If true, also draws the whole circle of the arc while the start and end points are chosen: its radius follows the cursor until the start point is clicked. Drawn in 2D windows only; the 3D window shows Archicad's default feedback.

snapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to for the center and the start point. Archicad's arc input has no snap filter, so the end point snaps as usual. Default: Archicad's usual snapping.

constraint.description: Constrains every click: the center, the start point and the end point. With fromLastPoint the start point is measured from the center (type Distance fixes the radius, type Angle the direction of the start point) and the end point from the start point. Default: no constraint.

cancelled.description: True if the user cancelled the input (Escape); no other field is returned then.

radius.description: The radius of the arc: the distance of the start point from the center in the x-y plane.

startAngle.description: The direction of the start point from the center, in radians from the x axis, counterclockwise, between -pi and pi.

endAngle.description: The direction of the end point from the center, in radians from the x axis, counterclockwise, between -pi and pi.

arcAngle.description: The angle the arc turns through from its start to its end, in radians: positive (up to 2*pi) for a counterclockwise arc, negative (down to -2*pi) for a clockwise one.

clockwise.description: True if the arc was drawn clockwise from its start to its end.

startPoint.description: The start point of the arc, as clicked.

endPoint.description: The end point of the arc: the point of its circle in the direction of the third click (its z is the clicked z).

licenseType.description: The kind of license Archicad runs on, read from protectionMode: Trial, Demo, Education (an education license with or without a key), BIMcloudTeamClient, Start (the Start edition), otherwise Full.

protectionMode.description: The raw protection mode bit mask reported by Archicad (the APIPROT_*_MASK bits of the Archicad API).

licenseFlags.description: The bits set in protectionMode, by name: Site (more licenses), NotForResale, School, PayPerUse, Network (network licensing), Teamwork (Teamwork functionality is on), Education (education key), Start (Start edition), Solo (SOLO edition), LiveSubscription, OEM (Archicad 27 or later), SSA (SSA license, Archicad 25 only), and without a hardware or software key EducationWithoutKey, Demo, Trial and BIMcloudTeamClient.

ssaLevel.description: The highest Software Service Agreement (SSA) level the license has: NoSSA, SSA or Forward. A script needing a level checks that this is at least that level, in this order. Missing in Archicad 25, which cannot report it.

archicadLocation.description: The location of the Archicad executable in the filesystem.

mainVersion.description: The main version of the running Archicad, e.g. 29.

releaseVersion.description: The release (update) version of the running Archicad.

buildNumber.description: The build number of the running Archicad.

caption.description: The caption of the Archicad application window. Missing when Archicad does not report it.

isVisible.description: True when the Archicad application is shown, false when it is hidden.

attributeTypes.description: The attribute types to report the indexes of.

projectFilePath.description: The absolute path of the project or template file (for example .pln or .tpl) to read the attributes from.

attributeTypes.description: The attribute types to read. Layer, Surface, BuildingMaterial and MEPSystem cannot be read from a file that is not open; they get an error item.

autoGroup.description: True if the Auto Group mode is currently on.

isOn.description: True if Auto-Intersection is currently on.

elementId.description: Optional. The element to retrieve context dependent autotext keys for (its own properties, plus the ones common to all element types, e.g. 'Element ID', 'Area'). When omitted, only the property based autotext keys common to all element types are returned. The other autotexts (Project Info, layout, drawing, date, ...) are returned either way.

name.description: The autotext's name, as shown in the Insert Autotext dialog of Archicad.

key.description: The autotext's key. To embed it in the content of a Text or Label element, surround it with '<' and '>', e.g. '<PROJECTNAME>' or '<PROPERTY-69A58F6F-DD3B-478D-B5EF-09A16BD0C548>'.

keys.description: Autotext keys as returned by GetAutoTextKeys or GetProjectInfoFields (without the surrounding '<' and '>'), e.g. 'PROPERTY-69A58F6F-DD3B-478D-B5EF-09A16BD0C548' or 'PROJECTNAME'.

filterByTypeId.description: Optional. Filter by libpart type (matches the value returned by LibPartTypeIdToString).

skippedCount.description: Library parts that ACAPI_LibraryPart_Get failed to read. Non-zero means the inventory is partial.

skippedSample.description: First five failed indices with their ACAPI error code, for diagnostic.

bodyMaterials.description: The bodies of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Building Material. If omitted, every field is returned.

buildingMaterials.description: A list of building materials or errors.

calculatedParametersOfElements.description: The calculated parameters of each given element, in the order of the input, or an error for an element that is not a curtain wall frame, panel, junction or accessory.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the sub-element as Archicad calculated them for its place in the curtain wall.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

displayName.description: The display name of the parameter.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of array (in case of array value).

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of array (in case of array value).

value.description: The value of the parameter.

valueDescription.description: The value description for numeric parameter.

itemDescriptions.description: Per-item text labels for an array-type parameter, one per array element in dim1xdim2 order. Only present when the library part defines them.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for length values.

cameraSets.description: The Camera Sets (camera paths) of the project, each with its cameras.

name.description: The name of the Camera Set, as the navigator shows it.

isActive.description: True for the active Camera Set.

activeCameraElementId.description: The current camera of the set. Missing when the set has none.

cameras.description: The cameras of the set, in the order of the path.

isActiveInPath.description: True when the camera is active in the path of its Camera Set.

perspective.description: The perspective of the camera, in the shape Set3DProjectionSettings accepts as its perspective, so passing it there shows the camera's view in the 3D window.

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

categories.description: The categories to read. Left out: every category of the project.

categoryValuesOfDefaults.description: The category values of the tool defaults of each element type, in the order of the input. A category Archicad cannot read for the type is left out of its list; an invalid element type, or one with none of the requested categories, is represented by an error object.

categories.description: The categories to read. Left out: every category the element has.

categoryValuesOfElements.description: The category values of each element, in the order of the input. A category the element does not have is left out of its list; an element that does not exist or has none of the requested categories (an annotation, for example) is represented by an error object.

classificationItemParents.description: The parent and the system of each given item, in the order of the input. A non-existing item is an error item.

targets.description: The elements, element tool defaults and attributes to check the classification items for.

classificationItemVisibilities.description: One entry per target, in the order of the input. A non-existing element or attribute, or an invalid element type, is represented by an error object.

attributeClassifications.description: Order of the items is the same as in the input. classificationItemId is omitted when the attribute is unclassified in the system. Non-existing attributes or a non-existing classification system are represented by error objects.
The classifications of the attributes, in the order of the input. A non-existing attribute is represented by an error object.

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

elementDefaultClassifications.description: Order of the outer list is that of the given element types, the inner list that of the given classification systems. Invalid element types or non-existing classification systems are represented by error objects.

elementClassifications.description: Order of the ids are the same as in the input. Non-existing elements or non-existing classification systems are represented by error objects.

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

classificationsOfToolDefaults.description: The classifications of the tool defaults of each element type, in the order of the given element types. Invalid element types are represented by error objects.

commands.description: Every command of the Tapir Add-On, in the order of the command reference.

componentsOfElements.description: The components of each element, in the order of the given elements. Each component id carries the element id too, so the items can be passed on to GetPropertyValuesOfElementComponents as they are.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Composite. If omitted, every field is returned.

composites.description: A list of composites or errors.

elements.description: The owner (host) elements whose connected elements are collected, e.g. Walls, Curtain Walls, Stairs or Railings.

connectedElementType.description: The type of the connected elements to collect, e.g. Window or Door for a Wall owner, or a subelement type of a Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing owner.

databases.description: The database of each element, in the order of the input elements. Pass windowType and databaseId to ChangeWindow to open it.

virtualOriginOffset.description: The offset of the origin of the virtual coordinate system from the world origin. Archicad sets it after a project is opened when the model is far from the world origin. Missing when Archicad does not return it for the current window.

userOrigin.description: The user origin of the current database, relative to the origin of the virtual coordinate system. Missing when the current window has none (only floor plan, section, detail and 3D windows have one).

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model of the current view.

layerCombinationId.description: The layer combination in effect in the current window. Missing when the current state of the layers matches no layer combination.

name.description: The name of the layer combination. Missing together with layerCombinationId.

index.description: The attribute index of the current Pen Table, as returned by Archicad.

isPenTableAttribute.description: True if the index refers to an existing Pen Table attribute. When false, attributeId and name are omitted; the pens in effect can not be read with GetPenTables.

name.description: The name of the current Pen Table attribute.

penCount.description: The number of pens in the current Pen Table. Omitted when it can not be read.

GetCurrentToolResult.description: The tool active in the Toolbox, in the form SetCurrentTool accepts. Empty when the active tool makes no element, e.g. the Arrow or the Marquee.

elementType.description: The element type of the tool. Unknown for the tools of add-ons, which classId identifies.

variation.description: The four-character subtype of the tool, e.g. DOOR, SKYL, CRWD, or the signature of a library part subtype registered by an add-on. Missing for the generic tool of the element type.

classId.description: The class id (a guid) of the tool of an add-on, whose elementType is Unknown. Archicad 26 and later.

image.description: The base64 encoded image, in the requested format.

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

scale.description: The denominator of the drawing scale of the current window: 100.0 for 1:100, 20.0 for 1:20. Always 1.0 for layouts.

databaseId.description: The database shown in the current (active) window, the same id GetDatabases and GetContainingDatabases return. Pass it to ChangeWindow to bring this window back. Missing when the window has no database of its own that can be identified, for example a report, a rendering or a custom add-on window. The saved view (View Map item) the window was opened from is not returned: Archicad does not tell which one it was, and several saved views can show the same database.

absoluteBottoms.description: The absolute bottom of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

stretches.description: The custom stretch of the curve member of each element, in the order of the input. An element the stretch cannot be got for is represented by an error object.

cutPolygons.description: The cut of each body of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

types.description: The types of the databases to list. Optional, by default the databases of every type are listed.

descriptorsOfElements.description: The descriptors of each element, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

navigatorItemIds.description: The navigator items of the views (View Map items).

designOptionSetId.description: The guid identifier of the design option set.

name.description: The name of the design option set.

isEditable.description: Whether the design option set can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork).

notEditableError.description: The reason why the design option set is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

designOptions.description: The list of design options in the set.

teamworkId.description: The Teamwork identifier of the project's design options. Present only in Teamwork projects.

elements.description: Optional list of elements to get details for. When omitted, all elements in the current database (optionally filtered by the filter parameter) are used; an empty list returns no details.

fields.description: Optional filter for the fields to return for each element. When omitted, every field is returned. Fields not listed are not computed at all, so listing only what you need skips in particular the floorPlanPolygons extraction, which regenerates each element's 2D drawing primitives and can dominate the execution time of batch reads.

filter.description: Optional server-side filter. Without elements, only the elements matching it are returned. A listed element that does not match it gets an error entry in its place.

additionalFields.description: Optional extra fields to return for each element, on top of the ones selected by fields. None of them is returned unless listed here, so callers that do not give this parameter get the same response as before.

detailsOfElements.description: One entry per input element, in the same order as the input elements array. An element that cannot be read, or that does not match the filter, gets an error entry in its place, so the position of an entry tells which input element it belongs to. Without elements, one entry per element that matches the filter.

enabled.description: Whether the dialog auto close is on: true while Archicad closes the dialogs it would show with their default button instead of waiting for the user. This is the same state SetDialogAutoClose writes.

elements.description: The identifier of the dimension elements.

name.description: Only the dimension standard with this name is returned (case-sensitive). The list is empty when no standard has this name.
The name of a new 3D Document.

refId.description: The reference ID of a new 3D Document.

materialFrom3D.description: Use the surfaces of the 3D model; when false, cMater is used for every element.

cMater.description: The index of the uniform surface (material), used when materialFrom3D is false.

boundaryPen.description: The pen of the boundary contours, used with OverrideContours.

boundaryLineType.description: The index of the line type of the boundary contours, used with OverrideContours.

contentBoxes.description: One item per input element, in the same order: the full content box of the Drawing, or an error.

lines.description: The lines of the grid of the grid-based drawing numbering of the current layout. Only a layout that uses grid-based drawing numbering has such a grid.

drawingPrimitivesOfElements.description: The drawing primitives of each element, in the order of the input elements.

inEditMode.description: True when Archicad is in any hierarchical editing mode (curtain wall, stair, railing, beam, column, MEP elements, etc.). Only returned from Archicad 29.

elements.description: Optional list of electrical circuits.

electricalPanels.description: Optional list of electrical panels whose circuits are returned. When neither elements nor electricalPanels is given, every circuit of every electrical panel of the project is returned.

electricalCircuits.description: The given circuits first, in their order, then the circuits of the given panels, in the order of the panels.

elements.description: Optional list of electrical devices. Every electrical device of the project is returned when it is not given.

electricalDevices.description: The electrical devices, in the order of the given elements.

elements.description: Optional list of electrical panels. Every electrical panel of the project is returned when it is not given.

electricalPanels.description: The electrical panels, in the order of the given elements.

voltage.description: The default voltage of the project.

elementType.description: The type of the element to look for. Only polygonal element types can be searched, for example Slab, Roof, Mesh, Zone or Hatch.

coordinate.description: The point to search at, in the project's coordinates, on the floor plan of the current database.

z.description: Optional. The elevation of the search point, handed to Archicad together with the coordinate. Default is 0; without z a point 1 mm higher is also tried, so an element whose top is at 0 (for example a slab at the story level) is found.

filters.description: Optional. Only an element passing every given filter is found (the same values as FilterElements accepts).

found.description: True when an element of the given type was found at the coordinate.

elementId.description: The identifier of the found element. Absent when nothing was found.

categories.description: The element categories of the project, each with its possible values.

stateId.description: The state to compare from, as returned by CaptureElementState.

toStateId.description: The state to compare to, as returned by CaptureElementState with the same type as stateId. If omitted, the current state of the project is used, so the response lists what changed since stateId was captured.

newElements.description: The elements that exist in the later state but not in the earlier one.

modifiedElements.description: The elements that exist in both states and changed between them.

deletedElements.description: The elements that exist in the earlier state but not in the later one. They cannot be read any more, only their identifiers are known.

elements.description: The elements to search connections among. Only connections between two of these elements are returned.

connections.description: The connected pairs of the given elements. Each pair appears once.

executionResults.description: Aligned with the input array of elements: whether the element was found and taken into the search.

prompt.description: Shown in the control box while Archicad waits for the click. Single-byte text: the box takes a char field. Archicad's main thread waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then.

elementTypes.description: Only an element of one of these types is accepted. A click on empty space or on an element of another type asks for the click again. Default: any element.

snapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to, for example only the points and edges of the element types asked for. Default: Archicad's usual snapping.

constraint.description: Constrains every click, for example to a fixed X coordinate or to a direction. Default: no constraint.

elementId.description: The clicked element. In a section or elevation window it is the model element the section element was cut from.

elementType.description: The type of the clicked element (one of the ElementType values, or Unknown).

position.description: The clicked point in the project's coordinates, as GetPointFromUser returns it.

elementPosition.description: The coordinate of the clicked part of the element (e.g. its node or hotspot), when Archicad gives one for it.

cancelled.description: True when the input was cancelled with Escape; no other field is returned then.

imageType.description: The type of the preview image. Default is 3D.

format.description: The image format. Default is png.

width.description: The width of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

height.description: The height of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

elementSets.description: The element sets to get the data of.
The data of each given element set, or an error.

elementSetsOfElements.description: The element sets that contain each given element, or an error, in the order of the input. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On are examined.

elementTrims.description: One item per queried element, in order. An unknown or deleted element is an error item, so it cannot be mistaken for an element that is simply not trimmed.

elementTypes.description: The element types to get the localized names of.

names.description: The localized name of each element type, aligned with the input, or an error.

keys.description: Optional. Only the pairs with these keys are returned; a key an element does not hold is left out of its pairs. When omitted, every pair stored on each element is returned.

elementUserData.description: One item per element, in the input order: the pairs stored on the element (none when the element holds no user data of Tapir), or an error when the element was not found or its data could not be read.

elementsOfClassificationItems.description: The elements classified with each classification item, aligned with the input, or an error for a non-existing classification item.

layerIndices.description: Optional filter for layer attribute indices.

filters.description: Optional Archicad API element filter flags. Objects that belong to another element (zone stamps, the parts of stairs, railings and curtain walls) are left out unless IncludeSubElemObjects is given, as in GetElementsByType and GetAllElements.

propertyCriteria.description: Optional list of property evaluation criteria. All criteria must match (AND condition).

propertyName.description: Case-insensitive property definition name, as shown in the project's language. An error is returned when it matches no property, or properties in more than one group and propertyGroupName is not given. Prefer propertyId in scripts that must work in any language.

propertyGroupName.description: Case-insensitive property group name, to choose between properties of the same name in different groups.

operator.description: Evaluation operator. Default is 'equals'. hasValue (alias hasAnyValue) matches a property with a value, isUserUndefined (alias isUndefined) one set to undefined by the user, isNotAvailable one that does not apply to the element. isDefault matches a property whose value comes from its default, hasCustomValue one whose value was set on the element (also to undefined). Archicad gives the default status only together with the evaluated value, so isDefault and hasCustomValue take as long as reading the value, also for expression properties.

value.description: Expected value as a string. Required for the comparison operators. For number, integer, length, area, volume and angle properties, equals, notEquals and the range operators compare numbers in internal units (m, m², m³, rad) written with a decimal point, independent of the project's display settings; other properties compare the displayed text, case-insensitively.

countOnly.description: If true, only returns the count of matching elements without listing their GUIDs. Minimizes token usage.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching elements to list. The count is still the total number of matches.

elements.description: List of matching elements.

ifcIds.description: A list of IFC identifiers to get the corresponding elements for. Each one is either an IFC GlobalId (22 characters) or, before Archicad 28, the 36 character GUID form that GetIFCIdsOfElements returns there as ifcId.

elementType.description: Optional. Only elements of this type are returned, still in drawing order. If omitted, every element is returned.

filters.description: Optional. The filters an element must pass to be returned, the same as for GetElementsByType.

databases.description: The databases to list the elements of, each in its own drawing order. If omitted, the current database is used.

groups.description: The groups to get the elements of.

elementsOfGroups.description: The elements directly contained by each given group, or an error.

arcTolerance.description: The largest distance allowed between an arc and the straight segments that replace it when Archicad segments curves for export, in meters.

folderPath.description: The folder to read, the folder names from the root of the Favorites palette down. The Favorites of its subfolders are returned too. Omit it or leave it empty for every Favorite.

favorites.description: The Favorites of the folder and of its subfolders, or an error for a Favorite that could not be read.

favoriteDefaults.description: The element default of each given Favorite, in the order of the input, or an error for a Favorite that could not be read.

favoriteDetails.description: The details of the given favorites, in the order of the input, or an error for a favorite that could not be read.

imageType.description: The type of the preview image. Default is 3D.

format.description: The image format. Default is png.

width.description: The width of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

height.description: The height of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

favoriteSettings.description: The settings of each given Favorite, in the order of the input, or an error for a Favorite that could not be read.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Fill. If omitted, every field is returned. Requesting only the fields you need avoids fetching lineItems/symbolLines/symbolArcs/symbolHotspots, which can be large.

fills.description: A list of fills or errors.

fontNames.description: Names of the fonts to find, as the Text tool's font list shows them and GetDetailsOfElements reports them in fontName, e.g. 'Arial'.

fonts.description: One item per name, in the order given: the font found, or an error when no loaded font has the name.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to read the default GDL parameters of.

gdlParametersOfLibraryParts.description: The default GDL parameters of each given library part, in the order of the input, or an error for a name that no loaded library part has.

globals.description: The GDL parameters, in the format GetGDLParametersOfElements uses. Separators, titles and dictionary parameters have no value here and are left out.

on.description: Whether the ghost story (Trace & Reference) is shown on the floor plan.

showOne.description: Whether the story at storyIndex is the ghost story.

showAbove.description: Whether the story above the current one is the ghost story.

showBelow.description: Whether the story below the current one is the ghost story.

storyIndex.description: The index of the ghost story, as GetStories reports it. Meaningful when showOne is true.

ghostColor.description: The color the ghost story is drawn in.

filter.description: The element types shown in the ghost story. Types without a Tapir element type name (for example MEP or external ones) are left out, so passing this list to SetGhostStorySettings hides them.

graphicOverrideCombinations.description: The graphic override combinations of the project.

graphicOverrideRuleGroups.description: The graphic override rule groups of the project, empty ones included.

graphicOverrideRules.description: The graphic override rules to get, by name.

includeCriterion.description: Also return each rule's criterion as structured conditions ('criterion'), in the shape CreateGraphicOverrideRules and ModifyGraphicOverrideRules take. Default: false.

graphicOverrideRules.description: The rules, or errors, in the order of the input.

includeCriterion.description: Also return each rule's criterion as structured conditions ('criterion'), in the shape CreateGraphicOverrideRules and ModifyGraphicOverrideRules take. Default: false.

graphicOverrideRules.description: The graphic override rules of the project.

styles.description: The graphic override style of each element in the current window, aligned with the input, or an error.

elementId.description: The grid element. The zero GUID for the tool defaults.

variation.description: Four-character variation of the object: 'GREL' for a grid element.

floorIndex.description: Home story index.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index.

pos.description: Insertion point: the start of the grid line.

angle.description: Direction of the grid line in radians.

length.description: Length of the grid line: the GDL parameter AC_Length of the Grid Tool's grid marker, or the object's A size for a library part without it.

xRatio.description: The object's xRatio as stored: its A size with useXYFixSize on, otherwise the A size divided by the library part's own A.

yRatio.description: The object's yRatio as stored, like xRatio for the B size.

useXYFixSize.description: Whether xRatio and yRatio hold the sizes themselves.

level.description: Elevation of the object from its home story.

libraryPartName.description: Localized name of the library part.

parameters.description: GDL parameters, separators left out. Only when requested.

includeParameters.description: Also return the GDL parameters of each grid element. Default false.

groupGuids.description: The identifier of the group that directly contains each given element, or an error for elements that are not part of any group.

elements.description: The elements whose owners are looked up, e.g. Curtain Wall frames or panels, Stair treads or Railing posts.

owners.description: The owner of each element, aligned with the input.

hotlinkNodes.description: The hotlink nodes, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes.

hotlinkDesignOptionTables.description: One item per requested node, in order: the design options of the hotlinked source file and which of them the node shows, or an error.

hotlinks.description: The hotlink nodes (hotlinkNodeId from GetHotlinks) and placed hotlink instances (elementId of a Hotlink element) to read the design option table of.

hotlinkDesignOptionTables.description: The design option tables, in the order of the given hotlinks.

hotlinkOwners.description: The hotlink each element comes from, aligned with the input.

hotlinkInstances.description: The placed hotlink instances: elements of type Hotlink, for example the hotlinkId of an element inside one. Not the nodes GetHotlinks returns.

proxyElementTables.description: One item per requested instance, in order: its proxy elements with the source elements they were made from, or an error.

hotlinks.description: The source files of hotlinks of the project, for example the location of each node GetHotlinks returns.

hotlinkSourceStatuses.description: One item per requested hotlink, in order: the availability of its source file, or an error.

hotspotsOfElements.description: The hotspots of the given library part instances, in the order of the input.

rootGroups.description: The IFC groups (e.g. IfcGroup, IfcZone, IfcSystem) that are not assigned to another group.

childObjects.description: Each IFC object that has objects assigned to it, with those objects.

parentObjects.description: Each IFC object that is assigned to other objects, with those objects.

storedOnly.description: Return only the attributes stored on the elements, not the ones Archicad would generate on IFC export. Used only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27. Default: false.
Return only the classification references stored on the elements, not the ones Archicad would generate on IFC export. Used only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27. Default: false.

translators.description: The IFC export translators of the project, in the order of Archicad's translator list. The first one, which the Archicad API documents as the preview translator, has preview true.

elements.description: Elements to get the IFC story index of. Optional.

project.description: The IfcProject object. Left out when Archicad does not report it.

site.description: The IfcSite object. Left out when Archicad does not report it.

building.description: The IfcBuilding object. Left out when Archicad does not report it.

elements.description: The story of each given element in the IFC model, in the order of the input. Left out when no elements were given.

name.description: Issue name

isTagTextElemVisible.description: The visibility of the attached tag text element

keynoteItems.description: The keynote items to get the autotext tokens for.

foldersInRoot.description: The top-level keynote folders with their content recursively. The technical root folder itself is not included.

itemsInRoot.description: The keynote items located directly in the technical root folder.

memberParts.description: The member parts to get the local coordinate system of.

localCoordinateSystems.description: The local coordinate system of each member part, in the order of the input. A member part the coordinate system cannot be got for is represented by an error object.

elementTypes.description: The element types to get the last 3D default level of.

levels.description: The last 3D default level of each element type, in the order of elementTypes, in meters.

name.description: The name of the last valid library part of the embedded library.

path.description: The path of the file of that library part.

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults are read.

layersOfElementDefaults.description: One item per element type, in the input order: the layer of its tool defaults, or an error when the type is unknown or has no tool defaults.

layerId.description: The layer new elements of this type are placed on.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Layer. If omitted, every field is returned.

layers.description: A list of layers or errors.

masterLayoutDatabaseId.description: The database of the master layout of the layout. Not present for master layouts.

masterNavigatorItemId.description: The Layout Book navigator item of the master layout of the layout. Not present for master layouts.

masterLayoutName.description: The name of the master layout of the layout. Not present for master layouts.

subsetSettings.description: One item per input navigator item, in the same order: the subset's settings with the field names of CreateLayoutSubset, or an error.

transformations.description: The placement transformation of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

libraryParts.description: Library parts to look up, each given by exactly one of name and guid.

libraries.description: One entry per input library part, in the same order.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part, without the file extension (a trailing '.gsm' is accepted too).

elementId.description: Optional. A placed instance of the library part whose parameters are used for drawing the symbol. Without it the default parameters of the library part are used.

gdlContext.description: Optional. The GDL context the 2D symbol is drawn in, the value of the GLOB_CONTEXT GDL global (2 is the floor plan). Default value is 2.

primitives.description: The lines, arcs and polygons of the 2D symbol, in the order Archicad draws them, in the coordinate system of the library part. Other primitives (texts, hotspots, ...) are not returned.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

sectionId.description: The type identifier of the custom section. A four-character code is given as its integer value, the first character in the highest byte (e.g. 'ABCD' is 1094861636).

index.description: Optional. The index of the section among the sections with the same identifier. By default 0.

exists.description: Whether the library part has this custom section.

dataVersion.description: The data version stored with the section. Left out when the section does not exist.

data.description: The content of the section, base64 encoded. Left out when the section does not exist.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to read, each by its name or by its index.

subTypeOf.description: Optional. The name of another loaded library part, e.g. a subtype template. When given, the isInSubTypeOf field of each library part tells whether it is in that subtype.

includeScripts.description: Optional. When true, the interface script and the forward and backward migration scripts are returned too. By default false.

libraryParts.description: The details of each given library part, or an error, in the order of the input. A field is omitted when Archicad cannot return it for that library part.

files.description: The absolute paths of the library part files (.gsm) to read. The files are read without loading them into the libraries of the project.

scripts.description: The scripts to read. All five by default.

password.description: The password of password protected library parts. Reading a script of a protected part without the right password is an error for that file.

files.description: The information of the files in the order of the input, or an error for a file that cannot be read.

libraryParts.description: The library parts, each given by its index or by the path of its file.

identities.description: One item for each given library part, in the same order.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to read the metadata of.
The metadata of each given library part, or an error, in the order of the input.
The library parts to look up.

locations.description: The original location of each given library part, in the order of the input.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to read.
The default parameters of each given library part, in the order of the input, or an error for a library part that could not be read.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

previewPicture.description: The preview picture as a base64 encoded PNG. Left out when the library part has none.

darkPreviewPicture.description: The preview picture for the dark user interface as a base64 encoded PNG. Left out when the library part has none, and before Archicad 29.

gdlPictures.description: The pictures stored in the library part for its GDL scripts, as base64 encoded PNGs, in their stored order.

darkGdlPictures.description: The GDL pictures for the dark user interface, as base64 encoded PNGs. Left out before Archicad 29.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to read, each given by its name or by an element placed from it.

scripts.description: The scripts to read. All five by default.

password.description: The password of password protected library parts. Reading a script of a protected part without the right password is an error for that part.

libraryParts.description: The scripts of the library parts in the order of the input, or an error for a library part that cannot be read.

index.description: The index of a loaded library part, as GetAvailableLibraryParts returns it.

sectionType.description: The four-character code of the section type, as GetLibraryPartSections returns it. A shorter code is padded with spaces.

subIdent.description: The sub-identifier of the section, as GetLibraryPartSections returns it. 0 when not given.

password.description: The password of a protected library part.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to list the sections of.
One item for each given library part, in the same order.
The library parts to get the details of.
The details of the library parts, in the order of the input, or an error for a library part that was not found.

startPrompt.description: Prompt for selecting the line start point.
startPrompt.default: Click the start point of the line

endPrompt.description: Prompt for selecting the line end point.
endPrompt.default: Click the end point of the line

showRubberLineFeedback.description: If true, draws a unit-square rubber feedback around the cursor while input is active.

snapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to, for both points. Default: Archicad's usual snapping.

constraint.description: Constrains the end point, for example to a direction from the start point (type Angle with fromLastPoint). The start point is not constrained. Default: no constraint.

cancelled.description: True if the user cancelled the input (ESC).

startPoint.description: The start point of the line.

endPoint.description: The end point of the line. It is only valid if cancelled is false.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Line. If omitted, every field is returned. Requesting only the fields you need avoids fetching dashItems/lineItems, which can be large.

lines.description: A list of lines or errors.

elements.description: A list of elements, or of element types to read the links of the element defaults of that type.

linkedPropertyObjectsOfElements.description: The property object links of each element or element default, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

elements.description: The elements whose outgoing links are returned.

linksOfElements.description: The links starting from each element, aligned with the input.

objectSetName.description: The name of the lockable object set, as the Archicad API documents it: BuildingMaterials, Cities, Composites, Favorites, FillTypes, LayerSettingsDialog (layers and layer combinations), LineTypes, MarkupStyles, MEPSystems, ModelViewOptions, OperationProfiles, PenTables, Profiles, ProjectInfo, GeoLocation (project location), PreferencesDialog (project preferences and dimension standards), GraphicOverrides (renovation override styles), Surfaces or ZoneCategories. Other names the Archicad API accepts work too.

conflicts.description: The users who hold a reservation on the object set.

includeTree.description: Whether to return the tree of each system: its elements from the root element on, each with the element it is connected to on the way from the root. False when not given.

distributionSystems.description: The distribution systems of the project.

ports.description: The ports in the distribution systems graph (see GetMEPPorts).
