elementDetails.description: The details of the given MEP elements, in the order of the input, or an error for an element that is not an MEP element, and in Archicad 28 for an elbow. A value that cannot be read is left out.

elementTypes.description: Optional filter for the MEP element types.

domains.description: Optional filter for the MEP domains.

elements.description: The MEP elements.

physicalSystemsOfElements.description: The physical systems of each given element, in the order of the elements.

domains.description: The domains whose preference tables to list. Defaults to all three.

items.description: The MEP domain of a preference table container.

containers.description: The preference table container of each domain, in the order of the domains.

tableId.description: The guid of a preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables (the branch, elbow and transition tables with includeFittingTables): a pipe or circular duct segment table, a branch or elbow table of the Piping or Ventilation domain, or, from Archicad 29, a transition table. Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables are found too, but their rows have no key. Archicad 27: any preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers.

keys.description: The keys of the rows to get.

name.description: Archicad 27 only: the name of the table.

sizes.description: Archicad 27 only: the number of rows of each shape.

rows.description: The rows in the order of the keys.

domain.description: The MEP domain of the segment preference tables.

includeFittingTables.description: Also return the elbow, branch and transition preference tables. Defaults to false. Ignored for the CableCarrier domain.

tables.description: The circular segment preference tables of the domain. Empty for the CableCarrier domain.

rectangularTables.description: The rectangular segment preference tables of the Ventilation domain.

cableCarrierTables.description: The segment preference tables of the CableCarrier domain.

referenceSet.description: The reference set of the Piping or Ventilation domain. Not returned for the CableCarrier domain.

elbowTables.description: The elbow preference tables of the domain. Only when includeFittingTables is true.

branchTables.description: The branch preference tables of the domain. Only when includeFittingTables is true.

transitionTables.description: The transition preference tables of the domain. Only when includeFittingTables is true, available from Archicad 29.

elements.description: MEP routing elements, routing nodes or routing segments.

routingParameters.description: The routing parameters of the given elements, in their order.

systemGroups.description: The system groups of the project with their physical systems.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each MEP System. If omitted, every field is returned.

mepSystems.description: A list of MEP systems or errors.

domains.description: The domains to return the tool defaults of. All three when not given.

toolDefaults.description: The tool defaults of each requested domain, in the order requested.

equipment.description: The default of the Equipment tool, which has no domain. Left out when Archicad gives none.

curveApproximation.description: How the Magic Wand approximates curves with straight segments: a fixed number of segments along arcs or along full circles (segmentCount), segments that deviate from the curve by at most maxDeviation, or segments of segmentLength. Unknown for a mode this version of Tapir does not know.

segmentCount.description: The number of segments along an arc or circle, used by SegmentsAlongArcs and SegmentsAlongCircles.

maxDeviation.description: The largest distance of the segments from the curve, in meters, used by DeviationFromCurves.

segmentLength.description: The length of the segments, in meters, used by SegmentLength.

traceMethod.description: How curves are traced: Linear traces them with straight segments as set above, BestMatch with the curves that match them best. Unknown for a method this version of Tapir does not know.

groups.description: The groups to get the top level group of.

mainGroups.description: The top level group of each given group (the group itself if it is not nested in another group), or an error.

markerParametersOfElements.description: The marker of each given element, in the order of the input, or an error for an element that is not a window or a door.

multiStory.description: True for a multi-story (thick) marquee, false for a single-story (thin) one. Absent when there is no marquee.

box.description: The rectangle of a 'rectangle' or 'rotatedRectangle' marquee. For a rotated rectangle it is given as Archicad stores it: in the coordinate system rotated by rotationAngle around the project origin, not around the box itself. Use polygon for the corners on the plan.

rotationAngle.description: The rotation angle (radians) of a 'rotatedRectangle' marquee.

polygon.description: The vertices of the marquee outline on the plan, each listed once: the four corners of a 'rectangle' or 'rotatedRectangle' marquee, the vertices of a 'polygon' marquee.

elementMerges.description: One item per queried element, in order: the elements it is merged with. An unknown or deleted element is an error item, so it cannot be mistaken for an element that is simply not merged.

attributeTypes.description: The attribute types to check. All of them when omitted.

sources.description: What to check: the placed elements (element), the tool default settings (toolDefault), the Favorites (favorite), the graphic override rules (overrideRule), the Model View Options combinations (modelViewOption) and the attributes that refer to other attributes (attribute: composites, building materials, surfaces, MEP systems and profiles). All of them when omitted.

missingAttributes.description: One item per reference to an attribute index that has no attribute in the project: first the placed elements in the order they were found (the floor plan first, then the views and layouts), then the tool defaults, then the Favorites, then the graphic override rules, then the Model View Options combinations, then the attributes that refer to other attributes.

checkedElementCount.description: The number of placed elements checked; 0 when the elements were not checked.

checkedToolDefaultCount.description: The number of tool defaults checked. Missing when the tool defaults were not checked.

checkedFavoriteCount.description: The number of Favorites checked. Missing when the Favorites were not checked.

checkedOverrideRuleCount.description: The number of graphic override rules checked. Missing when the rules were not checked or could not be listed.

checkedModelViewOptionCount.description: The number of Model View Options combinations checked. Missing when they were not checked.

checkedAttributeCount.description: The number of composites, building materials, surfaces, MEP systems and profiles checked for references to other attributes. Missing when they were not checked.

warnings.description: What could not be checked. Missing when everything was checked.

libPartNames.description: The library part name of each given element, in the order of the input, or an error.

modelViewOptions.description: The model view option combinations to read, each given by id or by name. When omitted, every combination of the project is returned.

modelViewOptionDetails.description: The settings of each model view option combination, in the order of the input, or in the order of the project when no input is given.

names.description: The names of the module data to get; the empty name is the default section. When omitted, every module data Tapir stored in the project is returned.

includeContent.description: Whether the content is returned too. When false, only the names and data versions are read, without loading the data. The default is true.

modulData.description: The module data in the order of the given names (or of the list Archicad returns), or an error for a name that has no module data.

name.description: The name of the module data.

dataVersion.description: The version number stored with the data.

content.description: The content of the module data. Left out when includeContent is false.

publisherSetName.description: The name of the publisher set to retrieve. Used only when navigatorMapId is PublisherSets. Without it the first publisher set is returned.

includeChildCount.description: Set to true to add childCount, the number of direct children Archicad reports, to every item. Defaults to false.

parentItems.description: The parent of each requested navigator item, in the order of the input, or an error for an item whose parent cannot be read.

autoTextIds.description: Numeric values of the API_NoteAutotextID enumeration of the Archicad API (the autotexts of dimension, label and other element notes).

keywords.description: One result per input id, in the same order.

noteOwnerType.description: The type of the element that owns the note, e.g. 'Dimension', 'RadialDimension', 'LevelDimension' or 'AngleDimension'.

dimensionAppearance.description: Optional dimension type, as in the Dimension Settings, whose note autotexts are listed when noteOwnerType is 'Dimension'. Defaults to Linear. Not allowed with other owner types.

noteAutotexts.description: The autotexts available in the notes of the given owner type, in ascending order of autotextId.

elements.description: The Opening elements (made with the Opening tool) to read.

openings.description: The details of the openings, in the order of the given elements.

elements.description: The Opening elements (made with the Opening tool) to read.

openings.description: The floor plan parameters of the openings, in the order of the given elements.

elements.description: The Opening elements (made with the Opening tool) to read.

openings.description: The GDL parameters of the floor plan symbols of the openings, in the order of the given elements.

openingTransformations.description: The transformation of each given Opening, or an error, in the order of the input elements.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Pen Table. If omitted, every field is returned. Requesting only the fields you need avoids fetching the 255-element pens array.

penTables.description: A list of pen tables or errors.

indices.description: The indices of the pens to return, from 1 to the number of pens (GetCurrentPenTable returns penCount). If omitted, every pen is returned.

pens.description: The pens in effect in the current window, or errors. The order is that of the given indices.

prompt.description: Shown in the control box while Archicad waits for the click. Single-byte text: the box takes a char field. Archicad's main thread waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then.

snapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to. Default: Archicad's usual snapping.

constraint.description: Constrains the click, for example to a fixed X coordinate or to a direction. Default: no constraint.

position.description: The clicked point in the project's coordinates.

startPrompt.description: Prompt for selecting the polygon start point.
startPrompt.default: Click the start point of the polygon

prompt.description: Prompt shown while placing the remaining polygon nodes.
prompt.default: Click polygon nodes and finish the input

snapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to for the start point. Archicad's polygon input has no snap filter, so the other nodes snap as usual. Default: Archicad's usual snapping.

constraint.description: Constrains the nodes after the start point, for example to a direction from the previous node (type Angle with fromLastPoint). The start point is not constrained. Default: no constraint.

cancelled.description: True if the user cancelled the input (ESC).

printer.description: The printer selected in Archicad, or an error when it cannot be read.

plotter.description: The plotter selected in Archicad, or an error when it cannot be read.

fixText.description: Whether text is printed in fixed size.

productName.description: The name of the product. Archicad 29 or later.

productType.description: The Graphisoft product type. Archicad 29 or later.

productFamilyId.description: The identifier of the product family.

languageCode.description: The Graphisoft language code of the running Archicad (for example INT, GER).

buildNumber.description: The build number of the running Archicad.

versionString.description: The full version of the running Archicad as text.

mainVersion.description: The main version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

updateVersion.description: The update version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

hotfixVersion.description: The hotfix version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

versionNumbers.description: The three parts of the version number. Archicad 28 only.

availableDomains.description: The domains available in the running Archicad. Archicad 29 or later.

ceipProjectId.description: The CEIP project identifier of the open project. Left out when no saved project is open. Archicad 29 or later.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Profile. If omitted, every field is returned. Note the raw cross-section vector geometry itself is not exposed; width/height/minimumWidth/minimumHeight/widthStretchable/heightStretchable/hasCoreSkin/profileModifiers are derived measurements matching what the Profile Editor shows, computed from the profile's internal stretch/parameter data.

profiles.description: A list of profiles or errors.

keys.description: The project data stored by Tapir in the project.

names.description: The names of the project data to get.

values.description: The project data in the order of the given names, or an error for a name that has no project data.

isUntitled.description: True, if the project is not saved yet.

isTeamwork.description: True, if the project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project.

projectLocation.description: The location of the project in the filesystem or a BIMcloud project reference. A BIMcloud project reference is returned without the user name and login token.

projectPath.description: The path of the project. A filesystem path or a BIMcloud server relative path.

architect.description: Architect: the full name of the Project Info contact. Archicad keeps it as name parts (title prefix, given, middle and family name, title suffix); SetProjectNotes puts a new value into the given name and clears the other parts, so it reads back unchanged. Use SetProjectInfoField to set the parts.

draftsmen.description: Draftsmen: the full name of the Project Info CAD technician, kept as name parts like architect.

dateOfIssue.description: Date of issue (free text, as typed in Project Notes).

preferenceTypes.description: The preference pages to get. Every page when missing.

GetProjectPreferencesResult.description: The pages asked for, by name.

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

includeValues.description: Adds the value of each property in the tool default (propertyValue), or an error in its place when it has none. Default is false.

propertiesOfToolDefaults.description: The properties of the tool defaults of each element type, in the order of the given element types. Invalid element types are represented by error objects.

elementType.description: The element type whose current tool default is checked. This is the native tool default, a Favorite counts only after it was applied.

propertyAvailabilities.description: The order is that of the given properties.

propertyDefinitionsOfAttributes.description: The property definitions of each attribute, in the order of the given attributes.

filter.description: Which property definitions to return: the user defined (Custom) ones, the built-in ones, or all. The default is All.

propertyDefinitionsOfElementComponents.description: The property definitions available on each element component, in the order of the given element components. GetAllProperties returns the full details of a property.

elements.description: Checks whether the value of each property can be modified for these elements, and whether each property is visible for them.

elementTypes.description: Checks whether the value of each property can be modified in the tool default of these element types.

propertyDefinitionDefaults.description: When true, checks whether the default value of each property definition can be modified. This is the default value of the property definition itself, not the tool default of an element type.

GetPropertyEditabilityResult.description: Only the lists that were asked for are present.

editabilityOfElements.description: Present when elements were given. The order of the outer list is that of the given elements. The order of the inner lists are that of the given properties.

editabilityOfElementTypeDefaults.description: Present when elementTypes were given. The order of the outer list is that of the given element types. The order of the inner lists are that of the given properties.

editabilityOfPropertyDefinitionDefaults.description: Present when propertyDefinitionDefaults is true. The order is that of the given properties.

editable.description: Whether the default value of the property definition can be modified.

references.description: One item for each property, in the order of the input: its expression reference, or an error.

reference.description: The string that refers to the property in a property expression.

propertyObjectsOfElements.description: The property objects of each element, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

includeStatus.description: If true, each item also tells whether the property is available, editable and visible for the attribute, and a property without an available value is returned with its status and without a value instead of as an error. The default is false.

propertyValuesForAttributes.description: The order of the outer list is that of the given attributes. The order of the inner lists are that of the given properties.

propertyValuesForElementComponents.description: The order of the outer list is that of the given element components. The order of the inner lists are that of the given properties. The items have the shape of GetPropertyValuesOfElements.

elementType.description: The element type whose current tool default is read. This is the native tool default of the generic variation of the type, a Favorite counts only after it was applied.

propertyValues.description: The order is that of the given properties. A property that is not available for the tool default is an error item.

includeAvailability.description: Adds isAvailable to each property value or error, telling whether the property is available for the element (for example by its classification). Default is false.

useSIUnits.description: Returns precise, locale-independent numeric strings in SI units, except degrees for angles. Default is false.

propertyValuesForElements.description: The order of the outer list is that of the given elements. The order of the inner lists are that of the given properties.

publisherSets.description: The publisher sets of the project, in the order of the Publisher Sets map.

name.description: The name of the publisher set.

rootNavigatorItemId.description: The navigator item ID of the root of the publisher set.

path.description: The saved local or LAN output path, when the set is published to files. When it is also uploaded to a Teamwork file server, this is the temporary local path.

twFileServerPath.description: The saved output path on the Teamwork file server, when the set is published to files onto a file server.

host.description: The saved host name, when the set is published to the Internet.

dirName.description: The saved directory name on the host, when the set is published to the Internet.

minOpeningSize.description: Optional minimum opening size in square meters. Openings smaller than this are not subtracted when the conditional values (for example volumeConditional of a Wall) are calculated. Archicad only uses it for walls. Default value is 0, so every opening is subtracted.

calculateInOneCall.description: Optional. When true, Archicad calculates the quantities of all the supported elements in one call instead of one call per element, which can be faster for many elements. The output has the same format. If that one call fails, every supported element gets the same error. Default value is false.

quantitiesOfElements.description: The quantities of the elements, in the order of the given elements. Lengths are in meters, areas in square meters and volumes in cubic meters.

otherElementType.description: Optional filter: only relations to elements of this type are returned.

relations.description: Type-specific relations of each element, aligned with the input.

sceneNames.description: The names of the rendering scenes of the project (the Scene list of the PhotoRendering Settings palette), in the order of recent usage: the most recently used scene, the current one, first.

currentSceneName.description: The name of the current rendering scene, the one selected in the PhotoRendering Settings palette: the first of sceneNames. Left out when the project has no rendering scene.

renovationFilters.description: Every renovation filter of the project.

activeRenovationFilterId.description: Identifier of the renovation filter of the current window. Absent when the current window has none or it could not be read.

renovationStatuses.description: The renovation statuses an element can have, in the order Existing, New, Demolished.

reservationStatuses.description: One item per input element, in the same order.

customScheme.description: The custom scheme fields of the revision issues (key and name). Present only when the project defines any.

roofPlanesOfElements.description: The planes of each roof, aligned with the input, or an error.

planes.description: The single planes of the roof: the planes Archicad decomposes a multi-plane roof into, or the roof itself for a single-plane roof.

partId.description: Archicad's identifier of the plane within the multi-plane roof (API_ElemPartId). Missing for a single-plane roof.

main.description: The main part of Archicad's identifier of the plane (API_ElemPartId main).

sub.description: The sub part of Archicad's identifier of the plane (API_ElemPartId sub).

details.description: The plane as a single-plane roof: slope, pivot line, level and outline.

format.description: The image format. Default is png.

width.description: The width of the preview image in pixels. Default is 256.

height.description: The height of the preview image in pixels. Default is 256.

offset.description: Offset of the clip polygon from the edge of the zone. Default is 0.001.

scale.description: Scale of the view (e.g. 0.005 for 1:200). Default is 0.005.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the generated image. Default is white (1.0, 1.0, 1.0).

schedules.description: The Interactive Schedules of the Project Map, in navigator order.

uiId.description: The window to use, as returned by ShowScriptUI (1 to 8). Takes precedence over scriptId.

scriptId.description: Any text that identifies the calling script, so it uses its own window: ShowScriptUI gives a script without a window a free one, preferring the closed windows. The Tapir palette gives each script it starts its own id in the TAPIR_SCRIPT_ID environment variable, which aclib passes here automatically; that script's window is titled with its name and is freed when it ends. Without uiId and scriptId the first window is used.

uiId.description: The window the result was read from (1 to 8). Missing when scriptId was given and that script has no window.

hasResult.description: True if the Script UI page has submitted a result since the last call.

result.description: The submitted content (as passed to window.ACAPI.SubmitResult). Only present when hasResult is true.

isOpen.description: True while the Script UI palette is open. False before the first ShowScriptUI call and once the user closed the palette with its close box, the page called window.ACAPI.ClosePalette or Archicad closed it; stays true while Archicad only temporarily hides all palettes (e.g. during a modal dialog). Lets a waiting script stop polling when the user closes the palette.

databases.description: The section, elevation or interior elevation databases to list the section elements of. If omitted, the current database is used.

sectionElements.description: The elements drawn in the given databases, each with the owner element it was generated from.

sectionElementId.description: The identifier of the section element itself, accepted by CreateAssociativeDimensionsOnSection as sectionElementId.

ownerElementId.description: The identifier of the owner element the section element was generated from - this is what every other listing command returns.

ownerElementType.description: The type of the owner element. Only present when the owner's header is readable from the section database.

includeMarkers.description: Whether the objects attached to the elements (window and door markers, drawing titles, ...) are drawn with them. When omitted, Archicad's current setting is used. The setting is changed back after the drawing.

shapePrimitivesOfElements.description: The drawing primitives of each element, in the order of the input elements.

skylightHolePolygons.description: The hole each Skylight cuts into its host Roof or Shell, aligned with the input: its polygon, or an error (for example for an element that is not a Skylight).

snapPointsOfElements.description: The snap points (hotspots) of each element, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

snapPoints.description: The snap points (hotspots) of the element: the points Archicad snaps to and dimensions attach to, in world coordinates (meters, absolute Z). Empty when the element has none.

neigId.description: Which kind of point of the element the hotspot is, as the DevKit's API_NeigID enumerator value of its neig (for example the begin or end point of a Wall's reference line, or a vertex of a Slab's polygon).

inIndex.description: Subindex of the point within its kind (API_Neig inIndex), for example the vertex index in the element's polygon.

elements.description: Elements to query. Returns all solid links where each element is a target or an operator.

solidLinks.description: For each input element, the solid links where it acts as target and where it acts as operator.

folderTypes.description: The types of the special folders to retrieve.

splines.description: The spline segments to measure and the coordinates to measure from them.

results.description: The result of each input item, in the same order, or an error.

skipNullFloor.description: Floor indices above ground-floor level may start with 1 instead of 0.

databaseId.description: A section, elevation or interior elevation database, for example as GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId returns it.

primitives.description: The primitives of the story levels drawn in the database, in the order Archicad draws them. The Ctrl_* items mark the beginning and the end of sub-parts (texts, ...).

GetStructureDisplayResult.description: The Partial Structure Display of the current window.

is3D.description: True when the setting belongs to the 3D window.

externalSubelements.description: The subelements of an external hierarchical element (for example an MEP element or an element of another add-on). Available from Archicad 28.

timeZoneInMinutes.description: The time zone of the project location in minutes, as Archicad stores it.

timeZoneOffset.description: The time zone offset of the project location in minutes, as Archicad stores it.

sunPosition.description: The sun position for the project's date, time and location.

elements.description: The elements to get the surface quantities of.

coverElements.description: Optional covering elements: the area where one of them overlaps a surface of an element is subtracted from that surface, so for example a slab on a wall takes its footprint off the top surface of the wall. When omitted, every Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Morph, Mesh, Stair and Curtain Wall of the project is a covering element. Pass an empty array to get the whole surfaces with nothing subtracted. An element never covers itself.

surfaceQuantitiesOfElements.description: The surface quantities of the elements, in the order of the given elements. Areas are in square meters.

surfaceTypes.description: The polygons of the 3D model of each element with their surface types, aligned with the input, or an error.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Surface. If omitted, every field is returned.

surfaces.description: A list of surfaces or errors.

projectToSurvey.description: The 3x4 matrix that transforms a point given in the Project Origin coordinate system into the Survey Point coordinate system, row by row (12 numbers): x' = m[0]*x + m[1]*y + m[2]*z + m[3], y' = m[4]*x + m[5]*y + m[6]*z + m[7], z' = m[8]*x + m[9]*y + m[10]*z + m[11].

surveyToProject.description: The inverse of projectToSurvey in the same row by row layout: it transforms a point given in the Survey Point coordinate system into the Project Origin coordinate system. Missing when projectToSurvey is not invertible.

suspendGroups.description: True if the Suspend Groups mode is currently on.

accessRights.description: The names of the access rights to check, the API_TWAccessRights enumerators without the API prefix, e.g. LayersCreate or LibraryPartDeleteModify. All rights available in this Archicad version are checked when omitted.
The rights of the current user, in the requested order.

hasRight.description: Whether the role of the current user has this right.

owners.description: The Teamwork owner of each given database, in the order of the input. userId is 0 when nobody owns the database.

isTeamwork.description: True, if the opened project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project. When false, every other Teamwork field is left out.

isOnline.description: True, if the Teamwork project is connected to its BIMcloud server. False in a solo project or when the Teamwork project works offline.

userId.description: The Teamwork user identifier of the current user, as the Teamwork commands report users.

userName.description: The name of the current Teamwork user.

serverUrl.description: The address of the BIMcloud server of the Teamwork project.

projectName.description: The name of the Teamwork project on the server.

objectIds.description: The objects to check, by guid, for example element guids.

rights.description: One item per input object, in the same order.

canCreate.description: Whether the current user has the right to create objects of this kind.

canDeleteModify.description: Whether the current user has the right to delete or modify the object.

isShared.description: Whether the opened project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project.

isOnline.description: Whether there is a live connection to the Teamwork server. Always false for a project that is not shared.

users.description: The members of the shared project. Only present when the project is shared.

hotlinkCacheManagementOwner.description: The user who has reserved the Hotlink and XRef management. Only present when somebody has reserved it.

textureCoordinates.description: The texture coordinates of each element, aligned with the input: per solid body of its 3D model, or an error.

includeHidden.description: Also list the tools that have no icon in the Toolbox but can be active, e.g. the Slab Accessory. Default: false.

toolboxItems.description: The tools installed in the Toolbox, the tools of add-ons included, each in the form SetCurrentTool accepts.

elementType.description: The element type of the tool. Unknown for the tools of add-ons, which classId identifies.

variation.description: The four-character subtype of the tool, e.g. DOOR, SKYL, CRWD, or the signature of a library part subtype registered by an add-on. Missing for the generic tool of the element type.

classId.description: The class id (a guid) of the tool of an add-on, whose elementType is Unknown. Archicad 26 and later.

currentTool.description: The tool active in the Toolbox, as GetCurrentTool returns it. Empty for the Arrow and the Marquee.

elementType.description: The element type of the tool. Unknown for the tools of add-ons, which classId identifies.

variation.description: The four-character subtype of the tool, e.g. DOOR, SKYL, CRWD, or the signature of a library part subtype registered by an add-on. Missing for the generic tool of the element type.

classId.description: The class id (a guid) of the tool of an add-on, whose elementType is Unknown. Archicad 26 and later.

urlReferences.description: The web link of each given element, or an error. An element without a link gets the error APIERR_NOUSERDATA.

types.description: The attribute types to check. All of them when omitted.

attributeTypes.description: One item per checked attribute type, in the order layer, fill, surface, buildingMaterial, composite, profile, lineType, penTable, zoneCategory.

archicadReport.description: Archicad's usedAttributes report as it came, e.g. 'Layer: 16, LineType: 9, Fill: 17'. Missing when the query failed.

warnings.description: What could not be checked. Missing when everything was checked.

filterByTypeId.description: Optional. Only list the unused library parts of this type (the typeId of GetAvailableLibraryParts).

includeNotPlaceable.description: Also list the library parts that cannot be placed (macros, pictures, property objects, list schemes and the like), which are never placed on their own. Default: false.

unusedLibraryParts.description: The loaded library parts that no element of the project is placed from, in index order.

usedLibraryPartCount.description: The number of different loaded library parts that are placed in the project.

scannedElementCount.description: The number of elements checked, in the floor plan and every view and layout database.

complete.description: False when a view or layout database or a library part could not be read (see warnings): then a listed library part may still be used.

GetUsedAttributesResult.description: How many attributes of each type are in use, as Archicad reports them for the usedAttributes JSON query.

usedAttributes.description: The number of attributes in use per attribute type. The keys are the attribute types of Tapir (Layer, Line, Fill, Composite, Surface, LayerCombination, ZoneCategory, Profile, MEPSystem, OperationProfile, BuildingMaterial) where they exist, otherwise Archicad's own names (e.g. City, DimStand, MarkupStyle, GraphicOverride). Archicad lists only the types it found in use. Missing when the report could not be read.

raw.description: The report as Archicad wrote it, e.g. 'Layer: 16, LineType: 9, Fill: 17'.

userDataOfAttributes.description: One item per attribute, in the input order: the pairs stored on the attribute (none when it holds no user data), or an error when the attribute was not found or holds user data in another layout.

groups.description: The groups to get the user data of.

userDataOfGroups.description: The user data attached to each given group, or an error for groups that have none.

userId.description: The stable GSID User ID of the logged-in user.

organizationIds.description: The list of organization IDs the user belongs to. Empty if not part of any organization or if the information cannot be retrieved.

modelViewOptionIndex.description: The index of the model view option combination the window applies, 0 when its options are not a stored combination (Custom). It is the index FindModelViewOption and GetModelViewOptionDetails return, which is not always the position in the list of GetModelViewOptions.

modelViewOptionName.description: The name of that combination, empty when there is none. Archicad may renumber the combinations when the view options of a window change, so look the index up by this name (FindModelViewOption) before switching back to it with SetViewOptions.

structureDisplay.description: The Partial Structure Display mode to check the elements in. The current window is not changed.

visibleSkinStatuses.description: Whether each element has a visible skin in the given Partial Structure Display mode, aligned with the input, or an error.

zoneElementId.description: The identifier of a single Zone. Prefer the zones array: querying many Zones in one call is much faster than one call per Zone.

zones.description: A list of Zones. Only one of zoneElementId and zones can be given.

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Zone Category. If omitted, every field is returned.

zoneCategories.description: A list of zone categories or errors.

isAutomaticLabelingOn.description: Whether the automatic labeling of Zones (placing a Label on each new Zone) is on.

selectedFavoriteName.description: The name of the Label Favorite that is placed on each new Zone. Missing when no Favorite is selected.

elements.description: A list of Zones.

reductionsOfZones.description: The area reductions of each Zone, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

userId.description: The Teamwork user id of the user to hand the elements over to, as GetTeamworkProjectInfo, GetReservationStatusOfElements and the conflicts of ReserveElements report users.

names.description: The names of the project data, reserved by the current user, to grant.

toUserId.description: The Teamwork user id of the user who gets the project data, for example the userId of a user returned by GetProjectDataKeys or ReserveProjectData.

GraphicOverrideColumnCoatingType.description: Matches columns whose coating type equals this.

GraphicOverrideColumnCrossSectionType.description: Matches columns whose cross section type equals this.

name.description: The name of the combination, unique within the project.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The rules of the combination, in priority order.
The rules of the combination, in priority order.

GraphicOverrideCombinationId.description: The identifier of a graphic override combination.

GraphicOverrideCombinationIdOrError.description: A graphic override combination identifier or an error.

name.description: The new name of the combination, unique within the project. The current name is kept when omitted.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The new rules of the combination, in priority order. They replace the current rules. The current rules are kept when omitted.

GraphicOverrideCriterion.description: Structured conditions of a graphic override rule, turned into Archicad's criterion XML (an alternative to criterionXML). Give exactly one property (classificationSystem and libraryPartSubtype go next to the condition they belong to). 'and'/'or' combine other conditions, nested at most three levels like the rows of the criteria editor (see their description). GetGraphicOverrideRules returns this shape with includeCriterion. 'elementType' filters by the tool an element was created with; 'all3DTypes'/'all2DTypes' match every 3D or 2D element. The other properties are conditions of Archicad's criteria editor: classification, layer and Model View, Construction, Positioning, Plan and Section, Surfaces and Materials, ID and Categories, Geometry, custom properties, and fields of the Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Object/Lamp, Door/Window, Opening, Curtain Wall and Stair tools. Their identifiers were captured from rules made in the criteria editor of Archicad 29; Archicad 27 keeps the generated rules as well. Not available: text content, the line pen of a dimension, hotlinked modules and Xrefs, and the MEP system (their stored format is not decoded yet).

and.description: Matches if all of the nested criteria match. Nesting follows the criteria editor's table, at most three levels: the top 'and' holds the rows, a row with several values is an 'or' (values joined with 'or') or an 'and' (joined with 'and'), and values joined with 'and' within an 'or' row are one more 'and'. A deeper 'and'/'or' is rejected.

or.description: Matches if any of the nested criteria match. As a row of the criteria editor's table: the values of one condition joined with 'or'. Nested at most three levels, see 'and'.

criterionXML.description: One condition in Archicad's criterion XML: a <ClassGuid> followed by the condition's element, as GetGraphicOverrideRules returns a condition it does not decode. Written into the criterion unchanged.

elementType.description: Matches elements created with this tool. 'AllTypes' matches elements of every type.

elementTypeNot.description: Matches elements not created with this tool (the criteria editor's 'is not'). 'AllTypes' is not allowed here.

libraryPartSubtype.description: Narrows elementType or elementTypeNot to a library part subtype of the tool, as the criteria editor stores it: the subtype's main and revision guid. GetGraphicOverrideRules returns it for the tools it decodes.

classification.description: Matches elements classified with this Classification System item ID (e.g. 'Slab'), or with any descendant of it in the classification tree (ArchiCAD's 'is in the branch of' operator - not a strict equality check).

classificationNot.description: Matches elements NOT classified with this Classification System item ID and not with any descendant of it in the classification tree (ArchiCAD's 'is not in the branch of' operator - not a strict inequality check).

classificationSystem.description: The classification system 'classification'/'classificationNot' refers to: its name as shown in the Classification Manager (e.g. 'Classification Archicad'), or its name and version as the criteria editor shows them (e.g. 'Classification Archicad - v 2.0'). Left out: the only classification system of the project that contains the item ID (the only system at all for classificationHasValue and classificationHasNoValue); an error when several do.

all3DTypes.description: If true, matches every 3D model element type.

all2DTypes.description: If true, matches every 2D drawing element type.

missingAttributes.description: Matches elements whose 'Missing attributes' status equals this value.

missingLibraryPart.description: Matches elements whose 'Missing library part' status equals this value (e.g. an Object/Lamp referencing a library part not found in the loaded libraries).

layer.description: Matches elements on this layer (by layer name).

layerNot.description: Matches elements NOT on this layer (by layer name).

layerLocked.description: Matches elements whose layer's locked state equals this value.

layerVisible.description: Matches elements whose layer's visible state equals this value.

layerCombination.description: Matches elements whose layer is shown in this layer combination (by layer combination name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.

layerCombinationNot.description: Matches elements whose layer is NOT shown in this layer combination (by layer combination name).

layerNameIs.description: Matches elements whose layer name equals this string exactly.

layerNameIsNot.description: Matches elements whose layer name does not equal this string.

layerNameContains.description: Matches elements whose layer name contains this substring.

layerNameNotContains.description: Matches elements whose layer name does not contain this substring.

layerNameStartsWith.description: Matches elements whose layer name starts with this substring.

layerNameEndsWith.description: Matches elements whose layer name ends with this substring.

compositeStructure.description: Matches elements built with this Composite Structure attribute (by name).

compositeStructureNot.description: Matches elements NOT built with this Composite Structure attribute (by name).

complexProfile.description: Matches elements built with this Complex Profile attribute (by name).

complexProfileNot.description: Matches elements NOT built with this Complex Profile attribute (by name).

compositeStructureNameIs.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name equals this string exactly.

compositeStructureNameIsNot.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name does not equal this string.

compositeStructureNameContains.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name contains this substring.

compositeStructureNameNotContains.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name does not contain this substring.

compositeStructureNameStartsWith.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name starts with this substring.

compositeStructureNameEndsWith.description: Matches elements whose Composite Structure attribute name ends with this substring.

complexProfileNameIs.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name equals this string exactly.

complexProfileNameIsNot.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name does not equal this string.

complexProfileNameContains.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name contains this substring.

complexProfileNameNotContains.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name does not contain this substring.

complexProfileNameStartsWith.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name starts with this substring.

complexProfileNameEndsWith.description: Matches elements whose Complex Profile attribute name ends with this substring.

roofConnected.description: Matches roofs whose 'connected to other roof(s)' status equals this value.

seaLevelAltitude.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude equals this value.

seaLevelAltitudeNot.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude does not equal this value.

seaLevelAltitudeLessThan.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude is less than this value.

seaLevelAltitudeGreaterThan.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude is greater than this value.

seaLevelAltitudeLessOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude is less than or equal to this value.

seaLevelAltitudeGreaterOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose sea level altitude is greater than or equal to this value.

projectZeroAltitude.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero equals this value.

projectZeroAltitudeNot.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero does not equal this value.

projectZeroAltitudeLessThan.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is less than this value.

projectZeroAltitudeGreaterThan.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is greater than this value.

projectZeroAltitudeLessOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is less than or equal to this value.

projectZeroAltitudeGreaterOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose altitude to project zero is greater than or equal to this value.

groundFloorAltitude.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor equals this value.

groundFloorAltitudeNot.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor does not equal this value.

groundFloorAltitudeLessThan.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is less than this value.

groundFloorAltitudeGreaterThan.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is greater than this value.

groundFloorAltitudeLessOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is less than or equal to this value.

groundFloorAltitudeGreaterOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose altitude to the ground floor is greater than or equal to this value.

roofAltitude.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude equals this value.

roofAltitudeNot.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude does not equal this value.

roofAltitudeLessThan.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude is less than this value.

roofAltitudeGreaterThan.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude is greater than this value.

roofAltitudeLessOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude is less than or equal to this value.

roofAltitudeGreaterOrEqual.description: Matches elements whose roof altitude is greater than or equal to this value.

floorIndex.description: Matches elements whose placement story equals this 0-based story/floor index (same convention as floorIndex elsewhere in Tapir). Only equality is supported - ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not offer a 'not equal' option for this field.

sillHeight.description: Matches Door/Window/RoofWindow/Opening elements whose sill height equals this value.

lintelHeight.description: Matches Door/Window/RoofWindow/Opening elements whose lintel height equals this value.

screedThickness.description: Matches Door/Window/RoofWindow elements whose screed thickness ('Epaisseur chape') equals this value.

linkedUpperStoryAbsolute.description: Matches Stair/Zone elements whose absolute linked upper story equals this 0-based story index. Only equality is supported. -31001 means 'not linked' ('Non lie').

linkedUpperStoryRelative.description: Matches Stair/Zone elements whose relative linked upper story equals this value. Only equality is supported. -31001 means 'not linked' ('Non lie').

mepDiameter.description: Matches MEP elements whose diameter equals this value.

mepDiameter2.description: Matches MEP elements whose 2nd diameter equals this value.

mepDN.description: Matches MEP elements whose nominal diameter (DN) equals this value.
