scripts.description: The requested scripts, by the keys used in the input.

index.description: The index of the library part, as GetAvailableLibraryParts returns it.

name.description: The name of the library part.

fileName.description: The file name of the library part.

unId.description: The unique ID of the library part, '{main GUID}-{revision GUID}'.

parentUnId.description: The unique ID of the parent of the library part.

sectionType.description: The four-character code of the section type, as GetLibraryPartSection takes it.

subIdent.description: The sub-identifier that tells apart sections of the same type.

size.description: The size of the section content in bytes. Missing when Archicad could not read the section, for example a protected one without its password.

isText.description: True when Archicad returns the section as text (scripts, comments), which GetLibraryPartSection reads. Binary sections, such as previews, are only listed. Missing when Archicad could not read the section.

subIdent.description: The secondary identifier of the section, for a library part with more sections of the same type. Default value is 0.

text.description: The new content of the section.

LibraryPartSectionUpdateType.description: The type of the text section.

index.description: The index of the library part.

sections.description: The sections of the library part, in the order Archicad lists them.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

displayName.description: The display name (description) of the parameter.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of array (in case of array value).

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of array (in case of array value).

value.description: The default value of the parameter. An array value is a flat list of dimension1 x dimension2 items, as GetGDLParametersOfElements returns it. Absent for a Dictionary parameter.

valueDescription.description: The value description for numeric parameter.

itemDescriptions.description: Per-item text labels for an array-type parameter, one per array element in dim1xdim2 order. Only present when the library part defines them.

unId.description: The full unique ID of the checked library part.

isSubtypeOf.description: True if the ancestor is anywhere up the subtype hierarchy of the library part. False for the ancestor itself: a library part is not a subtype of itself.

LibraryPartTransformation.description: The transformation chain of the library part instance: placement at location, rotation by angle, then scaling by xRatio and yRatio in the rotated coordinate system.

location.description: The location of the referenced library part on the floor plan.

angle.description: The rotation angle in radians.

xRatio.description: The scaling along the rotated x axis.

yRatio.description: The scaling along the rotated y axis.

LibraryPartType.description: Enumeration of available library part types. 'Unknown' is the schema-valid catch-all returned for any libpart whose typeID is not one of the named values (rare ACAPI sentinels and any future SDK subtype).

index.description: The current index of the library part. It may change when the libraries are reloaded.

name.description: The name of the library part.

fileName.description: The file name of the library part.

unId.description: The full unique ID (main and revision GUID) of the library part.

parentUnId.description: The full unique ID of the direct parent subtype of the library part.

creatorElementType.description: The type of the element the library part is placed as (its creator tool). Missing when Archicad does not report one.

creatorVariation.description: The four character variation ID of the creator tool, when it is not the generic variation.

name.description: The name of the library, as returned by GetLibraries.

path.description: The absolute path of the library, as returned by GetLibraries.

name.description: The name of the library, as returned by GetLibraries.

path.description: The absolute path of the library, as returned by GetLibraries.

LineAttributeOrError.description: A line attribute or an error.

dash.description: Length of the visible part of the item.

gap.description: Length of the invisible part of the item.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing Line to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

index.description: Index of the existing Line to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing Line with the given name will be overwritten.

scaleWithPlan.description: If true, the line type parameters are defined in meters at the given defineScale and scale on printout with the actual plan scale. If false (default), the parameters are fixed values in millimeters as the line will appear on the printout.

defineScale.description: The floor plan scale the line type is defined with. Only used if scaleWithPlan is true.

lineType.description: Solid, Dashed, or Symbol. Defaults to Solid.

period.description: The length of one period (Dashed and Symbol line types).

height.description: The height of the symbol line (Symbol line type only).

dashItems.description: Dash-gap pairs describing one period (Dashed line type only).

lineItems.description: Symbol items describing one period (Symbol line type only).

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line?

LineElementData.description: The parameters of the new Line.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

floorInd.description: The identifier of the floor. Optional parameter, by default the current floor is used.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index to place the line on. Optional parameter, by default the current layer is used.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line? Optional, defaults to false.

linePenIndex.description: Optional pen index. By default the current pen is used.

lineTypeId.description: Optional line type attribute. By default the current line type is used.

itemType.description: Separator, CenterDot, CenterLine, Dot, RightAngle, Parallel, Line, Circle, or Arc.

centerOffset.description: Vertical distance from the origin. Used for Separator, CenterDot, and CenterLine item types.

length.description: Length of the item. Used for CenterLine, RightAngle, and Parallel item types.

begPos.description: Beginning position. Used for Dot, RightAngle, Parallel, Line, Circle, and Arc item types.

endPos.description: End position. Used for Line item type only.

radius.description: Radius. Used for Circle and Arc item types.

beginAngle.description: Beginning angle in radians, measured from the vertical axis. Used for Arc item type only.

endAngle.description: End angle in radians, measured from the vertical axis. Used for Arc item type only.

links.description: The links to create, each from one element to another.

executionResults.description: One result per link, aligned with the input.

LinkToSettings.description: Mode of linking an element to its home story.

homeStoryDifference.description: Difference of the home story from the current story.

newCreationMode.description: Controls home-story selection during element creation. If true, homeStoryDifference selects the home story relative to the current story and the element's absolute floor index is ignored. If false, the absolute floor index is used and Archicad fills homeStoryDifference. This is a creation instruction, not a persistent linking mode.

linkByCriteria.description: Link the property objects matching their criteria to the element.

individualLibraryPartIndex.description: The index of the library part of the property object to assign to the element individually, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. 0 removes the individually assigned property object.

elementType.description: Set the links of the element defaults of this type instead of an element.

linkByCriteria.description: Link the property objects matching their criteria to the element defaults.

individualLibraryPartIndex.description: The index of the library part of the property object to assign to the element defaults individually, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. 0 removes the individually assigned property object.

LockableObjectSetStatus.description: Free: nobody has reserved it. Editable: the current user has reserved it. Locked: another user has reserved it (see conflicts). NotAvailable: the Teamwork server is offline or not available. NotExist: there is no Teamwork connection, for example the project is not a Teamwork project. An unknown object set name is reported as an error, not as a status.

LowCeilingAreaReduction.description: Up to three ceiling height limits split a zone into height ranges; the area of each range is reduced by its own percent in the calculated area of the zone.

activeHeightLimits.description: How many of the three height limits are in use: 0 (no reduction) to 3.

heightLimits.description: The three height limits, each with the reduction of the area under it (and above the previous limit); the first activeHeightLimits of them are in use. In SetProjectPreferences the given items change the limits of the same index.

reductionPercentAboveHeightLimits.description: The reduction of the area above the highest height limit, in percent.

LowCeilingAreaReductionUpdate.description: Up to three ceiling height limits split a zone into height ranges; the area of each range is reduced by its own percent in the calculated area of the zone.

activeHeightLimits.description: How many of the three height limits are in use: 0 (no reduction) to 3.

heightLimits.description: The three height limits, each with the reduction of the area under it (and above the previous limit); the first activeHeightLimits of them are in use. In SetProjectPreferences the given items change the limits of the same index.

reductionPercentAboveHeightLimits.description: The reduction of the area above the highest height limit, in percent.

isDefined.description: Whether the angle is defined in the set.

MEPAngleSet.description: The angles (in degrees) that the elbow and branch preference tables of a domain can use.

isEditable.description: Whether the set can be edited.

angleDetails.description: The angles of the set in the same order as angles, each with whether it is defined.

isEditable.description: Whether the table can be edited.

routingElementId.description: The routing element to connect to. When connecting two routes, the first or last node of the 'connectToId' route must lie exactly on this route (on its centerline, not within a tolerance). For a tee, this is the main route, which is split and gets the branch element.

connectToId.description: The MEP element or routing element connected to 'routingElementId'. For a tee, this is the branch route, whose first or last node lies on the main route. Two routes must have the same domain and MEP system; an MEP element's port must match the route in domain and MEP system, lie on its first or last node and point in the opposite direction.

MEPConnectionResult.description: The result of connecting an MEP routing element: the routing element deleted by merging, the routing element created by splitting and the branch element created by the connection. Empty in Archicad 27, which does not report them.

MEPConnectionResultOrError.description: The result of an MEP connection or an error.

MEPConnectionResultsOrErrors.description: A list of MEP connection results or errors.

MEPConnectionStyle.description: How the pieces of an MEP routing segment, or an MEP port, are connected. For pipes, the settings dialog of Archicad 29 shows SimpleBody as Welded, and Welded is refused on a pipe route.

MEPCrossSectionShape.description: Shape of an MEP routing segment's cross section or of an MEP port.

MEPCutPlanePosition.description: Where the floor plan cut plane of an MEP routing element is. Available from Archicad 29.

physicalSystemIds.description: The physical systems of the distribution system. From Archicad 29; missing when Archicad could not tell.

tree.description: The elements of the system from its root element on, in the order Archicad traverses them. Only returned when includeTree is true, and missing when Archicad could not traverse the system.

MEPDistributionSystemTreeNode.description: An element of a distribution system tree.

depth.description: The number of steps from the root element; 0 for the root element.

previousElementId.description: The element before this one on the way from the root element. Missing for the root element.

connectedPortIdOfPreviousElement.description: The port of the previous element this element is connected to (see GetMEPPorts). Missing when Archicad gives none.

connectedPortIdOfThisElement.description: The port of this element that is connected to the previous element (see GetMEPPorts). Missing when Archicad gives none.

nextElements.description: The elements after this one, away from the root element.

MEPDomainOrUnknown.description: The reported MEP domain. Unknown indicates that the domain could not be determined.

MEPDomainToolDefaults.description: The current settings of the MEP tools of one domain. A tool whose default Archicad does not give for the domain is left out; a setting is left out where the Archicad version does not have it.

routingSegment.description: The segment default of the routing tool.

anchor.description: The anchor point of the cross section, with the values of GetMEPRoutingElements.

routingNode.description: The node default of the routing tool.

elbow.description: The elbow default: Archicad 27 gives its radius factor (it calls elbows bends), Archicad 28 none, Archicad 29 and later both values.

rigidSegment.description: The rigid segment default of the routing tool.

width.description: Archicad 27 and 28.

height.description: Archicad 27 and 28.

insulationThickness.description: The insulation thickness, when the default has insulation.

branch.description: The branch default of the routing tool.

flexibleSegment.description: The flexible segment tool default. Archicad 27 has it in the Ventilation domain only.

preferenceTableId.description: The guid of an elbow preference table of the domain (see GetMEPPreferenceTables with includeFittingTables).

factorRadius.description: The radius factor of the elbows placed at the nodes.

isEditable.description: Whether the table can be edited.

angle.description: In degrees. Available from Archicad 29.

type.description: The type of the MEP element.

domain.description: The MEP domain of the element. Empty for domain-independent elements (e.g. Equipment).

localizedTypeName.description: The type name of the element in the language of Archicad. Only returned by Archicad 28.

domain.description: Required for all types except Equipment. For Equipment it only selects the ports that mepSystemId is applied to.

libraryPartId.description: Optional library part to place instead of the one in the tool's settings, as listed by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Its ports replace the default ones, so 'ports' refers to the ports of this library part. Its ports keep the MEP system of the library part, which may be none, so give 'mepSystemId' with it to connect it. If it is not found, the item fails and nothing is placed.

xSize.description: Optional size along the local x axis in meters. Available from Archicad 30. Some library parts calculate their own size and keep it.

ySize.description: Optional size along the local y axis in meters. Available from Archicad 30. Some library parts calculate their own size and keep it.

mepSystemId.description: Optional MEP system of the ports of the element's domain (of every port when an Equipment item has no domain). The 'mepSystemId' of an entry of 'ports' overrides it for that port.

ports.description: Optional changes to single ports of the element before it is placed. The values are in meters.

orientationDirection.description: Optional direction vector of the orientation. Defaults to (1, 0, 0).

orientationRotation.description: Optional rotation vector of the orientation. Defaults to (0, 1, 0).

floorIndex.description: Optional home story index (as returned by GetStories). The position stays absolute: the element is placed at it, then moved to this home story. Without it, Archicad picks the home story, which follows the active story. A story that does not exist gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed.

MEPElementDefaultDetails.description: The settings of a terminal, accessory, fitting, equipment or branch tool default.

libraryPartId.description: The library part the tool places.

insulationThickness.description: The insulation thickness, when the default has insulation.

MEPElementDefaults.description: Optional changes to the tool default before the element is placed. Only what is placed changes, not the tool's settings. A value that cannot be set gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed.

removeInsulation.description: If true, the element is placed without insulation. Cannot be combined with insulationThickness.

domain.description: The MEP domain (Ventilation, Piping or CableCarrier), empty if the element has none.

insulationThickness.description: The insulation thickness. RigidSegment, Elbow, Branch and Transition.

routingSegmentId.description: The routing segment the rigid segment belongs to (see GetMEPRoutingElements). RigidSegment.

routingNodeId.description: The routing node the elbow or transition belongs to (see GetMEPRoutingElements). Elbow and Transition.

controlPoints.description: The control points of the flexible segment. FlexibleSegment.

polyline.description: The line and spline parts of the flexible segment, when Archicad gives them (a flexible segment placed as a polyline, see CreateMEPFlexibleSegments). FlexibleSegment.

factorRadius.description: The radius factor of the elbow (Elbow::GetFactorRadius). Elbow, from Archicad 29.

preferenceTableId.description: The guid of the elbow or transition preference table (see GetMEPPreferenceTables). Elbow and Transition, from Archicad 29.

branchAngle.description: The angle of the branch, as returned by Branch::GetBranchAngle. Branch.

branchLength.description: The length of the branch. Branch.

offsetY.description: The Y offset of the transition (Transition::GetOffsetY). Transition.

offsetZ.description: The Z offset of the transition (Transition::GetOffsetZ). Transition.

widerPortId.description: The port at the wider end of the transition (see GetMEPPorts). Transition.

narrowerPortId.description: The port at the narrower end of the transition (see GetMEPPorts). Transition.

isControlledByPreference.description: Whether the transition is controlled by its preference table. Transition, from Archicad 29.

anchorPoint.description: The new anchor point of a terminal, accessory, equipment, fitting or flexible segment.

orientation.description: The new orientation of a terminal, accessory, equipment, fitting or flexible segment.

libraryPartId.description: The library part a terminal, accessory, equipment or fitting uses, as listed by GetAvailableLibraryParts. If it is not found, the element keeps its library part and the item fails.

controlPoints.description: The new control points of a flexible segment, from its beginning to its end. Not together with 'polyline'.

polyline.description: The new geometry of a Piping flexible segment as alternating line and spline parts that connect at their ends. Not together with 'controlPoints'. Available from Archicad 28.

width.description: The new width of a flexible segment.

height.description: The new height of a flexible segment.

MEPElementPorts.description: The ports of an MEP element.

MEPElementPortsOrError.description: The ports of an MEP element or an error.

MEPElementPortsOrErrors.description: A list of MEP element ports or errors.

controlPoints.description: The control points of the flexible segment, from its beginning to its end. Give either 'controlPoints' or 'polyline'.

startOrientation.description: Optional orientation at the beginning, with 'controlPoints'. Defaults to the direction from the first control point to the second one, with a horizontal rotation vector perpendicular to it.

endOrientation.description: Optional orientation at the end, with 'controlPoints'. Defaults to the direction from the last but one control point to the last one, with a horizontal rotation vector perpendicular to it.

polyline.description: The flexible segment as alternating line and spline parts that connect at their ends, instead of 'controlPoints'. Archicad places polyline flexible segments in the Piping domain only.

startDirection.description: Optional direction vector at the beginning, with 'polyline'. Only when the first part is a spline.

endDirection.description: Optional direction vector at the end, with 'polyline'. Only when the last part is a spline.

MEPFlexibleSegmentPolyline.description: The geometry of a polyline MEP flexible segment: its line and spline parts in order, which alternate and connect at their ends. Available from Archicad 28.

begin.description: The beginning of a line part.

end.description: The end of a line part.

controlPoints.description: The control points of a spline part.

MEPFlexibleSegmentPolylinePartType.description: A straight line from 'begin' to 'end', or a spline through 'controlPoints'.

MEPFloorPlanDisplayOption.description: How an MEP routing element is shown on the floor plan. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPFlowDirection.description: The flow direction of a piping or ventilation port.

MEPOnStoryVisibility.description: On which stories an MEP routing element is shown. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPOrientation.description: The orientation of an MEP element, given by a direction and a rotation vector.

systemGroupId.description: The system group the new physical system belongs to.

rootElementId.description: The MEP element the system starts from. Archicad keeps it only while it is part of an MEP network: the root of a stand-alone element is cleared when the MEP networks are recalculated.

mepSystemId.description: The MEP system attribute used as the category of the physical system.

isEditable.description: Whether the physical system can be modified. Missing when Archicad could not tell.

rootElementId.description: The element the system starts from. Missing when not set, or when Archicad cleared it because the element is not part of an MEP network.

mepSystemId.description: The MEP system attribute used as the category of the system. Missing when not set.

MEPPhysicalSystemId.description: The identifier of an MEP physical system.

name.description: The new name of the physical system.

rootElementId.description: The MEP element the system starts from. Archicad keeps it only while it is part of an MEP network: the root of a stand-alone element is cleared when the MEP networks are recalculated.

mepSystemId.description: The MEP system attribute used as the category of the physical system.

physicalSystemIds.description: The physical systems the element is part of. Empty for an element of no physical system.

isConnectable.description: Whether the port can be connected to the other port.

portIndex.description: Zero-based index of the port in the library part.

mepSystemId.description: The MEP system of the port.

width.description: The width of the port.

height.description: The height of a ventilation or cable carrier port.

diameter.description: The diameter of a piping port.

MEPPortDefaultDetails.description: The settings of one port of an MEP tool default. Each field is present only where the port's domain and the Archicad version have it: Archicad 27 gives only the index and the shape.

index.description: The index of the port in the default.

height.description: The height of a ventilation or cable carrier port.

diameter.description: The diameter of a piping port.

wallThickness.description: The wall thickness of a piping or ventilation port.

flowDirection.description: The flow direction of a piping or ventilation port.

flangeSize.description: The flange size of a piping or ventilation port, when it has flanges. Available from Archicad 30.

MEPPortDetails.description: The details of a port of an MEP element.

mepElementId.description: The MEP element the port belongs to.

isPhysicallyConnected.description: Whether the port is physically connected to another port. Available from Archicad 28.

isConnected.description: Whether the port is connected to another port. Archicad 27 only; from Archicad 28 see isPhysicallyConnected.

connectionStyle.description: The connection style of the port. Available from Archicad 30.

flowDirection.description: The flow direction of a piping or ventilation port.

nominalSize.description: The nominal size of a piping port. Available from Archicad 30.

outerDiameter.description: The outer diameter of a piping port.

wallThickness.description: The wall thickness of a piping or ventilation port.

flangeSize.description: The flange size of a piping or ventilation port. Available from Archicad 30.

portId.description: The port to modify, as returned by GetMEPPorts.

connectionStyle.description: New connection style of the port. Available from Archicad 30.

flowDirection.description: New flow direction of a piping or ventilation port.

outerDiameter.description: New outer diameter of a piping port.

nominalSize.description: New nominal size of a piping port. Available from Archicad 30.

portId.description: The port to check, as returned by GetMEPPorts.

otherPortId.description: The port to connect it to, as returned by GetMEPPorts.

index.description: The index of the new row in the table. Archicad 27: in the list of its shape, after the call.

MEPPreferenceRowChange.description: Changes one row of a preference table, in the shape GetMEPPreferenceTables returns. Only the given values are changed. A value that does not belong to the kind of table is an error; the read-only values (reference ids, branchAxisAngle, isValid, and angle of an elbow table) are ignored.

delete.description: Deletes the row. The circular segment tables, and the elbow tables in Archicad 28, have a fixed row for each reference id; there the row is emptied instead. Cannot be combined with new values.

value.description: Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables. These tables keep their rows ordered by value, so a changed value can move the row; the indices of the other rows given in the same call are followed.

length.description: Branch tables and piping transition tables.

angle.description: Ventilation transition tables, in the unit GetMEPPreferenceTables returns it. Read-only (ignored) in elbow tables.

valid.description: Whether the row is valid. Archicad 27: whether the list of the shape has a row with the index.

MEPPreferenceRowIndex.description: The position of the row in its preference table, as ModifyMEPPreferenceTables expects it. Rows that cannot be read are left out of GetMEPPreferenceTables, so this is not always the position in the rows list.

MEPPreferenceRowKey.description: The key of a row. Segment tables: referenceId. Elbow tables: referenceId and angle. Branch tables: mainAxisReferenceId, branchAxisReferenceId and branchAxisAngle. Transition tables: beginReferenceId and endReferenceId. The angles are as GetMEPPreferenceTables returns them; Archicad 28 finds the rows by their reference ids only and rejects a key with an angle. Archicad 27: shape and index (AddMEPPreferenceTableRows: shape only).

index.description: Archicad 27 only: the index of the row in the list of its shape, from 0.

MEPPreferenceRowShape.description: Archicad 27 only: the shape whose list of values the row is in.

index.description: Archicad 27 only: the index of the row after the call, which can differ from the index of its key when setting a value moves rows. The keys are the indices before the call.

MEPPreferenceRowValues.description: The values of a row, lengths in meters. Segment tables: diameter, wallThickness and description. Elbow tables: diameter, radius and description. Branch tables: mainAxisDiameter, branchAxisDiameter, length, branchOffset, connectionLength and description. Pipe transition tables: beginDiameter, endDiameter, length and description. Duct transition tables: beginDiameter, endDiameter, angle and description. Archicad 27: value and description.

value.description: Archicad 27 only: the value of the row.

isEditable.description: Whether the table can be edited.

useIndividualSegmentLengths.description: Whether the table uses individual segmentation lengths. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPPreferenceTableChange.description: Changes one preference table, in the shape GetMEPPreferenceTables returns. Only the given values and rows are changed.

guid.description: The guid of the table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables.

name.description: The new name of the table.

useIndividualSegmentLengths.description: Segment tables only. Available from Archicad 29.

minimumSegmentationLength.description: Segment tables only; the maximum is kept when not given. Available from Archicad 29.

maximumSegmentationLength.description: Segment tables only; the minimum is kept when not given. Available from Archicad 29.

rows.description: The rows to change or delete, each at most once. All indices refer to the table before this call.

newRows.description: Rows to add to a rectangular duct or cable carrier segment table, after the other changes. Adding rows to the other tables is not supported yet.

domain.description: The MEP domain of a preference table container.

tableId.description: The id of a preference table, for the tableId of the preference table row commands.
The id of a preference table, for the tableId of the preference table row commands.

MEPPreferenceTableSizes.description: The number of rows of each shape.

MEPPreferenceTableType.description: The kind of preference table container: the segment tables (circular and rectangular ducts share one container), or the elbow, branch or transition tables. CableCarrier has only segment tables, transition tables are available from Archicad 29.

MEPPreferredTransitionPlacement.description: Where an MEP routing node places its transitions.

isDefined.description: Whether the reference id is defined in the set.

MEPReferenceSet.description: The reference ids (nominal sizes) that the preference tables of a domain can use.

isEditable.description: Whether the set can be edited.

referenceIdDetails.description: The reference ids of the set in the same order as referenceIds, each with whether it is defined.

MEPRigidSegmentParameters.description: The rigid segment default parameters of a routing segment (RoutingSegment::GetRigidSegmentDefaultParameters). Archicad 28 only.

MEPRoutingAnchor.description: The anchor point of the cross section, on a 3x3 grid.

nodeCoordinates.description: The corner points of the route polyline.

crossSectionWidth.description: Optional cross section width applied to all segments.

crossSectionHeight.description: Optional cross section height applied to all segments.

crossSectionReferenceId.description: Optional cross section reference id of the segment preference table (used for circular cross sections). Resolved against preferenceTableId if given, otherwise against the table of the current routing tool default.

preferenceTableId.description: Optional guid of the segment preference table (see GetMEPPreferenceTables) applied to all segments. Not applicable to the CableCarrier domain.

layerIndex.description: Optional layer attribute index of the routing element and all its parts (routing segments, rigid segments, elbows and transitions). Only a positive index takes effect; otherwise the routing tool default layer is used. A layer that does not exist or is locked gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed.

floorIndex.description: Optional home story index (as returned by GetStories) of the routing element and all its parts. The node coordinates stay absolute: the route is placed at them, then moved to this home story. Without it, Archicad picks the home story, which follows the active story. A story that does not exist gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed.

MEPRoutingElementDefaults.description: Optional changes to the routing tool default of the domain before the route is placed. Only what is placed changes, not the routing tool's settings. A value that cannot be set gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed.

MEPRoutingElementDetails.description: The details of an MEP routing element.

floorIndex.description: The index of the home story of the routing element (see GetStories).

offsetFromHomeStory.description: The offset of the lowest node of the routing element from the level of its home story.

branchPreferenceTableId.description: The guid of the branch preference table used by the routing element (see GetMEPPreferenceTables). Not present when the routing element has none.

logicallyConnectedPortIdAtRouteBegin.description: The port logically connected to the beginning of the route (see GetMEPPorts). Not present when nothing is connected there.

logicallyConnectedPortIdAtRouteEnd.description: The port logically connected to the end of the route (see GetMEPPorts). Not present when nothing is connected there.

MEPRoutingElementDetailsOrError.description: The details of an MEP routing element or an error.

MEPRoutingElementDetailsOrErrors.description: A list of MEP routing element details or errors.

crossSectionWidth.description: New cross section width applied to all segments.

crossSectionHeight.description: New cross section height applied to all segments.

crossSectionShape.description: The new shape is applied to all segments.

crossSectionReferenceId.description: New cross section reference id of the segment preference table applied to all segments (used for circular cross sections). Resolved against preferenceTableId if given, otherwise against the table the segments already use.

preferenceTableId.description: New segment preference table (guid as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables) applied to all segments. Not applicable to the CableCarrier domain.

branchPreferenceTableId.description: New branch preference table (guid as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables) of the routing element.

anchor.description: Applied to all segments of the routing element.

referenceLineOffsetX.description: New horizontal offset of the reference line from the anchor point, applied to all segments.

referenceLineOffsetY.description: New vertical offset of the reference line from the anchor point, applied to all segments.

wallThickness.description: New wall thickness applied to all segments.

flangeSize.description: New flange size applied to all segments. Needs the Flanged connection style, which can be set in the same call.

insulationThickness.description: New insulation thickness of the route, as Insulation in its settings: applied to the rigid segments of all segments and to the elbows (bends in Archicad 28) and transitions at all nodes. 0 removes the insulation. Not applicable to the CableCarrier domain.

connectionStyle.description: New connection style applied to all segments.

preferredTransitionPlacement.description: New preferred transition placement applied to all nodes.

cutPlanePosition.description: New cut plane position of the routing element. Available from Archicad 29.

floorPlanDisplayOption.description: New floor plan display option of the routing element. Available from Archicad 29.

showProjection.description: New show projection setting of the routing element. Available from Archicad 29.

onStoryVisibility.description: New on-story visibility of the routing element. Available from Archicad 29.

nodePositions.description: New positions of the routing nodes. The size must match the number of nodes of the route.

MEPRoutingNodeDefaults.description: The routing node default: the elbows and transitions placed at the nodes of the route. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPRoutingNodeDetails.description: The details of an MEP routing node.

routingElementId.description: The routing element the node belongs to.

incomingSegmentId.description: The routing segment ending at this node. Not present at the beginning of the route.

outgoingSegmentId.description: The routing segment starting at this node. Not present at the end of the route.

elbows.description: The elbows (bends in Archicad 28) at this node.

MEPRoutingNodeParameters.description: The routing node default parameters of a routing element (RoutingElement::GetRoutingNodeDefaultParameters). The elbow is given from Archicad 29.

MEPRoutingNodeParametersUpdate.description: The routing node default parameters of a routing element (RoutingElement::Modifier::SetRoutingNodeDefaultParameters). Archicad 29 or newer.

MEPRoutingSegmentDefaults.description: The routing segment default parameters of a routing element (RoutingElement::Modifier::SetRoutingSegmentDefaultParameters).

crossSectionReferenceId.description: Cross section reference id of the segment preference table. Resolved against preferenceTableId if given, otherwise against the table already set.

preferenceTableId.description: A segment preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables.

MEPRoutingSegmentDetails.description: The details of an MEP routing segment.

routingElementId.description: The routing element the segment belongs to.

crossSectionReferenceId.description: The cross section reference id of the segment in its preference table (meaningful for circular cross sections).

preferenceTableId.description: The guid of the segment preference table used by the segment (see GetMEPPreferenceTables).

beginNodeId.description: The routing node at the beginning of the segment.

endNodeId.description: The routing node at the end of the segment.

referenceLineOffsetX.description: The horizontal offset of the reference line from the anchor point.

referenceLineOffsetY.description: The vertical offset of the reference line from the anchor point.

wallThickness.description: The wall thickness of the segment.

flangeSize.description: The flange size of the segment (width for Ventilation, diameter for Piping). It is used only when the connection style is Flanged; Archicad 29 also returns it for other styles.

insulationThickness.description: The insulation thickness of the rigid segments of the segment. Only present when they are insulated (never for cable carriers).

rigidSegments.description: The rigid segments (the straight duct, pipe or cable carrier pieces) of the routing segment.

MEPRoutingSegmentParameters.description: The routing segment default parameters of the routing element (RoutingElement::GetRoutingSegmentDefaultParameters).

MEPShowProjection.description: How much of an MEP routing element's projection is shown on the floor plan. Available from Archicad 29.

domain.description: The domain(s) this system belongs to. Archicad 29+ allows only one; earlier versions may report several.

materialId.description: The surface (material) attribute applied to the 3D model of the elements of the system.

insulationMaterialId.description: The surface (material) attribute applied to the insulation of the elements of the system.

MEPSystemAttributeOrError.description: An MEP system attribute or an error.

MEPSystemData.description: Data to create an MEP System.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing MEP System to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

index.description: Index of the existing MEP System to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing MEP System with the given name will be overwritten.

domain.description: Only elements belonging to the same domain can use this system.

contourPen.description: The index of the contour pen [1..255].

fillPen.description: The index of the fill (foreground) pen [1..255].

fillBackgroundPen.description: The index of the background pen [0..255]. 0 means transparent background.

centerLinePen.description: The index of the center line pen [1..255].

fillId.description: Identifier of the fill pattern attribute.

centerLineTypeId.description: Identifier of the center line type attribute.

materialId.description: Identifier of the surface (material) attribute applied to the 3D model of the elements of the system.

insulationMaterialId.description: Identifier of the surface (material) attribute applied to the insulation of the elements of the system.

isEditable.description: Whether the system group can be modified. Missing when Archicad could not tell.

MEPSystemGroupId.description: The identifier of an MEP system group.

name.description: The new name of the system group.

domain.description: Optional domain of the Take-Off tool whose settings are used. Defaults to the domain of the segment's routing element. Archicad currently only has Ventilation take-offs.

segmentId.description: The routing segment to place the take-off on (the elementId of an item of 'segments' returned by GetMEPRoutingElements).

distanceFromBeginning.description: The distance of the take-off from the beginning of the segment, in meters. Must not be negative or more than the length of the segment.

rotationAroundMainAxis.description: Optional rotation of the take-off around the axis of the segment, in radians. Archicad places take-offs only at quarter turns, so it must be a multiple of pi/2 (negative values and full turns are allowed). Defaults to 0, which places the take-off facing left relative to the segment's direction; pi/2 faces up, pi faces right, 3*pi/2 (or -pi/2) faces down.

length.description: Optional length of the take-off in meters, set after placing it; must be positive. The length of the Take-Off tool when not given.

defaults.description: Optional changes to the settings of the Take-Off tool before the take-off is placed. Only what is placed changes, not the tool's settings. A value that cannot be set gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed. The insulation thickness of a take-off cannot be set (Archicad stops with a fatal error).

removeInsulation.description: If true, the take-off is placed without insulation.

MEPTransitionDefaults.description: The transition parameters of a routing node (RoutingNode::Modifier::SetTransitionDefaultParameters). Archicad 29 or newer.

preferenceTableId.description: A transition preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables.

MEPTransitionParameters.description: Transition parameters. preferenceTableId is given from Archicad 29.

isEditable.description: Whether the table can be edited.

angle.description: In degrees. Ventilation only.

value.description: The size of the row.

MEPValuePreferenceTable.description: A rectangular duct or cable carrier segment preference table: a list of sizes.

isEditable.description: Whether the table can be edited.

useIndividualSegmentLengths.description: Whether the table uses individual segmentation lengths. Available from Archicad 29.

elements.description: The elements to make the property available for.
The elements to make the property unavailable for.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the edge of the zone.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the zone.

value.description: The new value of the marker parameter, see the value given with a name.

name.description: The name of the marker parameter.

value.description: The new value of the marker parameter: a number for the numeric types (Integer, Length, Angle, RealNumber, PenColor, LineType, Material, FillPattern, BuildingMaterial, Profile, RGBColor, Intensity), a string for String and Title, true/false for Boolean and 'On'/'Off' for LightSwitch. Array parameters are not supported.

libPart.description: The library part of the marker. Absent when it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the marker.

MarqueeType.description: The shape of the marquee in the current window, or 'none' when there is no marquee.

texts.description: The texts to measure, each with the font, style and height it would be placed with. Nothing is created.

measurements.description: One item per input text, in the same order. The measurement takes no width factor or character spacing into account.

elements.description: The construction elements to merge together. At least two.

MergedElements.description: The elements merged with one element.

mergedElements.description: The elements merged with the queried element. Empty when it is not merged with any.

MergedElementsOrError.description: The elements merged with one element, or an error.

MeshData.description: The parameters of the new Mesh.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

level.description: The Z reference level of coordinates.

buildingMaterialId.description: Optional building material of the mesh. Its top, side and bottom surface overrides are cleared, also one from the Mesh tool defaults, so the mesh shows the building material's own surface.

showLines.description: Whether to show secondary mesh lines (level lines other than the user-defined ones) on plan.

contourPen.description: Optional pen attribute index for the mesh's contour line.

levelPen.description: Optional pen attribute index for the mesh's level lines.

lineTypeIndex.description: Optional line type attribute index for the mesh's contour.

levelPen.description: Pen attribute index for the mesh level lines.

lineTypeIndex.description: Line type attribute index for the mesh contour.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the outline polygon of the mesh. Replaces the existing boundary entirely; the existing outline arcs are removed unless polygonArcs is also given, and the existing holes are kept unless holes is also given.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the mesh. Replaces the existing outline arcs; when given without polygonCoordinates, they apply to the existing outline.

holes.description: The 3D holes of the mesh. Replaces all existing holes; an empty array removes them. When given without polygonCoordinates, the existing outline is kept.

sublines.description: The leveling sublines inside the polygon of the mesh. Replaces existing sublines entirely.

MeshRidges.description: How ridges between mesh facets are displayed in 3D: 'AllSharp' shows all ridges, 'AllSmooth' hides them, 'UserDefined' shows only ridges along user-defined level lines (the drawing-set look for contour-line topography).

MeshSkirtType.description: The type of the skirt structure.

coordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the leveling subline of the mesh.

source.description: What refers to the missing attribute: a placed element, the default settings of a tool, a Favorite, a graphic override rule, a Model View Options combination, or another attribute.

elementId.description: The placed element. Only for source element.

elementType.description: The element's type, as GetElementsByType names it: for a tool default or a Favorite the type of its tool. Missing for a graphic override rule, a Model View Options combination and an attribute.

overrideRuleId.description: The graphic override rule. Only for source overrideRule.

overrideRuleName.description: The name of the graphic override rule. Only for source overrideRule.

modelViewOptionId.description: The Model View Options combination, the id GetModelViewOptionDetails returns. Only for source modelViewOption.

modelViewOptionName.description: The name of the Model View Options combination. Only for source modelViewOption.

gdlOptionsName.description: When the reference is a GDL parameter of the library part settings of a Model View Options combination, the name of that option set (the gdlOptions name GetModelViewOptionDetails returns). Missing otherwise.

ownerAttributeType.description: The type of the attribute that refers to the missing one. Only for source attribute.

ownerAttributeId.description: The attribute that refers to the missing one. Only for source attribute.

ownerAttributeName.description: The name of that attribute. Only for source attribute.

favoriteName.description: The name of the Favorite. Only for source favorite.

subElementType.description: When the reference is in a sub-element the Favorite keeps apart (e.g. a stair's structure), the type of that sub-element. Missing otherwise.

parentElementId.description: The element this one is part of (the curtain wall of a frame, the column of a segment, ...). Missing for an element that is not part of another one.

databaseId.description: The database the element is in, the same id GetDatabases returns. Only for source element.

databaseType.description: The type of that database, e.g. FloorPlan, Worksheet, Details, Section, Layout. Only for source element.

storyIndex.description: The element's home story. Only for elements of the floor plan.

storyName.description: The name of that story. Only for elements of the floor plan.

databaseName.description: The name of the view or layout (e.g. the worksheet) the element is in. Missing for the floor plan.

databaseReference.description: The reference id of that view or layout. Missing when it has none.

inHotlinkedModule.description: True when the element comes from a hotlinked module: it has to be fixed in the module's file. Missing otherwise.

index.description: The attribute index the element, tool default, Favorite, graphic override rule, Model View Options combination or attribute refers to, which no attribute of attributeType has.

field.description: The element's setting that holds the index, named as in the Archicad API (e.g. layer, contLtype, cWallFrameDefaults.material); for a graphic override rule lineType, fillOverride or surfaceOverride; for a Model View Options combination the field as GetModelViewOptionDetails names it (e.g. stair.stairSchemeSurfaceIndex); for an attribute the field as GetComposites, GetBuildingMaterials, GetSurfaces, GetMEPSystems or GetProfiles names it (e.g. skins[0].buildingMaterialId, cutFillIndex). gdlParameter.description: The library part parameter that holds the index, with the cell for an array parameter (e.g. gs_frame_mat, matArray[2][1]). Missing when field is given.

libPartName.description: The name of the element's library part, also when the library containing it is not loaded.

Model3DComponentType.description: The component type: the API_3DTypeID enumerator name without its API_ prefix and ID suffix.

count.description: The number of components of this type.

coordinates.description: Model coordinates in the current database (meters). In a 3D window they are projected with the current camera; in other windows z is disregarded.

screenPoints.description: One item per input coordinate, in the same order: the pixel position local to the current Archicad view window (not global desktop coordinates), or an error.

name.description: The name of the model view option combination.

modelViewOptions.description: The fields of API_ModelViewOptions stored in the combination, with the curtainWall, stair and railing parts as nested objects: the same fields as viewOptions.modelViewOptions of GetViewOptions. gdlOptions.description: The model view options that library parts add to the combination (the library part settings of the Model View Options dialog, e.g. of doors, windows and objects), with their GDL parameter values.

modelViewOptionId.description: The identifier of the model view option combination (see FindModelViewOption).

name.description: The name of the model view option combination, as shown in Document > Model View > Model View Options.

clipPolygon.description: The new boundary of the cut out area, at least 3 points, without repeating the first one.

electricalDevicesData.description: Array of data to modify electrical devices. Only the given fields are changed.

electricalPanelsData.description: Array of data to modify electrical panels. Only the given fields are changed.

clearWiringTypes.description: If true, every wiring type is removed before wiringTypesToAdd is applied; wiringTypesToRemove is then not needed and is ignored.

clearLoadClassifications.description: If true, every load classification is removed before loadClassificationsToAdd is applied; loadClassificationsToRemove is then not needed and is ignored.

graphicOverrideRules.description: The graphic override rules to modify.

textPen.description: Pen index of the dimension text, applied to both texts of the marker. Optional parameter.

dimForm.description: Marker type of the Level Dimension tool, 0-19 as Archicad stores it (read it back with GetDetailsOfElements from an existing level dimension or one placed with a favorite). Optional parameter.

needPlus.description: Show a plus sign for positive values. Optional parameter.

markerSize.description: Size of the marker in millimeters (paper size). Optional parameter.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the marker in radians. Optional parameter.

origin.description: The origin the level is measured from. Optional parameter.

remove.description: Loaded libraries to remove, each by its name or by its path.

physicalSystemsData.description: Array of data to modify physical systems. Only the given fields are changed.

portsData.description: Array of data to modify MEP ports. Only provided fields are changed.
