So do not change the selection until then, and read the new geometry with a later command. Every Zone is checked first; if one cannot be updated (not a Zone, listed twice, hidden or locked layer, not editable), nothing is selected or updated. An empty list updates nothing. Without the list the current selection is updated, or every Zone when nothing is selected.

libraryPaths.description: The paths of the local library folders or container files (.lcf) to upload.

serverUrl.description: The URL of the BIMcloud or Teamwork server, e.g. 'https://bimcloud.example.com:22000'.

parentPath.description: The path of the folder on the server that holds the libraries, as shown in BIMcloud Manager.

executionResults.description: One result per library, in the order of the input.

UserDataKey.description: The key of the value. Scripts should prefix their keys (for example 'myscript.databaseId') so that different scripts do not overwrite each other's data.

UserDataKeysToDelete.description: The keys to remove from the user data. A key that is not stored is ignored. Applied after pairs.

UserDataPair.description: A string value stored under a key in user data.

value.description: The stored value: any text, for example an id, a timestamp or a JSON document the script encodes itself.

UserDataPairs.description: Key-value pairs stored in user data.

UserUndefinedPropertyValue.description: A userUndefined value means that there is no actual number/string/etc. value, but the user deliberately set an Undefined value: this is a valid value, too.

navigatorItemId.description: Navigator item ID of the Project Map viewpoint to clone.

parentNavigatorItemId.description: Navigator item ID of the View Map folder to place the clone in. Required - Archicad's CloneProjectMapItemToViewMap API leaves a clone created directly at the View Map root in a broken state (it cannot be deleted or moved afterwards, by API or by hand), so Tapir refuses to fall back to the root on your behalf. Create a View Map folder (CreateViewMapFolder) first if you don't already have one to target.

navigatorItemId.description: Source navigator item whose database and settings are copied: a Project Map item, or a View Map view (e.g. a story view). A View Map view is created from its Project Map source (sourceNavigatorItemId in GetNavigatorItemTree), then gets the view's own view settings, name and ID.

parentNavigatorItemId.description: View Map folder to place the new view in. Required - the underlying Archicad API used to create the item leaves it undeletable and unmovable afterwards when it is attached directly to the View Map root, so Tapir refuses to fall back to the root on your behalf. Create a View Map folder (CreateViewMapFolder) first if you don't already have one to target.

name.description: Name for the new view. Optional; defaults to the source item name.
The name of the design option combination settings of the view, as Archicad reports it.

designOptionCombinationId.description: The design option combination the view shows. Given for the Standard status and, on Archicad 27 and 28, also for the Custom status (the combination the custom set was made from). On Archicad 29 and newer it is given only when exactly one combination has the name of the view's settings.

ViewDesignOptionCombinationStatus.description: MainModelOnly: the view shows only the main model, no design option. Standard: the view shows a design option combination. Custom: the view shows a set of design options modified by the user, without a name. Missing: the combination of the view was deleted.

ViewImageSource.description: The window whose image is returned: the 3D window, or the PhotoRendering window.

ViewOptions.description: The model view options and the on-screen view options, every field by its API_ViewOptions name. Values are the numeric API constants; attribute indices are plain integers.

modelViewOptions.description: Fields of API_ModelViewOptions, with the curtainWall, stair and railing parts as nested objects.

ViewOptionsUpdate.description: The fields to change, named as in the response of GetViewOptions. Fields not given keep their current value. Without an index, the window then uses Custom model view options (index 0), also when only on-screen view options are given. To keep the combination, give its index as well.

ViewSettings.description: The settings of a navigator view

modelViewOptions.description: The name of the model view options. If empty, the view has custom model view options.

layerCombination.description: The name of the layer combination. If empty, the view has custom layer combination.

dimensionStyle.description: The name of the dimension style. If empty, the view has custom dimension style.

penSetName.description: The name of the pen set. If empty, the view has custom pen set.

graphicOverrideCombination.description: The name of the graphic override combination. If empty, the view has custom graphic override combination.

drawingScale.description: The drawing scale stored on the view, if enabled (see saveFlags.drawingScale). Giving it to SetViewSettings also turns saveFlags.drawingScale on, unless that flag is given explicitly.

saveZoom.description: Whether the zoom box is stored in the view. The same flag as saveFlags.zoom, kept for compatibility; in SetViewSettings saveFlags.zoom wins when both are given.

ignoreSavedZoom.description: Whether changing to the view should ignore its stored zoom.

zoom.description: Stored zoom box. Used only when saveZoom is true. Giving it to SetViewSettings also turns saveFlags.zoom on, unless that flag is given explicitly.

saveFlags.description: Which settings the view stores: the "stored in this view" checkboxes of the View Settings dialog. A stored setting whose name field is empty is a custom (unnamed) one; a setting that is not stored is not part of the view at all, which the name fields alone cannot tell apart. Always complete in a GetViewSettings response. In SetViewSettings every flag is optional, a flag that is not given keeps its current value, and a flag given here overrides the one implied by drawingScale, zoom, structureDisplay or saveZoom.

zoom.description: Whether the zoom box is stored in the view.

displayOptions.description: Whether the model view options are stored in the view (named by modelViewOptions, custom if that is empty).

layers.description: Whether the layer settings are stored in the view (named by layerCombination, custom if that is empty).

drawingScale.description: Whether the drawing scale is stored in the view.

dimensions.description: Whether the dimension settings are stored in the view (named by dimensionStyle, custom if that is empty).

penSet.description: Whether the pen set is stored in the view (named by penSetName, custom if that is empty).

structureDisplay.description: Whether the structure display mode is stored in the view.

rotation.description: View rotation angle in radians, derived from transformationMatrix. Read via GetViewSettings; use SetViewRotation to change it.

transformationMatrix.description: The full 2D transformation of the view that rotation is derived from: the 3x4 matrix row by row (12 numbers), in the layout Get3DProjectionSettings uses. Its translation is at indices 3 and 7. Read via GetViewSettings; SetViewSettings ignores it, use rotation or SetViewRotation to change the rotation and translation to change the translation.

translation.description: SetViewSettings only: the translation part of the view transformation (indices 3 and 7 of transformationMatrix), so that view coordinates = rotation applied to model coordinates + translation. rotation leaves the translation as it is; without this field the translation is not changed. {x: 0, y: 0} clears it. Never returned by GetViewSettings (read it from transformationMatrix).

structureDisplay.description: Structure display mode. One of EntireStructure, CoreOnly, WithoutFinishes, StructureOnly.

renovationFilterGuid.description: Identifier of the renovation filter applied to the view.

renovationFilterName.description: Name of the renovation filter applied to the view. Read-only (GetViewSettings): present together with renovationFilterGuid when the name could be resolved; set the filter via renovationFilterGuid.

d3styleName.description: Name of the 3D style. Empty if not set.

renderingSceneName.description: Name of the rendering scene. Empty if not set.

usePhotoRendering.description: Whether photo rendering is used for this view.

hasVisibleSkin.description: True when the element has at least one skin shown in the given Partial Structure Display mode.

VolumeType.description: The type of the volume measurement unit.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a Wall favorite to base the new element on. Its settings (structure, reference line location, top link, offsets, ...) are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them. With a favorite only begCoordinate and endCoordinate are needed.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

layerIndex.description: Optional layer attribute index to place the new element on. It must be an existing, unlocked layer. When omitted the element gets the layer of the favorite or of the tool defaults.

floorIndex.description: Story index (as returned by GetStories). When provided, zCoordinate is interpreted as bottomOffset relative to the floor. Takes priority over zCoordinate for floor assignment.

zCoordinate.description: Absolute Z when floorIndex is absent; bottomOffset relative to the floor when floorIndex is provided.

height.description: Optional explicit height. Sets relativeTopStory to 0, so it replaces the top link of the favorite or the tool default. When omitted, the height and top link of the favorite (or of the Wall tool defaults) are kept.

thickness.description: Optional thickness. When omitted, the favorite's or the Wall tool default's thickness is kept. Only takes effect on a Basic (homogeneous) wall - a Composite or Profile wall takes its thickness from the composite or profile attribute. Without structureType the new wall keeps the structure of the favorite (or the wall tool default), which may be a composite; send structureType 'Basic' for the thickness to apply.

offset.description: Optional reference line offset. When omitted, the favorite's or the Wall tool default's offset is kept.

arcAngle.description: Arc angle in radians; non-zero creates a curved wall (begCoordinate/endCoordinate are the chord endpoints).

referenceLineLocation.description: Optional. When omitted, the favorite's or the Wall tool default's reference line location is kept. The Core* values only have an effect on a Composite or Profile wall.

flipped.description: Optional. True mirrors the wall to its reference line (the side GetDetailsOfElements reports as flipped). When omitted, the favorite's or the Wall tool default's side is kept, which for a Profile wall mirrors its whole cross section.

slantAlpha.description: Only has an effect when the wall's profileType is Slanted or Trapez.

slantBeta.description: Only has an effect when the wall's profileType is Slanted or Trapez.

topOffset.description: Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.

relativeTopStory.description: Non-zero links the wall's top to another story instead of an explicit height - do not set together with 'height' for the same wall: whichever is applied last wins, and Archicad recomputes the actual height from the story elevations once relativeTopStory is non-zero.

visibility.description: Confirmed live on Archicad 29 (#852): a wall there knows only 'Home story only' and 'All relevant stories' (Wall Settings offers no Custom option), and Archicad silently drops every other combination written here although the command reports success - showAllAbove, showAllBelow, showRelAbove and showRelBelow (any value, 0 included) and showOnHome true -> false all read back unchanged. 'All relevant stories' is isAutoOnStoryVisibility true. 'Home story only' takes two calls: first isAutoOnStoryVisibility true (Archicad resets the custom fields to 0), then isAutoOnStoryVisibility false with visibility { showOnHome: true }. Archicad 30 adds a Custom option for walls; whether the other fields become writable there is untested.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true (the default on a new wall), Archicad recomputes 'visibility' automatically from the wall's vertical extent and ignores any value set for it. Setting 'visibility' without also setting this field turns it off automatically. See the note on 'visibility' for which combinations a wall accepts.

cutFillPen.description: Pen of the cut fill. Archicad 27 and later; ignored on older versions.

cutFillBackgroundPen.description: Background pen of the cut fill. Archicad 27 and later; ignored on older versions.

structureType.description: Optional. When neither this nor one of the attribute ids below is given, the favorite's or the Wall tool default's structure is kept.

contourPen.description: Pen of the wall's own contour/reference outline (API_WallType::contPen) - distinct from cutFillPen, which is the cut fill pattern's pen.

contourPen3D.description: Pen of the wall's contour in 3D views (API_WallType::contPen3D).

contourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the wall's own contour (API_WallType::contLtype) - pairs with contourPen, which only sets the pen, not the line type.

belowViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "OutLines Only" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup (API_WallType::belowViewLineType).

aboveViewLinePen.description: Pen used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup - pairs with aboveViewLinePen.

viewDepthLimitation.description: Only has an effect on a multi-story wall (relativeTopStory/topOffset making it span more than one story).

useCompositePriority.description: When true, the Composite's own priority is used at junctions instead of connectionPriority.

linkToSettings.description: When newCreationMode is true, homeStoryDifference overrides the home story selected by floorIndex or derived from zCoordinate.

inheritEndSurface.description: The end surface of the wall is inherited from the adjoining wall.

alignTexture.description: Align texture mapping to the wall's edges.

polyCanChange.description: The polygonal wall's corners can be changed in case of L and T connections. Only meaningful for a Polygonal wall (geometryType).

materialsChained.description: Whether the surface materials are chained.

logHeight.description: Height of the log for log walls. 0 means a normal (non-log) wall.

height.description: height relative to bottom

bottomOffset.description: base level of the wall relative to the floor level

offset.description: wall's base line's offset from ref. line

arcAngle.description: The arc angle of the curved wall in radians.

begThickness.description: Thickness at the beginning of wall, it will return 0 for poly wall type

endThickness.description: Thickness at the end of wall, it will return 0 for poly wall type

polygonOutline.description: Polygon outline in case of polygonal wall

polygonArcs.description: Polygon arcs in case of polygonal wall

profileType.description: Only Normal/Slanted/Trapez are settable via ModifyWalls - Poly needs a profile attribute wired through a separate mechanism. slantAlpha/slantBeta only have an effect once this is Slanted or Trapez.

slantAlpha.description: Only has an effect once profileType is set to Slanted or Trapez.

slantBeta.description: Only has an effect once profileType is set to Slanted or Trapez.

topOffset.description: Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.

relativeTopStory.description: Non-zero links the wall's top to another story instead of an explicit height - do not set together with 'height' via ModifyWalls in the same call.

visibility.description: On Archicad 29 a wall knows only 'Home story only' and 'All relevant stories' (Wall Settings offers no Custom option), so a wall can read back a combination the dialog cannot show - a wall fresh from the Wall tool defaults may report showOnHome false with showRelAbove 1, which Wall Settings shows as an empty Show on Stories field (#852). See ModifyWalls for which combinations can be written.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true (the default on a new wall), Archicad recomputes 'visibility' automatically from the wall's vertical extent and ignores any value set for it.

contourPen.description: Pen of the wall's own contour/reference outline (API_WallType::contPen) - distinct from cutFillPen, which is the cut fill pattern's pen inherited from the building material/composite/profile. Unlike cutFillPen this is not inheritable/overridable, it is the wall's own pen index directly, the same field used regardless of structureType (Basic, Composite or Profile).

contourPen3D.description: Pen of the wall's contour in 3D views (API_WallType::contPen3D).

contourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the wall's own contour (API_WallType::contLtype) - pairs with contourPen, which only sets the pen, not the line type.

belowViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "OutLines Only" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup (API_WallType::belowViewLineType). Corresponds to the "Uncut Lines" value in the Wall Settings dialog.

aboveViewLinePen.description: Pen used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup. Corresponds to the "Overhead Line Pens" value in the Wall Settings dialog.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup - pairs with aboveViewLinePen.

viewDepthLimitation.description: Only has an effect on a multi-story wall (relativeTopStory/topOffset making it span more than one story).

connectionPriority.description: Priority of the wall in a junction with other elements (API_WallType::wallConnPriority - higher wins the cut/cover at the junction). Archicad ignores writes to this field; read-only in practice.

useCompositePriority.description: When true, the Composite's own priority is used at junctions instead of connectionPriority.

junctionSequence.description: Tie-breaker (0-999) used when two walls meet with the same connectionPriority, or when 3+ walls meet in a junction (API_WallType::sequence). Archicad ignores writes to this field; read-only in practice.

linkToSettings.description: newCreationMode is expected to read back as false after creation; Archicad resolves the relative story selection to an absolute floor index.

inheritEndSurface.description: The end surface of the wall is inherited from the adjoining wall.

alignTexture.description: Align texture mapping to the wall's edges.

offsetFromOutside.description: Distance between the reference line and the outside face of the wall. Output only - not settable via ModifyWalls.

polyCanChange.description: The polygonal wall's corners can be changed in case of L and T connections. Only meaningful for a Polygonal wall (geometryType).

materialsChained.description: Whether the surface materials are chained.

logHeight.description: Height of the log for log walls. 0 means a normal (non-log) wall.

hasWindow.description: Whether the wall has at least one Window. Output only.

hasDoor.description: Whether the wall has at least one Door. Output only.

WallModificationGeometryType.description: The wall's plan outline shape, distinct from its cross section shape.

WallModificationProfileType.description: Cross section shape of the wall, distinct from geometryType (which is the plan outline).

WallProfileType.description: Cross section shape of the wall, distinct from geometryType (which is the plan outline).

WallQuantities.description: Quantities of a Wall element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

volumeConditional.description: Conditional net volume of the wall (openings smaller than minOpeningSize are not subtracted).

grossVolume.description: Gross volume of the wall (openings not subtracted).

referenceSideSurface.description: Net surface on the reference line side.

oppositeSideSurface.description: Net surface on the side opposite to the reference line.

edgeSurface.description: Surface of the edges of the wall.

referenceSideSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional surface on the reference line side.

oppositeSideSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional surface on the side opposite to the reference line.

grossReferenceSideSurface.description: Gross surface on the reference line side.

grossOppositeSideSurface.description: Gross surface on the side opposite to the reference line.

length.description: Average of the lengths on the two sides of the wall.

referenceSideLength.description: Length on the reference line side.

oppositeSideLength.description: Length on the side opposite to the reference line.

centerLength.description: Length of the wall at its center.

area.description: Floor plan area of the wall.

perimeter.description: Floor plan perimeter of the wall.

windowsSurface.description: Surface of the windows in the wall.

doorsSurface.description: Surface of the doors in the wall.

emptyOpeningsSurface.description: Surface of the empty openings in the wall.

emptyOpeningsVolume.description: Volume of the empty openings in the wall.

WallReferenceLineLocation.description: The Core* values only have an effect on a Composite or Profile wall (structureType) - a Basic wall has no core skin, and Archicad falls back to the nearest non-core equivalent (e.g. CoreCenter becomes Center).

height.description: height relative to bottom

bottomOffset.description: base level of the wall relative to the floor level

offset.description: wall's base line's offset from ref. line

begThickness.description: Thickness at the beginning in case of trapezoid wall

endThickness.description: Thickness at the end in case of trapezoid wall

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a Dimension favorite to base the new dimension on, e.g. for its layer, line pen and markers. Its settings are applied first, then the command sets the geometry and its usual text placement. The favorite's text size, text pen and text frame are not applied (tested in Archicad 28): use textHeight, textPen and textFrame for the texts. The Dimension tool defaults are left as they were.

textHeight.description: Optional height of the dimension texts in millimeters (paper size), applied to every witness point (on creation after favoriteName).

textPen.description: Optional pen index of the dimension texts, applied to every witness point (on creation after favoriteName).

textFrame.description: Optional frame around the dimension texts (true: framed, false: not framed), applied to every witness point. Without it a new dimension gets the Dimension tool's setting.

appearance.description: Optional dimension type, as in the Dimension Settings. A new dimension is Linear without it, whatever favoriteName or the Dimension tool defaults say. Elevation gives level marks, e.g. on a vertical chain in a section.

elevationOrigin.description: Optional level an Elevation dimension measures from. A new dimension gets the one of favoriteName or the Dimension tool defaults without it.

linePen.description: Optional pen of the dimension and witness lines.

marker.description: Optional marker at the witness points; give the type, the pen or both. Its size is not written: the size the API reports did not match the marker size of the Dimension Settings for linear dimensions.

defaultWitnessForm.description: Optional witness line form, as in the Dimension Settings, applied to every witness point.

defaultWitnessVal.description: Optional value that goes with the witness line form, in meters (for Fix the length of the witness lines), applied to every witness point.

geometryType.description: Polygonal is not settable here; it is read-only via GetDetailsOfElements. This is unrelated to slantAlpha/slantBeta - see profileType for the cross section shape those depend on.

arcAngle.description: Arc angle in radians; non-zero makes the wall curved (begCoordinate/endCoordinate are the chord endpoints).

height.description: Sets relativeTopStory to 0 (explicit height). Do not combine with relativeTopStory in the same call - whichever is applied last wins, and Archicad recomputes the actual height from the story elevations once relativeTopStory is non-zero.

thickness.description: Only takes effect on a Basic (homogeneous) wall - a Composite or Profile wall takes its thickness from the composite or profile attribute. Send structureType 'Basic' in the same call to switch such a wall first.

flipped.description: True mirrors the wall to its reference line (the side GetDetailsOfElements reports as flipped).

profileType.description: slantAlpha/slantBeta only have an effect once this is set to Slanted.

slantAlpha.description: Only has an effect when the wall's profileType is Slanted or Trapez.

slantBeta.description: Only has an effect when the wall's profileType is Slanted or Trapez.

topOffset.description: Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.

relativeTopStory.description: Non-zero links the wall's top to another story instead of an explicit height - do not set together with 'height' for the same wall: whichever is applied last wins, and Archicad recomputes the actual height from the story elevations once relativeTopStory is non-zero.

visibility.description: Confirmed live on Archicad 29 (#852): a wall there knows only 'Home story only' and 'All relevant stories' (Wall Settings offers no Custom option), and Archicad silently drops every other combination written here although the command reports success - showAllAbove, showAllBelow, showRelAbove and showRelBelow (any value, 0 included) and showOnHome true -> false all read back unchanged. 'All relevant stories' is isAutoOnStoryVisibility true. 'Home story only' takes two calls: first isAutoOnStoryVisibility true (Archicad resets the custom fields to 0), then isAutoOnStoryVisibility false with visibility { showOnHome: true }. Archicad 30 adds a Custom option for walls; whether the other fields become writable there is untested.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true (the default on a new wall), Archicad recomputes 'visibility' automatically from the wall's vertical extent and ignores any value set for it. Setting 'visibility' without also setting this field turns it off automatically. See the note on 'visibility' for which combinations a wall accepts.

cutFillPen.description: Pen of the cut fill. Archicad 27 and later; ignored on older versions.

cutFillBackgroundPen.description: Background pen of the cut fill. Archicad 27 and later; ignored on older versions.

contourPen.description: Pen of the wall's own contour/reference outline (API_WallType::contPen) - distinct from cutFillPen, which is the cut fill pattern's pen. Not inheritable/overridable like cutFillPen, it is the wall's own pen index directly, the same field regardless of structureType.

contourPen3D.description: Pen of the wall's contour in 3D views (API_WallType::contPen3D).

contourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the wall's own contour (API_WallType::contLtype) - pairs with contourPen, which only sets the pen, not the line type.

belowViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "OutLines Only" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup (API_WallType::belowViewLineType).

aboveViewLinePen.description: Pen used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup - pairs with aboveViewLinePen.

viewDepthLimitation.description: Only has an effect on a multi-story wall (relativeTopStory/topOffset making it span more than one story).

useCompositePriority.description: When true, the Composite's own priority is used at junctions instead of connectionPriority.

inheritEndSurface.description: The end surface of the wall is inherited from the adjoining wall.

alignTexture.description: Align texture mapping to the wall's edges.

polyCanChange.description: The polygonal wall's corners can be changed in case of L and T connections. Only meaningful for a Polygonal wall (geometryType).

materialsChained.description: Whether the surface materials are chained.

logHeight.description: Height of the log for log walls. 0 means a normal (non-log) wall.

reveal.description: Turn the reveal on or off.

revealDepthOffset.description: Distance the frame plane is moved across the wall thickness, along the wall normal.

pen.description: Pen of the opening's floor plan symbol; used unless useObjectPens is true.

lineTypeId.description: Line type of the opening's floor plan symbol; used unless useObjectLineTypes is true.

cutLineTypeId.description: Line type of the cut lines of the opening.

sectionFillId.description: Fill of the section of the opening; used unless useObjectSectionAttributes is true.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type of the overhead lines ("Overhead Lines").

belowViewLinePen.description: Pen of the uncut lines of the opening.

useObjectSectionAttributes.description: Use the section attributes defined in the library part instead of 'sectionFillId' and the section pens.

It has to be a window library part. Set on the created window only, with its A and B from `width` and `height` (or the tool default's width and height); the Window tool defaults are not changed.

favoriteName.description: Optional. Name of an existing Window favorite (as returned by `GetFavoritesByType`). Applied to the Window tool defaults before the create.

width.description: Opening width.

height.description: Opening height.

centerOffset.description: Center offset along the owner wall reference line.

revealDepthOffset.description: Distance the frame plane is moved across the wall thickness, along the wall normal. The same value ModifyWindows and ModifyDoors take.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for length values.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

WorkingUnitPreferences.description: The Working Units page: the units and the number of decimals the model's lengths, areas, volumes and angles are shown with.

WorkingUnitPreferencesUpdate.description: The Working Units page: the units and the number of decimals the model's lengths, areas, volumes and angles are shown with.

Number of decimals to display for volume values.

clipPolygon.description: The boundary of the cut out area, at least 3 points, without repeating the first one.

polygonArcs.description: Optional arcs of the boundary, with indices into clipPolygon.

markerCoordinate.description: Where the marker symbol is placed. Default is the first point of clipPolygon.

angle.description: Rotation of the marker symbol in radians. Default is that of the tool defaults.

name.description: Name of the new viewpoint. Default is that of the tool defaults.

id.description: Reference ID shown in the marker and in the Project Map. A '/' splits it between the two lines of the marker. Default is that of the tool defaults.

floorIndex.description: Story of the marker when it is placed on a floor plan. Default is the current story.

WouldChange.description: What a real run would change on a target. Each command says what its oldValue and newValue are; either is left out when it cannot be told cheaply.

oldValue.description: The target's value now, before the change.

newValue.description: The value a real run would write.

WouldChangeExecutionResult.description: The result of a dry run for a target that passed every check: a real run would change it as wouldChange says.

WouldDeleteExecutionResult.description: The result of a dry run for a target that passed every check: a real run would delete it.

zoneBoundariesOfZones.description: The boundaries of each requested Zone, in the same order as the zones array of the input.

ZoneBoundariesOrError.description: The response of the zone boundaries command or an error.

connectedElementId.description: The unique identifier of the connected element.

isExternal.description: True if the boundary is an external one.

neighbouringZoneElementId.description: Returns the unique identifier of the other Zone the element connects to if the boundary is internal. Please note that this boundary does not represent the boundary of the element with the other Zone.

area.description: The area of the polygon of the boundary.

polygonOutline.description: The outline polygon of the boundary.

ZoneBoundaryPart.description: Section of a wall, beam or curtain wall segment related to a zone.

roomEdgeIndex.description: Index of the zone polygon edge adjacent to the element (not present for beams).

begDistance.description: Beginning distance of the section from the beginning point of the element.

endDistance.description: End distance of the section from the beginning point of the element.

ZoneCategoryAttributeOrError.description: A zone category attribute or an error.

ZoneCategoryData.description: Data to create a Zone Category.

attributeId.description: Indentifier of the existing Zone Category to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

index.description: Index of the existing Zone Category to overwrite, ignored if overwriteExisting is false.

name.description: Name. If overwriteExisting is true, then the existing Zone Category with the given name will be overwritten.

stampName.description: Document name of the zone stamp library part (GSM) to use, e.g. the value returned by GetZoneCategories or shown as StampDocumentName in an Attribute Manager XML export. Only used together with stampMainGuid/stampRevGuid; ignored otherwise.

stampMainGuid.description: Main GUID of the zone stamp library part to use, e.g. the value returned by GetZoneCategories for an existing Zone Category or shown as MainGuid in an Attribute Manager XML export. If omitted, the stamp is copied from the Zone Category being overwritten, or from an existing Zone Category of the project when creating a new one.

stampRevGuid.description: Revision GUID of the zone stamp library part to use, e.g. the value shown as RevGuid in an Attribute Manager XML export. Required together with stampMainGuid.

ZoneContourLine.description: The contour line of a zone on the floor plan. GetDetailsOfElements returns every field; when setting, only the given fields are changed.

use.description: Whether the contour line is drawn.

pen.description: The pen index of the contour line.

lineTypeId.description: The line type attribute of the contour line.

ZoneCoverFill.description: The cover fill of a zone on the floor plan. GetDetailsOfElements returns every field; when setting, only the given fields are changed.

use.description: Whether the cover fill is drawn.

fillId.description: The fill attribute of the cover fill.

foregroundPen.description: The pen index of the fill pattern.

backgroundPen.description: The pen index of the fill background. 0 is a transparent background; -1 also occurs in projects and is accepted, so a value read with GetDetailsOfElements can always be written back.

ZoneCreationGeometry.description: Defines the geometry of a zone. Used as input for creating zones.

ZoneData.description: The parameters of the new Zone.

favoriteName.description: Optional name of a favorite to base the new element on. Its settings are applied first, then the explicitly given fields override them.

id.description: Optional Element ID of the new element (the ID field of the Settings dialog, shown in schedules and labels; the same string GetDetailsOfElements returns as id). When omitted the element gets the next automatic ID of its tool.

floorIndex.description: Optional story index of the new zone. An automatic zone (geometry.referencePosition) is found around its reference point on this story, which is made active in the floor plan while the zone is created; the previously active story is restored afterwards.

name.description: Name of the zone.

categoryAttributeId.description: The identifier of the zone category attribute.

stampPosition.description: Position of the origin of the zone stamp.

stampAngle.description: Optional zone stamp rotation angle in radians.

fixedStampAngle.description: If true, the zone stamp angle remains fixed when the element is rotated.

contourLine.description: Optional contour line of the zone. Fields that are left out keep the value of the favorite or of the Zone tool defaults.

coverFill.description: Optional cover fill of the zone. Fields that are left out keep the value of the favorite or of the Zone tool defaults.

allowOverlap.description: Optional, defaults to false. Archicad answers a new zone whose area overlaps an existing zone on the same story with a modal warning dialog that blocks the API until it is dismissed, so by default such an item fails with an error naming the overlapping zone and no element is created for it. Set it to true to skip this check and create the zone anyway; the dialog may then appear. Zones that only touch (a shared edge or corner) do not overlap; curved edges are checked by their chords, and an automatic zone counts as overlapping when its referencePosition lies inside an existing zone.

height.description: Optional height of the zone from its bottom. Sets relativeTopStory to 0 (explicit height); when omitted, the height and top link of the favorite or of the Zone tool defaults are kept. Do not combine with relativeTopStory.

bottomOffset.description: Optional base level of the zone relative to its home story level.

topOffset.description: Optional offset of the top of the zone from the linked top story level. Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.

relativeTopStory.description: Optional top link: non-zero links the top of the zone to another story, relative to its home story (1 is the story above), instead of an explicit height. Do not combine with height.

floorThickness.description: Optional thickness of the floor finish (subfloor thickness) of the zone.

name.description: Name of the zone.

categoryAttributeId.description: The identifier of the zone category attribute.

stampPosition.description: Position of the origin of the zone stamp.

stampAngle.description: Rotation angle of the zone stamp in radians.

fixedStampAngle.description: If true, the zone stamp angle remains fixed when the element is rotated.

isManual.description: Is the coordinates of the zone manually placed?

referencePosition.description: The reference point an automatic zone was placed from (the referencePosition of CreateZones); the zone is found around it when zones are updated. Only present when isManual is false.

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the edge of the zone.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the zone.

zCoordinate.description: Absolute elevation of the bottom of the zone (the home story level plus bottomOffset).

height.description: Height of the zone from its bottom. When relativeTopStory is non-zero, Archicad calculates it from the story levels and topOffset.

bottomOffset.description: Base level of the zone relative to its home story level.

topOffset.description: Offset of the top of the zone from the linked top story level. Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.

relativeTopStory.description: The story the top of the zone is linked to, relative to its home story (1 is the story above). 0 means not linked: the top is set by height.

floorThickness.description: Thickness of the floor finish (subfloor thickness) of the zone.

height.description: The ceiling height limit in meters.

reductionPercent.description: The reduction of the area under this limit, in percent.

height.description: The ceiling height limit in meters.

reductionPercent.description: The reduction of the area under this limit, in percent.

ZonePreferences.description: The Zones page: the reduction of the calculated zone area under a low ceiling. The wall inset (niche) sizes of the page are not available through the API.

ZonePreferencesUpdate.description: The Zones page: the reduction of the calculated zone area under a low ceiling. The wall inset (niche) sizes of the page are not available through the API.

ZoneQuantities.description: Quantities of a Zone element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

calculatedArea.description: Calculated area of the zone (after reductions).

height.description: Height of the zone.

doorsSurface.description: Surface of the doors in the zone.

windowsSurface.description: Surface of the windows in the zone.

percent.description: The percentage by which the area of the polygon reduces the Zone area, as the DevKit reports it.

area.description: The area of the polygon in square meters.

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the outline of the polygon in meters; the last coordinate repeats the first.

polygonArcs.description: The arcs of the outline, indices into polygonOutline. Absent when the outline has no arc.

ZoneReductionType.description: What reduces the area in the polygon, as the DevKit's APIRoomReduction type of the polygon: Wall, Column, Hatch (a Fill set to reduce the Zone area), Gable (a low ceiling, for example the part under a sloping Roof below the low ceiling height), or Rest (the remaining polygon of the Zone). Unknown for a value this version of Tapir does not name.

reductions.description: The reduction polygons of the Zone, as its Zone Stamp's area calculation uses them: the parts of the Zone polygon covered by Walls, Columns and reducing Fills, and the parts under a low ceiling (for example under a sloping Roof), each with the percentage it is reduced by and its area. Empty when nothing reduces the Zone's area.

ZoneRelations.description: The relations of a zone: the related elements grouped by type and the boundary sections of walls, beams and curtain wall segments.

elementsGroupedByType.description: The elements related to the zone, grouped by element type.

wallParts.description: Sections of walls that border the zone.

beamParts.description: Sections of beams related to the zone.

curtainWallSegmentParts.description: Sections of curtain wall segments that border the zone.

ZoneSettings.description: Settings for modifying a zone. Only the given fields are changed, the polygon is kept. Set height and bottomOffset with ModifyZones: in SetDetailsOfElements they would make a wall's settings ambiguous.

name.description: Name of the zone.

categoryAttributeId.description: The identifier of the zone category attribute.

stampPosition.description: Position of the origin of the zone stamp.

stampAngle.description: Rotation angle of the zone stamp in radians.

fixedStampAngle.description: If true, the zone stamp angle remains fixed when the element is rotated.

topOffset.description: Offset of the top of the zone from the linked top story level. Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.

relativeTopStory.description: Non-zero links the top of the zone to another story, relative to its home story (1 is the story above), instead of an explicit height. Do not set together with height (ModifyZones) in the same call: whichever is applied last wins.

floorThickness.description: Thickness of the floor finish (subfloor thickness) of the zone.

referencePosition.description: Moves the reference point of an automatic zone; the zone is found around the new point when zones are next updated. Ignored for a manual zone (isManual true).

name.description: Name of the zone.

categoryAttributeId.description: The identifier of the zone category attribute.

stampPosition.description: Position of the origin of the zone stamp.

stampAngle.description: Rotation angle of the zone stamp in radians.

fixedStampAngle.description: If true, the zone stamp angle remains fixed when the element is rotated.

height.description: Height of the zone from its bottom. Sets relativeTopStory to 0 (explicit height), so do not combine it with relativeTopStory in the same call: whichever is applied last wins.

bottomOffset.description: Base level of the zone relative to its home story level.

topOffset.description: Offset of the top of the zone from the linked top story level. Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.

relativeTopStory.description: Non-zero links the top of the zone to another story, relative to its home story (1 is the story above), instead of an explicit height. Do not set together with height in the same call, see the note on height.

floorThickness.description: Thickness of the floor finish (subfloor thickness) of the zone.

contourLine.description: Contour line of the zone. Only the given fields are changed.

coverFill.description: Cover fill of the zone. Only the given fields are changed.

Zoom.description: A rectangular zoom box in model coordinates.

xMin.description: The minimum X value of the zoom box.

yMin.description: The minimum Y value of the zoom box.

xMax.description: The maximum X value of the zoom box.

yMax.description: The maximum Y value of the zoom box.

keepSelection.description: Restore the selection the window had before the command (default). With false the given elements stay selected.
